Disclaimer: viewers are asked to watch the content with caution.
Greets the audience and thanks them for joining.
Announces that today's class is on Pluto.

hindi: प्लूटो पी लूटो जो लूट लेता है
says: He plays on the name: Pluto is the one who loots, so Pluto stands for plunder, taking away what one has.
cells_derived_method: Where Pluto sits shows what gets looted: money in the 2nd house, status in the 10th, savings and gains in the 11th, peace and sleep in the 12th; the sign shows how it is taken.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 2nd house in Gemini, lagna Taurus; savings and speech-based income are drained through clever dealings or deception.
Derived: Pluto in the 8th house in Scorpio, lagna Aries; sudden loss and total transformation, what is taken may later be rebuilt.
Derived: Pluto in the 12th house in Capricorn, lagna Aquarius; slow heavy drain through expenses, institutions or foreign stay.

ambiguity: The name pun is his own; it is a mnemonic and not an etymology.
classical_check: Pluto is not part of classical Jyotish; the pun is modern and the classical analogue would be Yama or Rahu-Ketu type loss.

hindi: इसे हमने अपने हिंदू धर्म शास्त्रों में जिस ग्रह के लिए कंपैरिजन में लिया है वेस्टर्न साहित्य के साथ वो ग्रह है यमराज
says: Compared with Western literature, the planet Pluto is the Hindu deity Yamraj in the scriptures.
classical_check: Pluto-Yama equivalence is a modern mapping; classical Jyotish has no outer planets, while Yama is classically linked to Saturn and the south.

hindi: धर्मराज धर्म के पालन करने वाला यम यानी कि यमलोक ले जाने वाला
says: Yama is Dharmaraj, the keeper of dharma, and the one who takes the departed to Yamaloka; Pluto carries both the law and the carrying away.
classical_check: Yama as Dharmaraj is classical Puranic; agrees.

hindi: मृत्यु लोक से नर्क लोक और देवलोक तक की आत्मा की यात्रा के लिए रिस्पांसिबल देवता
says: The deity responsible for the soul's journey from the world of mortals onward to the hell realm or up to the world of gods is Yama, which becomes Pluto's role.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic role of Yama as judge of the departed.

hindi: हमारे जीवन में जब जब मृत्यु होती है तो किश्तों में होती है
says: In our life, death arrives in instalments, not all at once: different parts of life die in stages, and Pluto governs these stages.
cells_derived_method: none: a general principle on how Pluto acts; which part dies depends on the house Pluto occupies.
ambiguity: Death here is both literal and the ending of phases of life.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; closest is the 8th house as a place of gradual decline.

hindi: पहले थोड़ा सा मन मरता है
says: The first instalment of death is a small death of the mind: interest, spirit or hope begins to fade before anything else.
cells_derived_method: none: the mind is the Moon's domain, so this stage corresponds to the Moon weakening under Pluto.
ambiguity: He does not name the Moon here; the link is my reading from later sentences.
classical_check: Moon as karaka of mind is classical; staging death by mind first is his own.

hindi: थोड़ा सा शरीर मरता है
says: The second instalment is a small death of the body: some part of physical vitality is lost, such as strength or function.
cells_derived_method: none: body loss is given as a stage; the house of Pluto would show which body area, but he does not say.
ambiguity: Not a medical claim; he describes stages of decay in general terms.

hindi: फिर पूरा मन मर जाता है या पूरा शरीर मर जाता है
says: The final instalment comes when the whole mind dies or the whole body dies, which is the complete end of that life phase or of the person.
ambiguity: Whole body dying is literal death; I record only that he lists it as the last stage and make no prediction.

hindi: तो मृत्यु का जो मालिक है वो यमराज
says: So the lord of death is Yamraj, and by his equation the planet that owns death in a chart is Pluto.
classical_check: Classical lord of death/longevity is Saturn and the 8th lord; Pluto is a modern addition, so differs.

hindi: यह हमारे घर के अंदर दक्षिण दिशा में स्थापित होता है
says: Yamraj is placed in the south direction inside our home, so the vastu link of Pluto is the south zone of the house.
cells_derived_method: none: a direction assignment; a house-wise view would link it to the 10th house, which is the south of the chart, but he does not say so.
ambiguity: South of the home can mean the south wall or the south-facing zone.
classical_check: Yama as lord of the south direction is classical vastu (Yama is the dikpala of the south); agrees.

gist: Says that in Sanatan dharma this too has been given the form of a deity.
Restates it as the deity of death.

hindi: शिव को मृत्यु का देवता कहा गया है बल्कि भगवान कहा गया है लेकिन ऐसा नहीं है
says: Shiva is commonly called the god of death, but he says that is not right; Shiva is not simply death.
classical_check: Differs from the common view; Shiva as Mahakala is associated with time and death, while he separates Shiva from the god of death role.

hindi: शिव रीइकारनेशन के देवता है
says: Shiva is the deity of reincarnation, the one who restores life again after death.
classical_check: Shiva as Mrityunjaya who overcomes death is classical; calling him reincarnation deity is his phrasing.

hindi: जो विष्णु शब्द है उसका अर्थ है विश्व का अणु जो पूरे के पूरे इलाके में अणु चलता है
says: He gives a meaning for the name Vishnu: the atom of the universe, the particle that runs through the entire region of space.
ambiguity: This is his own etymology; the standard root is vish, to pervade.
classical_check: Differs in wording from standard derivation but is close to the sense of pervading.

hindi: ईथर का कंटेंट जो ब्रह्मा है वो ब्रह्म है
says: The content of ether is Brahma, and that is Brahm.
ambiguity: Caption is choppy; read as Brahma standing for the ether element and Brahm.
classical_check: Ether (akasha) as the first element is classical; linking it to Brahma is a loose mapping.

hindi: ब्रह्म मींस कॉन्शियसनेस चेतना
says: Brahm means consciousness, the awareness underlying everything.
classical_check: Brahman as pure consciousness is Vedantic; agrees.

hindi: जो शिव है वो सब में ईश्वर यानी जीवन
says: Shiva is the Ishwar, the divinity present in everything, which means he is life itself.
classical_check: Silent as a chart rule; consistent with Shaiva doctrine.

hindi: अगर मरे हुए में ईश्वर है तो शिव
says: If the divine is present in the living, that is Shiva, and if the person has died the body is a shava, so Shiva means life and shava means the lifeless body.
ambiguity: Caption says in the dead there is Ishwar, which does not fit the rest; read as in the living.
classical_check: The shiva-shava wordplay is a common teaching device, not a classical text rule.

hindi: शव यानी शिव पुनः जीवन देने वाला जीवन के चक्र को जी ओ डी जनरेट ऑपरेट डिस्ट्रॉय
says: Shiva is the one who gives life again, completing the cycle of life; the three-part cycle is Generate, Operate, Destroy, which he spells as GOD.
classical_check: Brahma-Vishnu-Shiva as create-sustain-destroy is classical; the GOD acronym is his own.

hindi: तो शिव से ठीक पहले की कड़ी है यमराज यमराज मृत्यु संहार का देवता जो हर चीज को खत्म करता है धीरे-धीरे
says: Yamraj is the link just before Shiva in this cycle: the god of death and destruction who slowly finishes every thing, after which Shiva restores.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; the ordering Yama then Shiva is his own scheme.

hindi: हमारे जीवन में कार्य पैसा धन समाप्त होता है
says: In our life, work, money and wealth come to an end gradually, and that gradual ending is Yama's, meaning Pluto's, action.
cells_derived_method: Which of work or wealth ends depends on the house: Pluto in the 10th hits work, in the 2nd or 11th hits money.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 10th house in Aquarius, lagna Taurus; career structures erode slowly through changes in the field.
Derived: Pluto in the 11th house in Sagittarius, lagna Aquarius; steady gains dry up and networks fall away.

ambiguity: Whether it applies to Pluto's placement or to Pluto's dasha/transit is not stated.
classical_check: Silent; closest classical idea is loss of wealth through the 6th, 8th and 12th lords.

hindi: धीरे-धीरे ऐसा भी होता है कि हम लूट पिट कर बीमार पड़कर खराब होकर दोबारा वापस आते हैं
says: Slowly it also happens that a person is looted, beaten, falls ill and is ruined, and yet comes back again; Pluto's ruin is followed by a return.
ambiguity: Illness is mentioned only as part of a general life-crash story, not a medical diagnosis.

hindi: ऐसे ऐसे भी लोग हैं जो जीवन के अंदर मौत के मुंह से वापस आए हैं
says: There are people who have returned from the very mouth of death, which he treats as evidence of revival after Pluto's grip.
classical_check: Silent; classical analogue is the 8th house giving long life after danger.

hindi: यानी जिनके जीवन में बिल्कुल तबाही हो चुकी है
says: He means those whose lives were totally wrecked; the revival he describes applies to complete devastation, not mild trouble.

hindi: आपका मरा हुआ प्रेम जीवित हो गया
says: A love that had died comes alive again, one of the forms of Pluto-Shiva revival he lists.
cells_derived_method: Love and relationships are the 5th and 7th houses; revival would show in those houses when Pluto is placed or aspects there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 7th house in Libra, lagna Aries; a marriage that nearly broke can be rebuilt after a crisis.
Derived: Pluto in the 5th house in Cancer, lagna Pisces; a romance thought finished returns with emotional intensity.

hindi: आपके शरीर के अंग वापस रीजेनरेट हो गए
says: Body parts regenerate again; revival can show as physical restoration after a breakdown. This is his claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: Regeneration is stated loosely and should not be read as a cure claim.

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर पुनः से ऐसा उत्थान हुआ
says: Life rises again to a new high after the fall, a recovery of status and fortune after Pluto's phase.
classical_check: Silent; classical analogue is the viparita raja yoga where loss houses give a later rise.

hindi: आपकी समस्या खत्म हो के दोबारा से जिंदगी बढ़िया हो गई
says: The problem ends and life becomes good again, the last of his examples of revival.

hindi: ये सारे के सारे काम तब है जब यमराज की कृपा मिली
says: All of these revivals happen only when Yamraj's grace has been received; Pluto's favour is the condition for revival.
ambiguity: Contradicts his later point that the Moon and Shiva give the revival; here he says Yama's grace.

gist: Rhetorical question: how is Yamraj's grace obtained?

hindi: पुनर्जीवन
says: His one-word answer is that grace comes as rebirth or revival, the return of life.
ambiguity: One-word reply, meaning drawn from the neighbouring sentences.

hindi: मृत्युंजय देवता यानी शिव ने दोबारा से कहा अच्छा ठीक है कोई नहीं यमराज हट जाओ यहां से साइड को हटो मेरा बच्चा है यह मैं इसको पुनः जीवन दूंगा
says: Shiva as Mrityunjaya tells Yamraj to step aside because the person is his child and he will give life again, so Shiva overrides Pluto's taking.
classical_check: Mrityunjaya as the one who conquers death is classical; this is a mythic framing of it.

gist: Starts the story: a Yamdoot tells Yamraj that a soul in Kashi cannot be brought away.
Yamraj says he has the right over every dead soul and will take it himself.
The messenger says an invisible power blocks them and the soul is not being released.
Yamraj wonders at the strange miracle.
Yamraj meditates but cannot work it out.
He decides to go himself.
Says otherwise the law of creation would change.
Asks how this could be possible.

hindi: तो उसने अपना निकाला महेश भैंसा जिसका सवार है वो और लेकर चल पड़ा
says: Yamraj takes out his vehicle, the buffalo (the caption garbles it as Mahesh) that he rides, and sets out; the buffalo is Yama's mount.
ambiguity: Caption word Mahesh is probably a misrecognition of mahish, buffalo.
classical_check: Yama riding a buffalo is Puranic; agrees.

gist: On reaching Kashi he sees an invisible power protecting the whole city, making it impossible to take the soul out.
Yamraj is astonished and troubled.
On meditating he learns Bhairav is protecting the soul.
Says the deity is called Kaal Bhairav.

hindi: काल मृत्यु का देवता है
says: Kaal means the deity of death, so Kaal Bhairav is a form tied to death and time.
ambiguity: Sentence split across caption lines: Kaal is the deity of death.
classical_check: Kaal as time and death is classical.

hindi: महाकाल शिव है
says: Mahakal is Shiva, the great time who rules over death.
classical_check: Mahakal as a name of Shiva is classical; agrees.

hindi: तो शिव का ही स्वरूप है
says: Kaal Bhairav is a form of Shiva himself, not a separate deity.
classical_check: Agrees with Shaiva tradition that Bhairav is a fierce form of Shiva.

gist: Says Kaal Bhairav is protecting the soul completely.
Yamraj roars and asks who is there.
Kaal Bhairav replies that Shiva owns this land.
He tells Yamraj that the soul cannot be taken from here.
Says this soul will be given moksha.
Says Shiva sits there to give moksha while Yamraj would only take the soul away.
Says Yamraj would throw it back into the cycle of birth and death.
Concludes the right over this soul is Kaal Bhairav's.
Says the Puranas have many such stories and a fierce battle took place.
Yamraj is beaten in the battle and concedes it is almost impossible to win.
Yamraj meditates on Shiva, who says leave it to me.

hindi: यानी शिव की एक ऐसी शक्ति है जो चंद्रमा देवता है जो आपके जीवन के अंदर पुनर्जीवन दे सकता है
says: Shiva has a power that is the Moon deity, and the Moon is the one that can give rebirth in your life, so the Moon is the planetary remedy against Pluto's death.
cells_derived_method: A strong Moon revives where it sits: in the 4th house it restores home and peace, in the 1st it restores vitality, in the 8th it restores after crisis; the sign strengthens (Taurus exalted, Cancer own) or weakens (Scorpio).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 4th house, lagna Aries; strong revival through home and mother.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 8th house, lagna Libra; recovery after crises is supported.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 1st house, lagna Scorpio; weak revival power, vulnerable body and mind.

classical_check: Moon is on Shiva's head and as karaka of life-fluid and mind is classical; Moon as the planetary answer to Pluto is his modern mapping.

hindi: जब जब आपकी मृत्यु होती है यानी आप जब परेशान होते हैं दिक्कत में होते हैं तो डॉक्टर कहता है ना खून जम गया भाई
says: Whenever a little death comes, meaning you are in trouble, the doctor says the blood has clotted; he treats the freezing of blood as the Moon's failing. This is his analogy, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Medical language used loosely as an analogy for a weak Moon.
classical_check: Moon as karaka of blood and fluids is classical.

hindi: भाई शरीर का तो पानी जम गया
says: The body's water has frozen, which is the picture of Moon, the water element, going cold and inactive.
classical_check: Moon as water and body fluids is classical; agrees.

hindi: यानी चंद्रमा निस्तेज हो जाता है
says: This means the Moon goes dull and loses its radiance, the planetary sign of the first stage of Pluto's pull.
classical_check: A dull, afflicted Moon is classically bad for mind and body; agrees.

hindi: जब आपका चंद्रमा बिल्कुल वीक होता चला जाता है यानी कि आपका यमराज प्लूटो बहुत ताकत पकड़ रहा है
says: When the Moon keeps weakening, it means Yamraj Pluto is gaining a lot of strength in the person's life; a falling Moon and a rising Pluto go together.
cells_derived_method: Moon is weakest in Scorpio and when afflicted or waning; the house shows the area where Pluto takes over: 4th the home, 6th the health routine, 8th sudden crises, 12th sleep and rest.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Moon in the 4th house, lagna Leo; home peace goes first, then Pluto's loss pattern sets in.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 6th house, lagna Gemini; daily health and work routine decline under pressure.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 12th house, lagna Sagittarius; sleep, rest and spending go out of control.

ambiguity: Weak Moon is not defined here; Scorpio is the sign of debilitation but he may include afflicted or waning Moon.
classical_check: Moon waning or in Scorpio weak is classical; the link to Pluto gaining strength is his own.

hindi: यानी मृत्यु आपको निगल लेगी
says: This means death will swallow the person, the end result if the Moon keeps weakening and Pluto keeps rising. He states it as a general claim and gives no timing.
ambiguity: Literal death or only the death of a life phase; flagged as a claim, not a prediction.

gist: Asks how it is when we are about to die.
Says the body goes cold.
Asks what is done for a dying person.

hindi: पैर तलवे सहलाते हैं ना खच खच खच खच
says: The soles and feet of a dying person are rubbed, a common custom that he links to Pluto because the feet are Pluto's place; recorded as a tradition he cites.
ambiguity: He does not say the rubbing is a remedy, only that it is done; the link to Pluto is in the next sentences.

gist: Reminds the class that in earlier classes they discussed which planet holds the place of the feet.

hindi: प्लूटो के पास
says: The place of the feet belongs to Pluto in his body map.
cells_derived_method: Body parts map to the houses: the 12th house is the feet in classical body mapping, so Pluto's body area would also be read in the 12th, but he does not say that here.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 12th house in Aquarius, lagna Pisces; feet and lower limbs are the vulnerable area.
Derived: Pluto in the 12th house in Gemini, lagna Cancer; feet issues through nerves and movement.

classical_check: Classical Kalapurusha gives the feet to Pisces, the 12th sign, and Jupiter or Venus; assigning feet to Pluto is his modern body map.

hindi: यमराज यह प्लूटो है
says: Yamraj is Pluto, repeated while pointing to the body diagram at the feet.
classical_check: Modern mapping, see the earlier row.

hindi: यमराज यह नेप्च्यून है
says: He points to Neptune on the body diagram next to Pluto; the caption says Yamraj for Neptune, which is probably a slip for Varuna, his name for Neptune.
ambiguity: Caption or speaker error: Yamraj is Pluto, so this is Neptune/Varuna.

hindi: यह इंद्र पैर पैरों के स्थान पर प्लूटो है
says: He points to Indra, Uranus, in the diagram and says that at the place of the feet is Pluto.
ambiguity: Sentence is garbled and mixes Indra with the feet; the order of outer planets on the body diagram is not clear.

hindi: इसके ऊपर शनि है
says: Above the feet region, Saturn comes next in the body diagram.
ambiguity: Which body part is meant by above is shown by gesture, not words.
classical_check: Saturn as legs and knees in some schemes is classical, so roughly consistent.

hindi: बृहस्पति है
says: Jupiter sits next above Saturn in the body diagram.
ambiguity: Position given by gesture only.
classical_check: Jupiter as thighs and hips is classical Kalapurusha (Sagittarius thighs); roughly consistent.

gist: Describes a child sitting in a squat as a way to picture the body map.
Gestures with the feet drawn in and hips down in the squat.
Says imagine sitting in pot style.
Says the knees come up to here, shown by gesture.
Says the thighs stay here, shown by gesture.

hindi: पैर का जो आखिरी पंजा है वो यहां आ जाता है
says: In the squat the very last part of the foot, the toes, comes up beside the hip region, which is how he locates the Pluto zone of the body.
ambiguity: Location shown by gesture.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own body mapping.

gist: Adds that this is exactly beside the hip bone.

hindi: यह प्लूटो है
says: This region at the end of the feet beside the hip bone is Pluto.

hindi: प्लूटो के इलाके में मौत शुरू होती है
says: Death begins in Pluto's area, meaning the feet and lower body, which is why the cold of death rises from the feet.
ambiguity: A claim about the dying process recorded as a tradition statement, not medical.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts, though tradition does say death cold climbs up from the feet.

hindi: अगर आपके जीवन में डॉक्टर कह रहा है बीमार हो ब्लड प्रेशर है प्रॉब्लम है शुगर है दिक्कत है चलो इसे एक्टिवेट
says: If a doctor tells you that you are ill, with blood pressure or sugar problems, he reads it as Pluto being activated; the sentence is cut off at the end of the batch. Recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Sentence is cut off at the batch boundary so the conclusion is missing.

gist: One word that completes the cut-off previous sentence: do it, activate it.

hindi: पैर ठंडे हो जाते हैं ना पैर ठंडे हो गए
says: When a person is dying or very ill the feet turn cold first; he reads the cooling of the feet as Pluto's area going dead.
cells_derived_method: Feet are the 12th-house region in classical body mapping, so Pluto in or aspecting the 12th would show lower-limb coldness or weakness, while Pluto in the 6th would show it as ailments of routine and service.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 12th house in Pisces, lagna Aries; feet and rest are the sensitive zone, with chills in the feet and sleep disturbance.
Derived: Pluto in the 6th house in Virgo, lagna Aries; the lower body weakens through routine, over-analysis and poor circulation, in his idiom.

ambiguity: Cold feet at death is descriptive; the Pluto link is his reading, and this is not a medical statement.
classical_check: Classical texts give the feet to the 12th house and Pisces, but no text links cold feet to Pluto.

hindi: सबसे पहले जान निकल रही है
says: Life leaves from the feet first, so the feet are where death starts, which makes the feet Pluto's territory.
classical_check: Traditional belief that life leaves through the feet at death is old; no classical planetary link.

hindi: भाई पैर नहीं हिल रहे मेरे डर के मारे
says: When we are terrified the feet will not move, which he cites as another sign that fear is felt in Pluto's body area.

gist: Rhetorical question: what happens in panic?
Idiom that death has fallen on the throat, meaning intense fear.

hindi: लगता है मर ही जाएंगे
says: In panic we feel we are going to die, so extreme fear mimics Pluto's death-energy even when there is no real danger.

gist: Rhetorical question: what do we do all our life?

hindi: भगवान हो बड़ा हो कोई भी हो उसके पैर छूते हैं
says: Whether it is God or an elder, we touch the feet of whoever is great; touching feet is therefore an act addressed to Pluto's zone.
classical_check: Touching feet (pranam) is a classical custom of respect; the Pluto explanation is new.

hindi: कहते भैया यमराज माफ कर दे बाबा जी
