hindi: तो शरीर याद करेगा तो बच्चे को मरे हुए व्यक्ति को जला दिया जाता है
says: Since the soul will remember the body, the dead person is burned so that the memory has no support; the caption is jumbled but this is the reason he gives for cremation.
ambiguity: The word child in the caption is probably a recognition error.
classical_check: Cremation as release is classical; agrees.

gist: Asks what is done in Abrahamic religions.

hindi: नहीं एक ही जन्म है इसी जन्म में ही जीना है उसके पश्चात आपको रिकारनेशन यहीं पर मिलेगा
says: In Abrahamic religions there is only one birth and one must live it here, after which the rising again happens at the same place, so the body is preserved.
ambiguity: His summary of other religions' belief; recorded as said.

hindi: इसलिए हड्डी संभाल के रखते हैं तो आत्मा गोलगोल घूमती है ऐसी प्रेत योनि के अंदर ऐसे भी लोग जाते हैं
says: Because the bones are kept, the soul circles round and round and enters the preta yoni, the ghost state, which is what happens to some people.
classical_check: Garuda Purana speaks of preta yoni after improper rites; partly agrees.

hindi: सनातन धर्म हो कोई सा भी धर्म कोई लिंक नहीं है
says: It does not matter which religion the dead person belonged to; the ghost state has no link with any religion.

hindi: हिंदू मुस्लिम से लेनदेन नहीं वो भटकती है
says: He has no dealings with the Hindu or Muslim label; the soul that is not released simply wanders.

hindi: इसी को प्रेत आत्माएं कहते हैं
says: These wandering unreleased souls are what are called preta atmas, ghost souls.
ambiguity: Sentence is split across the caption lines.
classical_check: Preta as a wandering departed is classical.

hindi: यानी जिनको यमराज ने भी नहीं स्वीकारा
says: Ghost souls are those whom even Yamraj has not accepted, so they remain in between.

hindi: आपके जीवन में कोई चीज ऐसी खराब हुई कि आपने उसकी डायरी बंद नहीं की
says: In life something went so bad that you never closed its diary, meaning you never let it end, so the past keeps haunting you like a ghost.

gist: Example: ten years ago my brother wrote off ten lakhs and I am still crying over it.

hindi: सोच के चलिए यमराज मुक्ति भी तो देता भाई
says: Think about it, Yamraj also gives liberation, so Pluto's ending releases a person from what binds him.

hindi: स्यापा ही मुख जाता है
says: The lamentation itself comes to an end when Pluto closes the matter.
ambiguity: The verb is garbled; read as the wailing ends.

hindi: इससे तो मेरा यार ये यादें खत्म हो जाती
says: With that closure these painful memories would be finished, and a clean end is better than clinging to them.

gist: Says people are living with constant quarrel and sorrow.
Example starts: there is trouble in the leg.

hindi: डॉक्टर ने काट दी
says: The doctor amputated the leg, which he treats as a small death of a body part that ends a long suffering. Recorded as his example, not medical advice.
ambiguity: A medical illustration used for Pluto's small deaths, not a diagnosis.

gist: Says it ended the lamentation completely.

hindi: अंग भंग कर देते हैं
says: Doctors cut away limbs or organs, which he counts as Pluto's small deaths, a part dies so that the person lives.

gist: Asks what a small death is.
Example: the kidney is troubling.

hindi: किडनी निकाल ली
says: The kidney was removed, another small death of an organ, after which the person carries on well. This is his example and not a medical claim.

gist: Says he is now running well on the remaining kidney.
Says the person became excellent.
Example: forty percent heart damage.
Says medicine was given and the person is fit.
Asks what is happening here.

hindi: यमराज ने मुक्त भी कर दिया
says: Yamraj has also freed the person, so Pluto's small deaths are releases from suffering.

hindi: तो ये मुक्ति भी देता है कष्टों से
says: So Pluto also gives liberation from troubles, not only loss.
classical_check: Silent; compare Ketu and the 12th house as givers of release.

hindi: जब मौत हो जाती है और आत्मा गोलगोल घूमती है शरीर के आसपास
says: After death the soul circles around the body, staying near it.
classical_check: Garuda Purana has the soul stay near the body in the early days; agrees.

hindi: ये हमारे शास्त्रों में उल्लेख है
says: He says this idea of the soul hovering round the body is mentioned in our scriptures.
ambiguity: No text is named.
classical_check: Garuda Purana is the likely source.

hindi: तो वो आत्मा इंतजार करती है
says: The soul waits for something, hoping to return to its body.

hindi: शरीर के साथ-साथ रहती है
says: The soul stays beside the body all along, without leaving it.

hindi: जब तक जला ना दिया जाए
says: The soul stays near the body until the body is burned, which is why prompt cremation matters.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical urgency of cremation.

hindi: फिर उसे कंफर्म हो जाता है यार अब ये यह प्रॉपर्टी मिलेगी नहीं भाई
says: After cremation it is confirmed to the soul that this property, its body, will not be had again, so it accepts the loss.

hindi: ये गई लुट गई यार
says: The soul concludes the body is gone and looted for good, which is the acceptance that lets it move on.

hindi: अब दूसरी प्रॉपर्टी ढूंढता
says: Having lost this property it starts looking for another, a new body; the sentence is cut off at the end of the batch.
ambiguity: Sentence is cut off at the batch boundary.

gist: Filler syllable that continues from the previous slice.
After death the soul goes on according to the account of its deeds, to heaven or hell.
At Yamaloka the soul is presented and Chitragupta tells it to face what it did.
Chitragupta says the soul gave commands, even mistaken ones, in its life.
The soul does not even remember what commands it gave.
Those commands will now be fulfilled.

hindi: तो कर्मों के अनुसार फल देगा।
says: Yama (his Pluto), working through Chitragupta's ledger, returns results in exact proportion to the person's own deeds and earlier 'commands'. He presents Pluto as the karmic accountant, not a random punisher.
cells_derived_method: Pluto's house would show the life area where the karmic account comes due: 8th (endings, transformation), 12th (loss, release), 6th (debts, illness, service). The sign it sits in colours the manner of settlement.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: the account is settled through deep crises and forced transformation.
derived, not said by him: the account is settled through isolation, loss and release from attachments.
derived, not said by him: the account is settled through debts, duties and health discipline.

ambiguity: The subject of 'will give fruit' is Chitragupta or Yama; he equates Yama with Pluto elsewhere in this series.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish has no Pluto; the doctrine that deeds bear fruit in proportion matches the prarabdha karma idea.

gist: Small children are often buried, not cremated, in some customs.
An infant who was to live only months or two years is buried so the soul does not take another body.

hindi: क्योंकि फिर मरेगी किसी आत्मा ने लिखा के लाया 100 साल का जीवन होगा पूर्ण जिंदगी ली किसी ने लिखा है दो साल तो क्या जिंदगी है यार उसकी
says: Each soul arrives with its own pre-written lifespan: one carries a hundred years and lives it fully, another carries only two years. Lifespan is treated as fixed at birth by the soul's own account. Recorded only as his belief; it gives no date for anyone.
ambiguity: Garbled run-on caption. It is unclear if he means the soul chooses the span or that it is imposed by past karma.
classical_check: Classical ayurdaya (longevity) rules also treat lifespan as fixed by prarabdha; they compute it from lagna, Moon and the 8th lord, which he does not do here.

gist: Bury the infant so it does not take birth again; he says there is a whole science behind this.
Some religions keep the soul 'alive' in a resting state in the belief of later reincarnation.
When the soul's account is complete in the preta realm.
The soul then takes its next birth.
The settling of the account is possible, said as a lead-in.
Cut-off fragment: according to your command it may be done in six days, continued in the next slice.
Or perhaps it takes six yugas; the duration of the account is unknown.
Only Yamraj and Chitragupta know this secret.
Colloquial remark that the mourning around a death never ends.

hindi: तो प्लूटो ने मुक्ति नहीं दी है।
says: When mourning around a departed person drags on endlessly, he reads it as Pluto not yet having granted the soul its release (mukti). Pluto is the planet that frees or holds the departed account.
cells_derived_method: Which house Pluto sits in or aspects would show where the 'unreleased' theme plays out in the living family: 4th (home and mother's side), 8th (inheritance, endings), 12th (departure, moksha). The sign adds the style.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: lingering grief and attachment centred on the home and family line.
derived, not said by him: the unresolved theme shows as secrets, inheritance disputes and long-running endings.
derived, not said by him: the release is delayed and appears as withdrawal, escapism or confinement.

ambiguity: It is not clear if 'mukti' is the soul's release or the living mind's release from grief.
classical_check: Not found in classical texts; Ketu and the 12th house are the classical moksha signifiers. Pluto here is his own scheme.

hindi: आत्मा भटक रही है।
says: He states that when the account is not cleared the departed soul is wandering, tied to the family's unreleased grief. This is the other half of the Pluto-has-not-freed-it claim and rests on belief, not on a chart rule.
ambiguity: Could refer to the dead soul wandering or to the mind of the living wandering; the next sentences speak of 'our mind'.
classical_check: Classical texts have no sign for this; preta and pitru-dosha ideas are the nearest, tied to the 9th house and Sun, not Pluto.

gist: Mimics a grandmother wailing; one word is garbled in the caption.
Mimics an old father lying in the ICU and crying.
The mimicked cry: what shall I do.

hindi: आईसीयू के पेशेंट प्लूटो के पास होते हैं सारे के सारे।
says: He assigns all patients lying in intensive care to Pluto's domain. This is a karaka claim about a hospital-type situation of prolonged critical care, not a medical diagnosis of anyone.
cells_derived_method: A critical-care or long-confinement period would be seen through Pluto's house, since 6th (illness), 8th (crisis) and 12th (hospitalisation) are the matching house topics.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: long-term illness and care routines with an impersonal, institutional flavour.
derived, not said by him: sudden life-and-death turns and invasive procedures.
derived, not said by him: stays in hospital or confinement, loss of control.

ambiguity: 'Under Pluto' may mean period (dasha) or natal placement; he does not say.
classical_check: Classical karakas for hospitals are the 6th and 12th houses and Saturn or Ketu; Pluto is outside the classical set.

hindi: क्योंकि प्लूटो कहता है भाई मारूंगा मैं किस्तों में मारूंगा।
says: Pluto, speaking in his voice, says it will 'kill' in instalments. He means that its way of ending things (health, status, relationships) is staged and gradual, not in one blow.
cells_derived_method: The house Pluto sits in shows which area is worn down in stages: 2nd (savings), 7th (partnership), 10th (career). The sign sets the pace and manner.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: wealth or family resources wear away in steps.
derived, not said by him: a partnership fades through a series of small ruptures.
derived, not said by him: status and career erode slowly over years.

ambiguity: 'Kill' is used in a literal and an figurative sense; he is speaking of dying patients here.
classical_check: Not in classical texts; the slow-grinding style resembles Saturn in classical work.

hindi: बहुत धीरे-धीरे मारूंगा यार घड़क से।
says: Pluto's action is very slow, drawn out, in contrast with a sudden cut. Slowness is its signature, and he stresses it as the reason patients linger in intensive care.
ambiguity: Caption word 'घड़क' is garbled and probably contrasts slow with a clean fast cut.

gist: Joke that this will not be 'jhatka' meat, meaning not a quick single cut.
Repeats that it will be done slowly.

hindi: एकदम से मौत हो जाए तो भी बड़ी सुंदर मौत।
says: If death comes suddenly instead of in instalments he calls that a beautiful death. A sudden, painless end is, in his view, the kinder side of Pluto's work. It is a general remark with no date or person attached.
ambiguity: It is unclear what in a chart separates the slow Pluto outcome from the sudden one.
classical_check: Classical texts link sudden endings to Mars, Rahu or the 8th lord; they do not call it a favour.

gist: Example of dying peacefully in sleep (first word garbled).
Exclamation about how lovely Pluto would then be.

hindi: कितना शानदार होगा आपका कि उसने आप पर ऐसी कृपा कर दी कि मौत बहुत बढ़िया से दे डाली।
says: A peaceful death should be taken as Pluto's grace on you: it spared you the instalment route. He reframes the sudden easy end as a favour from Pluto rather than a punishment. No person or date is implied.
ambiguity: 'Aapka' may be 'your luck' or 'your good fortune'; the caption is loose.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; a gentle end is classically a Jupiter/Venus or 12th-house-benefic indication.

gist: Starts a story about a very troubling account (hisab-kitab) coming up.
A woman, Mona, is ill in a big hospital with all reports bad and doctors baffled.
Doctors say Mona has incurable diseases in her body.
Her blood reports are so bad that the doctors are amazed.
They cannot understand the treatment and wonder whether to let her die.
But a doctor's duty is not to let a patient die.
They must keep trying something until the very end.
By trial and error the senior doctors decide to shift her to another hospital.
Remark that the girl is now left to God.
Some doctors ask what is the use if she dies in their hospital.
It would bring a bad name.
It is a difficult, troublesome case.
Mona is told she will go to another hospital.
She answers that they may send her anywhere now.
She asks to first see a hilltop saint, after which she will die in the other hospital.
They sign the papers, pack her into an ambulance and take her to the saint.
At the saint's place she is seated in a wheelchair and bows with folded hands.
The saint asks why she has come.
She says she feels she will not be able to come again.
The saint asks where she is going.
She answers: the hospital.
He asks why she is going.
He tells her to die right there.
Dying is inevitable for her anyway.
If she will not return, why go at all.
Stay here.
She says she cannot understand why this situation came in her life.
She claims she only did good deeds.
She never did bad deeds either.
She says she never did anything.
She says she cannot understand it.
She says she did no harm to anyone.
She says she did nothing in this birth.
The saint says that cannot be.

hindi: तुम्हारे शरीर में पीड़ा है इसका मतलब तुम्हारे मन में कोई कीड़ा है।
says: Pain in the body means there is a worm, an unresolved grievance, sitting in the mind. He links physical suffering to a mental burden. Recorded only as his belief; it is not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: He does not name a planet for the mind here; elsewhere the Moon is the classical mind-karaka.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish ties the mind to the Moon and the 4th house, and mental affliction to the 6th/8th, but gives no rule that body pain proves a mental cause.

gist: The saint says something heavy is going on inside her.

hindi: इतना वजन है कि डॉक्टर तुम्हारे शरीर का इलाज नहीं कर पा रहे क्योंकि तुम्हारे मन का इलाज चाहिए।
says: The inner load is so heavy that doctors cannot cure the body, because what needs treatment is the mind. Recorded only as his belief about why treatment fails; it is not medical advice and no cure is implied.
ambiguity: None of the 12 planets is named, so no chart cell can be derived.
classical_check: Silent; classical remedies (mantra, charity) address karma, but no text says medicine fails because of the mind.

gist: She asks the saint for some blessing.
She asks what she should do.
She repeats that she cannot understand anything.
The saint says she has kept something inside.

hindi: जो तुम्हें कूड़े मार रहा है और उसके कारण तुम्हारा शरीर बर्बाद हुए जा रहा है।
says: The thing you keep hidden inside is what is gnawing at you, and the body is being ruined because of it. Suppressed inner matter is named as the cause of bodily collapse. This is his belief only and not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: The caption word 'कूड़े' is probably 'कुरेद' (scratching); the sense is that it eats at her.

gist: She asks the saint what to do then.

hindi: बोले बेटा वापस लौट के आना है ना तो वो कूड़ा यहीं छोड़ जा।
says: Remedy: if you want to come back healthy, leave the inner garbage (grudges and resentments) behind at the saint's feet before you go. Leaving the burden is the condition for returning.
ambiguity: Whether this is a ritual at a holy place or an inner act that can be done anywhere is not clear from the sentence.
classical_check: Classical remedies include forgiveness and charity, but this surrender-at-the-feet form is not in the texts.

gist: She meditates five minutes, bows to the saint and leaves.
She goes back to the hospital and the doctors admit her.
They begin the tests again.
By the seventh day the test reports slowly start coming out right.
The doctors say it is a miracle.
Within ten days the girl is fully well.
The reports are normal; what magic is this.
Rhetorical question whether Yamraj let go of the one he had caught.
The doctors are amazed.
Doctors from both hospitals come.
They ask the patient what exactly she did.
She says she does not know.
She says she did nothing at all.
Garbled line, possibly 'by itself, you people are God'; sense cannot be recovered.
They ask where she went on the way before coming to the hospital.
They tell her to tell them.
She says she went to a hilltop saint.
They ask what she did there.
She says she bowed.
She took his blessing.
They ask what kind of blessing it was.
They ask what he said.
They ask for the whole story.
After hearing it they ask what she left behind when told to leave something.
Cut-off fragment: she said, continued in the next slice.

hindi: जी उन पांच मिनट के अंदर जो मैंने ध्यान लगाया और बाबा जी के चरणों में छोड़ा वो मैंने जिसजिस के प्रति बदले की भावना, क्लेश, क्रोध, आपत्ति, परेशानी, लेनदेन, झगड़े थे सब छोड़ दिए।
says: Remedy as she describes it: in five minutes of meditation she let go of revenge feelings, quarrels, anger, objections, troubles, old dealings and fights towards every person. The release is directed at specific people, one by one. Tradition claim only.
ambiguity: Whether five minutes is a fixed requirement or just how long it took her is not stated.
classical_check: Silent; classical remedies centre on mantra, charity and worship, not on releasing grudges as a cure.

hindi: माफ कर डाला और छोड़ा मुक्त करो मुझे।
says: Remedy: forgive each person and ask to be set free in return. Forgiveness plus a request for one's own release completes the surrender. Recorded as his tradition claim, without any promise of cure.
ambiguity: It is not clear if the plea 'free me' is addressed to the saint, to God or to the people forgiven.

gist: Rhetorical question: what is there to keep in these things.
She says she left all that at the saint's feet.
The doctors say she left a lot of negative energy there.
They say her body then began to heal.

hindi: आपको अपने जीवन में मरे हुए धन, मरे हुए तन, परेशान रिश्तों से अगर मुक्ति चाहिए, अपने मन के अंदर पड़े हुए यमराज को निकाल लो।
says: If you want freedom from dead (stuck) money, a dead (ailing) body and troubled relationships, take out the Yamraj lying inside your own mind. Here Yamraj (Pluto) is turned into an inner burden whose removal is the remedy for money, health and relationship blockages.
cells_derived_method: The three areas map to houses: money to the 2nd and 11th, body to the 1st and 6th, relationships to the 7th. Pluto's house would show which blockage dominates.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: stuck money is the main theme and the inner Yamraj is attachment to possessions.
derived, not said by him: strained partnerships hold the main burden, with old grudges at the centre.
derived, not said by him: ongoing bodily troubles tied to worry and over-analysis.

ambiguity: 'Dead body' could mean a chronically unwell body, not a corpse. He does not tie it to a chart placement.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; classical remedy for blocked wealth and relationships is mantra and worship of the lord of the afflicted house.

hindi: अगर आपने मन के अंदर पड़े हुए क्लेश विकार निकाल दिए, बॉडी तो करती है यूं हील।
says: If you remove the afflictions and distortions lying in the mind, the body heals itself quickly, he says with a snap of the fingers. This is his belief only; no cure or timeline is promised.
ambiguity: 'Heal' is not defined, and whether it covers every illness is not said.
classical_check: Silent; classical medical astrology never claims mental release heals the body.

gist: Garbled line, possibly 'because Munna's word the body has to obey'; meaning cannot be recovered.

hindi: बॉडी तो शरीर तो मन से चल रहा है।
says: The body is driven by the mind. He states the mind-over-body basis for his remedy, so the mental state is what governs how the body runs.
ambiguity: Garbled opening words; the sense that mind runs the body is clear.
classical_check: Classically the mind is the Moon and the body the lagna, so a mind-to-body link is a general theme, though not a stated rule.

gist: Rhetorical question: what you ate, drank or what treatment you took.
Says there is no 'dealing' in it; the sense is that diet and treatment do not matter here.
Doctors give the best treatment and then watch for 72 hours.
Says 72 hours is the time of a planet whose name is garbled in the caption ('Chhenu').
Doctors check whether the garbled planet has come.
Says the garbled-name planet is a god of destruction; which of his 12 planets this is cannot be known.
Says it kills straight away; subject is the garbled planet name.
Repeats whether the garbled-name planet has come.

hindi: उसके पश्चात वो कहते हैं प्लूटो उस पे छोड़ दो।
says: After the 72-hour watch is over, the doctors effectively say to leave the patient to Pluto. He treats the period after the critical window as Pluto's handover. This is a loose illustration, not a rule.
ambiguity: The preceding planet name is garbled, so the sequence from that planet to Pluto cannot be confirmed.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text gives a 72-hour window.

gist: Rhetorical question: leave what on it.
Cut-off fragment: the word Sun, continued in the next slice.

hindi: पर छोड़ दो।
says: Continuing from the cut-off word 'Sun' in the last slice: the patient or the case should be left to the Sun instead of to Pluto. The Sun, as life energy, is the planet he hands the matter to once the doctors' checking window is over.
ambiguity: The subject word 'Sun' sits at the end of the previous slice; the reading joins the two.
classical_check: The Sun as giver of vitality (prana) agrees with classical karakatva; handing a critical case to the Sun is his own framing.

hindi: सूर्य प्रकाश अगर यहां दे देगा तो मौत कभी आएगी?
says: If the Sun gives its light (energy) to the person, death will not come: the Sun's active supply of vitality blocks the arrival of death. It is a general claim, with no person or date implied.
cells_derived_method: A strong, well-placed Sun in the 1st, 5th or 9th (trines) would give most vitality, while a Sun in the 6th, 8th or 12th would give less.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Sun exalted on the ascendant, the strongest vitality case.
derived, not said by him: Sun in own sign but in the 8th, vitality present with recurring crises.
derived, not said by him: Sun debilitated in the 12th, vitality drains and recovers slowly.

ambiguity: A rhetorical question; read as a strong 'no, death will not come'.
classical_check: Sun as pranakaraka (life force) is classical; an absolute 'death never comes' is not.

hindi: सूर्य है जीवन ऊर्जा।
says: Definition: the Sun is the life energy itself. In his scheme it is the giver of vitality rather than only the king or soul-planet.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is atmakaraka and the karaka of prana and vitality.

gist: Rhetorical question: what is death.

hindi: जीवन ऊर्जा गई।
says: Death is defined as the departure of life energy, which is the Sun's province. So the Sun's loss, not Pluto's action, is what 'death' means in the body, and Pluto only follows it.
ambiguity: Whether this is only a definition or also a rule about the Sun's affliction is unclear.
classical_check: Silent as a definition; classical texts link death to the 8th house and Saturn as ayushkaraka.

hindi: ये डेविल बॉडी है।
says: He labels one kind of body as 'devil body' (the body run by Pluto/Yama), set against the 'spirit body' in the next line. The caption may mean 'divine body', so it is read as a two-body contrast with low certainty.
ambiguity: The word is 'devil' in the caption, but 'divine' (Sun's body) would fit the context of the next lines; both readings remain open.
classical_check: Silent; this two-body idea is not classical.

hindi: ये स्पिरिट बॉडी है।
says: The Sun's life energy corresponds to the spirit body, the part that decides whether the person survives. It is set against the physical body, which Pluto can damage.
ambiguity: The pronoun 'this' may refer to the Sun's energy or to what stays alive when Pluto acts; the first reading is used.
classical_check: Silent on a 'spirit body'; the nearest classical idea is the Sun as atman.

gist: Sets up an example: a terrible accident has happened.

hindi: सूर्य प्रोटेक्ट कर रहा है अगर तो भाई गाड़ी बंदे की तबाह हो गई।
says: If the Sun is protecting the person, he survives a terrible accident even though his car is wrecked. The Sun shields life when the vehicle is destroyed. This is an illustration, not a prediction for any person.
cells_derived_method: Protection would be strongest with the Sun in a trine (1, 5, 9) or kendra and weakest with the Sun in 6, 8, 12 or in debilitation. The sign sets its strength.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Sun in a friendly sign in the 9th, protection through luck and blessings.
derived, not said by him: Sun in a kendra but in a Moon sign, protection is real, though at home/vehicle level it may be uneven.
derived, not said by him: Sun debilitated in the 12th, a weak protector.

ambiguity: 'Protect' is not tied to a specific chart state like strength or transit.
classical_check: Classical rules on survival of accidents use the 8th lord and Saturn/Mars; this Sun-only protection is his claim.

gist: People wonder how the man could survive.
People are astonished.
Opposite example: people say the car has no damage.

hindi: बंदा डैमेज प्लूटो ऑन डेविल बॉडी
says: When the car is untouched but the person is badly damaged, he reads it as Pluto being switched on, working on the 'devil' (physical) body. Pluto's activation is shown as harm to the person while the surroundings are spared.
ambiguity: The caption runs the clause together and the 'devil body' wording is uncertain.

hindi: अगर आपका यमराज आपके साथ ऑन है तो आपकी बॉडी डिटेरेट कर रही है।
says: If your Yamraj (Pluto) is switched on with you, your body is deteriorating. Pluto active is tied to physical decline. It is his belief, with no diagnosis and no timeline for any individual.
cells_derived_method: Where Pluto sits would show which part of life suffers deterioration first: 1st (body), 6th (routine illness), 8th (chronic crisis).

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Pluto on the ascendant, body and vitality are strongly affected.
derived, not said by him: gradual wear in the digestive or routine health area.
derived, not said by him: slow chronic depletion linked to long-term strain.

ambiguity: 'On' could mean a dasha period, a transit or the person's own attitude (see the later line that you decide to switch Pluto on).
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; the classical view ties decline in health to the 6th/8th lords and the lagna lord.

hindi: आपका पैसा लूट रहा है।
says: With Pluto switched on, your money is being looted, drained away. Pluto's active phase is tied to financial loss as well as bodily decline. It is a general karaka claim, not a financial forecast.
cells_derived_method: Pluto in the 2nd or 11th would hit savings and gains directly; in the 8th it would show as sudden drains, taxes, others' money; in the 12th as expenses and losses.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: stored wealth is slowly drained.
derived, not said by him: gains and networks give less than they cost.
derived, not said by him: leakage through expenses, escapes or hidden losses.

ambiguity: The subject 'looting' is the Pluto pun in the next line.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; classically wealth loss is from the 12th/8th and the 2nd/11th lords being afflicted.

gist: Wordplay on 'P-loot-o' meaning Pluto loots slowly.
Repeats that you are being looted.

hindi: बहुत शन शय लाइफ ग्रो करने के बजाय सूर्य की ओर जाने के बजाय एक मकान से दो मकान बने बल्कि जो एक मकान था वो भी आधा रह गया।
says: Instead of growing toward the Sun, with one house becoming two, life under active Pluto shrinks, and even the one house you had is reduced to half. Sun-direction means growth; Pluto-direction means contraction.
ambiguity: The first two words are garbled, so only the growth-versus-shrinkage contrast is certain.
classical_check: Silent; the growth-or-shrinkage contrast is his own and has no classical rule.

hindi: यह आप डिसाइड करते हैं कि आपने प्लूटो ऑन किया कि नहीं।
says: Whether Pluto is switched on is the person's own decision: free will, not fate, decides whether Pluto's destructive side is activated. It sets up his remedy approach of choosing the Sun or Pluto direction.
ambiguity: It is not stated how a person 'switches on' Pluto, whether by attitude or behaviour.
classical_check: Classical astrology allows some free will through remedies and conduct, but has no Pluto switch.

hindi: कुंडली के अंदर पड़ा हुआ प्लूटो क्या करता यह बात से पहले यह जानना इसलिए आवश्यक है क्योंकि हम सबके पास 12% फिक्स भाग्य
says: Before explaining what the natal Pluto does, he gives a fate budget: each person has about 12 percent fixed destiny. It is the first number of a split of fate against free will, continued in the next lines.
ambiguity: The numbers are caption-transcribed and the split totals do not add up cleanly across the next lines (12, 72, 6, 4).
classical_check: Silent; classical texts have no percentage split of destiny.

gist: Cut-off fragment: '72%', completed in the next slice as changeable fate.

hindi: चेंजबल जिसको मुन्ना पकड़ लेता है जो शरीर है
says: The changeable part of fate, said to be about 72 percent, is the part 'Munna' grabs, which is the body. Munna seems to be his nickname for the ordinary mind or ego. The changeable share is therefore tied to the body and the grasping mind.
ambiguity: Munna is a nickname used without a clear definition, and the 72 figure sits in the previous slice.
classical_check: Silent; the fixed (dridha) and changeable (adridha) karma idea exists, but not in these percentages.

hindi: और 6% ऐसी फ्री विल की कृपा है यदि वो मिल जाती है तो 4% अग्नि जो है वो हमारे शरीर को पुनः ठीक कर देती है
says: About 6 percent is the grace of free will, and if that comes, 4 percent fire (agni) can repair the body again. He sets free will and the fire element as the two things that restore the body.
ambiguity: The percentages are caption-garbled and do not match the other line giving Munna as 12 percent.
classical_check: Silent; Agni as healing power is an Ayurvedic idea, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: याद रखें 4% अग्नि तीन गुना स्पीड से तेज ठीक करती है 6% जो हमारा अल्फा ब्रेन है वो दो गुना स्पीड से और मुन्ना जो है वो एक गुना ही चलता है।
says: He gives healing speeds: the fire part heals three times as fast, the alpha-brain part twice as fast, and ordinary 'Munna' mind only at normal speed. The slower the mind-driven channel, the more it should hand over to the faster ones.
ambiguity: The speeds are his metaphor and not measured; this is not a medical claim.

says: Munna, the ordinary mind, occupies only about 12 percent, even though it is the slowest channel. This conflicts with the earlier use of 12 percent for fixed destiny, so the numbers are not reliable.
ambiguity: 12 percent is used both for fixed destiny and for Munna; one of them is a caption or speaking error.

hindi: यह परिवर्तन तभी संभव है जब आपके अंदर जानकारी हो।
says: The change from the fixed script to a better outcome is possible only when you have the knowledge. Awareness of how the planets work is the precondition for using the changeable part of fate.
ambiguity: 'Jaankari' (information) is not defined as astrological or spiritual knowledge.
classical_check: Classical texts also say remedies work for those who know and follow them; no conflict.

gist: Filler words: all right, it is like this.
Lead-in: everybody has planets, the listeners, others and himself.

hindi: वैसे ही जैसे ग्रह है वैसी हमारी बुद्धि है।
says: Your intellect is as your planets are: the natal planets set the quality of your understanding. Mind and judgement are a product of the chart.
cells_derived_method: Intellect would be read from Mercury and Jupiter and from the 5th house; Moon for the mind. Their sign and house change the quality of thinking.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Saturn-ruled 5th gives cautious, structured thinking.
derived, not said by him: Jupiter-ruled 5th gives broad, optimistic thinking.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the 5th house, Mercury, Jupiter and the Moon govern buddhi.

hindi: उससे ऊपर आगे हम नहीं सोच सकते।
says: We cannot think beyond what our planets allow: the chart sets a ceiling on thought. A person can only reach beyond it with outside input.
classical_check: Silent; a strong deterministic claim, not found in the classical texts.

hindi: लेकिन जैसे ही किसी दूसरे ने आपको कुछ बताया तो वो ज्ञान आपको दूसरे से लोन में मिला है।
says: Knowledge you get from another person is a loan from him, not your own, so your own chart limit is bypassed by borrowing. The borrowed knowledge then carries the lender's planetary quality.

hindi: तो आपके कुंडली के ग्रह किसी के भी यह अलव करते हैं कि किसी दूसरे के द्वारा राय लेके आप आबाद या बर्बाद हो सकते हैं।
says: Your own planets permit that, by taking someone else's advice, you may be made or ruined. The chart decides whether you can be affected by outside counsel for better or worse.
cells_derived_method: Receptivity to advice would be read from the 3rd and 11th (communication, friends) and the 9th (guru, mentors), plus Mercury and Jupiter.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Jupiter-ruled 9th, advice from teachers tends to build up.
derived, not said by him: Mercury-ruled 11th, advice from friends and networks is plentiful and mixed.

ambiguity: The caption word 'अलव' is probably 'allow'.

hindi: आबाद या बर्बाद होना यह भी आपके प्लनेट्स के ऊपर कृपा से होगा।
says: Whether you are made or ruined by advice depends on the grace of your planets: the final outcome is again set by the chart, not by the adviser alone.

hindi: हो सकता है आपको बर्बाद करने वाली राय मिल जाए।
says: It may be that the advice you meet is the kind that ruins you. This is the bad-luck branch of receiving counsel.

gist: Cut-off fragment: the word 'it may be', completed in the next slice.

hindi: सकता है आबाद करने वाली।
says: Or the advice may be the kind that builds you up. This is the good-luck branch of receiving counsel, paired with the previous ruin branch.
ambiguity: The first word 'may be' sits in the previous slice.

gist: Rhetorical question: how will that happen.

hindi: वो तब होगा अगर आप सूर्य के नजदीक हैं या आप प्लूटो के पास है।
says: Whether advice builds or ruins you depends on your closeness to the Sun or to Pluto. Near the Sun it builds you; near Pluto it tends to ruin. 'Near' is left unexplained, whether in the chart or in conduct.
cells_derived_method: Nearness can be tested in the chart as the person's strongest planet or as a conjunction/aspect on the lagna or the Moon. The house sets the life area where advice matters.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Sun on the ascendant in own sign, advice received tends to strengthen the person.
derived, not said by him: Pluto-like intensity in the career house, advice from authority can break or make.

ambiguity: It is unclear whether 'near' is placement, conjunction, dasha or a way of living. It is also unclear which of the two is the good one, though the Sun side is read as good.

hindi: अगर यह भी ज्ञान नहीं तो क्या आपके पास बृहस्पति है?
says: If you do not have even that knowledge, the next question is whether you have Jupiter, the guru planet, supporting you. Jupiter is the fallback source of guidance when you cannot judge advice yourself.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's support would show in the 9th, 5th and 1st houses and by sign: own or exalted signs give a strong guide.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Jupiter in own sign in the 9th, a dependable guru or guide.
derived, not said by him: Jupiter exalted in the 5th, wisdom and good advice come easily.
derived, not said by him: Jupiter debilitated in the 6th, guidance is thin or conflicts with duties.

ambiguity: A question, not a flat statement; read as a test of whether Jupiter is strong.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the karaka of gurus, teachers and counsel.

gist: Restates that Jupiter is guru.

hindi: एक फोटो लगा लो ऐसे किसी गुरु महाराज की।
says: Remedy: if you lack the guidance, put up a photo of a guru of that kind. A guru's image is a simple substitute for the Jupiter connection.
ambiguity: It is unclear which guru, or whether the photo is only for those with a weak Jupiter.
classical_check: Classical Jupiter remedies include honouring teachers, but not photo placement as a rule.

hindi: अगर आपकी कुंडली के नौवें भाव में बृहस्पति यानी 10 और 11 नंबर राशि नहीं है ना नववांश में और ना ही लग्न में तो आपको गुरु की पूजा चाहिए।
says: If the signs 10 and 11 (Capricorn, Aquarius) are not in your 9th house, neither in the main chart nor the navamsa nor the lagna chart, then you need guru worship. In other words, a 9th house free of the Saturn signs suits Jupiter worship.
cells_derived_method: The 9th house in any lagna carries one major sign and a minor sign. If neither is Capricorn or Aquarius, guru worship is advised. If one is, the next lines say to skip it. The 9th house sign for each lagna is different.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: ninth sign is Jupiter's own, so guru worship is advised.
derived, not said by him: Jupiter-owned sign in the 9th, guru worship is advised.
derived, not said by him: Saturn sign on the 9th, so by his next lines guru worship is not advised.

ambiguity: The caption is garbled ('Jupiter i.e. 10 and 11 number sign'). The reading used is that 9th-house signs 10 and 11 are the exclusion test, based on the repeat in the next slice. The 'lagna' may mean the lagna chart, not the ascendant.
classical_check: Silent; the Saturn-sign exclusion for guru worship is not a classical rule.

gist: Restates that guru's grace is needed.

hindi: गुरुद्वारे से ही आपका आशीर्वाद और कृपा मिलेगी।
says: Your blessing and grace will come from the guru's door (gurudwara or the guru's place) itself, in the case where the 9th house is free of the Saturn signs. The guru's door is the channel for Jupiter's grace.
ambiguity: 'Gurudwara' may mean a Sikh gurudwara or any guru's seat; it is used generally here.
classical_check: Silent; visiting a guru's seat as a Jupiter remedy is traditional but not a textual rule.

hindi: अगर यह है तो गुरुद्वारे जाना भी आपको नुकसानदायक है।
says: If the 9th house does hold the Saturn signs (10 and 11), then even going to the gurudwara harms you. For that placement the guru route backfires.
cells_derived_method: Saturn-sign 9th house means a lagna where Capricorn or Aquarius sits on the 9th, so the 9th house is Saturn-ruled and Jupiter has little say.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Jupiter is debilitated here, which agrees with his caution.
derived, not said by him: Saturn's other sign on the 9th, guru-style worship is not recommended by his rule.

ambiguity: 'This' refers to the 9th-house Saturn signs in the previous sentence; the caption is garbled.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not forbid guru visits for Saturn-ruled 9th houses.

hindi: गुरु के चरणों में छोड़ना भी बेकार है।
says: In the Saturn-sign 9th-house case, leaving your burdens at a guru's feet is also useless. The surrender remedy from the story does not apply to those charts.
ambiguity: The condition is carried from the previous sentence.

hindi: फिर तो बिना गुरु के ही चलो।
says: Then go ahead without a guru. For the Saturn-sign 9th house he advises proceeding with no guru figure at all.
ambiguity: Carries the condition from the two lines above.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not tell anyone to go without a guru.

hindi: एक ही कंडीशन में क्योंकि वह गुरु विध्वंस कर देगा।
says: The guru route is acceptable in only one condition, because that guru will destroy you; he is describing Jupiter's destructive teaching mode in those charts. The sentence is clipped, so the exact condition is not clear.
ambiguity: The 'one condition' is not named in this sentence; it seems to be the Saturn-sign 9th case in which the guru's harshness is dangerous.

hindi: गुरु आपकी लाइफ को बेटर करने के लिए आपको मुक्त कर देगा।
says: To improve your life, the guru (Jupiter) will free you, meaning strip away what you are attached to. Jupiter's liberating action is cutting things off, which feels like destruction.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's house shows what is stripped: 2nd (money), 7th (relationship), 10th (status).

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Jupiter in own sign in the 2nd, wealth or family ties are pruned.
derived, not said by him: Jupiter debilitated in the 7th, a relationship is forcibly ended to teach.
derived, not said by him: status is cut back so a better course can begin.

classical_check: Silent; Jupiter is usually a benefic that expands, so freeing by destruction is his emphasis.

gist: Mimics the guru's voice: finished, gone, get lost, be ruined.
Mimics the guru saying he must beat you for your education.
Says the guru is a very strange thing.

hindi: यह आपको शिक्षित करने के लिए पीटता भी है।
says: Jupiter beats you in order to educate you: harsh events are a teaching method. The guru energy teaches through hardship as well as through kindness.
ambiguity: 'Beats' is used both literally and as hardship.
classical_check: Silent; classical Jupiter is gentler, so this is his own emphasis.

hindi: बड़ा क्रूर होता है।
says: Jupiter as guru is very cruel. He sets his harshness against the usual image of a mild benefic.
ambiguity: Caption has no explicit subject, taken to be the guru of the previous line.
classical_check: Differs from the classical view of Jupiter as a gentle benefic.

hindi: शुक्र बहुत मजेदार गुरु है।
says: Venus is a very fun guru: it teaches by pleasure rather than punishment. He contrasts the two teachers, Jupiter by hardship and Venus by enjoyment.
cells_derived_method: Venus teaches through the area of its house: 7th (romance), 4th (comforts), 2nd (food, family pleasures). The sign sets its taste.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: lessons arrive through relationships and partnership delights.
derived, not said by him: lessons arrive through comfort and home luxuries.

classical_check: Agrees in part: Venus is shukracharya, the guru of the demons in myth, a teacher of pleasures.

hindi: वो कहता है पार्टी कर और सीख।
says: Venus's teaching style is to party and learn: the lesson comes through enjoyment, and the cost shows later. It is the lighter counterpart to Jupiter's learn-by-suffering style.

gist: Jokes that the rope is tied to your leg, as if Venus's pleasure binds you.
Now learn, said as the punchline.

hindi: गुरु कहता है पिट और सीख।
says: Jupiter's teaching style is to take a beating and learn. Lessons come through pain and discipline, which is the other half of the Venus contrast.

hindi: गुरु कड़वा जो आपको बहुत कड़वाहट देता है तब गोविंद मिलता है।
says: A bitter guru who gives you great bitterness is the one through whom God is found. He quotes the known idea that God (Govind) is met through the guru, and ties it to hardship from Jupiter.
classical_check: Silent on charts; the guru-Govind idea is a devotional tradition.

hindi: तो वह कड़वाहट गुरु के द्वारा भी ना मिले इसके लिए आपके नौवें घर के अंदर मकर और कुंभ राशि 10 और 11 नंबर है तो वह मत करो।
says: So that you do not get the bitterness from the guru as well, if your 9th house holds Capricorn and Aquarius (signs 10 and 11), do not do the guru route. The Saturn-sign 9th house means avoid guru worship and guru surrender. He says houses carry both signs, so both count.
cells_derived_method: For lagnas where the 9th falls in Capricorn or Aquarius the rule is active. For the other 9th-house signs the guru route is open. Mixed houses touched by one Saturn sign and one other sign would apply it partly.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Jupiter debilitated here, so the guru route is avoided by his rule.
derived, not said by him: Saturn's air sign on the 9th, guru route avoided.
derived, not said by him: not a Saturn sign, so the guru route stays open.

ambiguity: 'Vah mat karo' (do not do that) points back to the guru worship of the earlier lines; the exact action is not named again.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not bar guru worship for a Saturn-sign 9th house.

gist: Says there are other ways besides that.

hindi: उसमें मंगल आपकी मदद करता है।
says: In that Saturn-sign 9th-house case, Mars helps you. Mars is named as the planet to rely on in place of Jupiter. He gives no further procedure.
cells_derived_method: Mars's help would depend on its own house and sign: Mars in Capricorn is exalted, so a Mars there gives stronger help than Mars in Cancer, where it is debilitated.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Mars exalted in the 10th, strong help through work and action.
derived, not said by him: Mars debilitated in the 4th, help is weak and needs support.
derived, not said by him: Mars in own sign in the 3rd, help through effort and courage.

ambiguity: 'In that' refers to the preceding Saturn-sign 9th case; what 'help' means is not described.

hindi: इसलिए आपके प्लूटो की सुरक्षा बहुत जरूरी है।
says: Protecting your Pluto is very important, so that Yama's side does not run amok in your life. The upcoming foot-care steps are the way he protects it.
ambiguity: 'Suraksha' is not defined; it seems to mean keeping Pluto from becoming harmful.
classical_check: Silent; Pluto is outside the classical set.

hindi: अपने ही पैर छुओ।
says: Remedy: touch your own feet. This is the first of his foot-based practices for protecting Pluto.
ambiguity: It is not stated how often.
classical_check: Silent; not in classical remedy lists.

hindi: अपने ही पैर दबाओ।
says: Remedy: press or massage your own feet. This is the second foot practice and adds care of the soles to the bowing.
ambiguity: No duration is given.

gist: Asks someone from the audience to bend down.
Checks the audience's backs: bend, my hands do not touch my feet.

hindi: एक्सरसाइज करो आपके हाथ पैर पर टच होने चाहिए
says: Remedy: do exercise until your hands can touch your feet, in other words, keep the back and hips supple enough to bend. Bending to the feet is treated as a fitness test as well as a protection for Pluto.
ambiguity: This is physical exercise advice, not a medical prescription, and no planet is named.

hindi: इसीलिए पैर दबाना बड़ों का बहुत आवश्यक
says: Pressing the feet of elders is very necessary, he says, because of the same bending and foot-care logic. Serving elders' feet is another route for protecting Pluto.
ambiguity: Caption has no clear end of sentence.
classical_check: Matches the common tradition of serving elders; there is no classical link to Pluto.

hindi: आपके पैर में खुकी नहीं होनी चाहिए
says: Remedy: your feet should not be dry; he says there should be no dryness or cracking. The caption word 'खुकी' is read as 'dryness'.
ambiguity: 'खुकी' is probably 'khushki' (dryness); this is the best reading.

hindi: वैसलीन सबसे बढ़िया
says: Vaseline (petroleum jelly) is the best thing to use for the feet. The practical remedy for keeping feet moist is a cheap petroleum product.
ambiguity: No hint about how often to apply.
classical_check: Silent; petroleum products are not in classical remedy lists, though Saturn is the classical karaka of oil.

gist: Describes petroleum jelly as a bottled petroleum product; the caption is garbled.

hindi: और यह सारा का सारा शनि है
says: All of petroleum and its products belong to Saturn. This is a karaka claim: oil, tar and petroleum jelly are Saturn things, so using them stays in harmony with Saturn.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: oils, tar and black materials are classical Saturn significations.

hindi: शनि इसका भाई है
says: Saturn is Pluto's brother. In his scheme, Pluto is Yamraj, so Saturn is Yama's brother, which links the two planets in one family.
ambiguity: 'Iska' (its) points back to Pluto/Yama by context.
classical_check: In myth Shani and Yama are brothers, sons of Surya; this agrees with the story, though Pluto is not classical.

hindi: और शनि 10 और 11 नंबर राशि
says: Saturn owns signs number 10 and 11, which are Capricorn and Aquarius. This confirms the Aries=1 to Pisces=12 sign numbering used by him.
ambiguity: He says Aquarius may also be Pluto's in his scheme, but here he gives it to Saturn.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn rules Capricorn and Aquarius.

hindi: जितना आप पैर को लुब्रिकेटेड रखोगे उतना चंद्र तत्व ठीक होगा
says: The more you keep the feet lubricated, the better the Moon element will be. He makes the feet a handle for the Moon (water, mind) and says foot moisture improves it.
ambiguity: 'Chandra tattva' means the water and Moon principle; no medical effect is claimed.
classical_check: Silent; classically the feet belong to Pisces (12th house) and the Moon to water, but that link is not drawn like this.

hindi: यह साइंस प्रूव कर चुका है कि प्लूटो के अंदर छुपा हुआ ओशन है।
says: Science has already shown that a hidden ocean lies inside Pluto. He uses this as the factual base for linking Pluto with water and with the Moon.
ambiguity: Whether the ocean is proven or only suggested by data is not for him to state; the claim is about the planet, not the chart.
classical_check: Silent; this is an astronomical claim, which is supported only as a likely inference by planetary scientists.

gist: Cut-off fragment: inside Pluto's surface if it is ... completed in the next slice.

hindi: काटा जाए तो उसके अंदर पानी पड़ा प्रचुर मात्रा में।
says: If Pluto were cut open, plenty of water would be found inside it. This completes the previous sentence and strengthens his water link: Pluto holds water in its core.
ambiguity: The start of the sentence, 'inside the surface of Pluto, if it ...', is in the previous slice.
classical_check: Silent; astronomical claim, not a chart rule.

hindi: यानी प्लूटो चंद्रमा को दाब देता है।
says: So Pluto presses down on the Moon. Because Pluto holds water, it overpowers the Moon (water, mind), and therefore the body's fluids and mind need protection from Pluto.
cells_derived_method: The Moon is pressed most when Pluto conjuncts or aspects it. The house shows the area where the pressure lands: 4th (peace of mind, home), 8th (emotional crises), 12th (sleep, release). The sign changes the Moon's strength.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Moon in own sign in the 4th resists the pressure but feels it at home.
derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in the 8th, the pressure is heaviest and emotional crises are deep.
derived, not said by him: Moon exalted in the 2nd, the Moon is strong enough to bear the pressure.

ambiguity: 'Daab dena' is read as 'overpower' or 'suppress' by sheer pressure.
classical_check: Silent; Pluto aspecting the Moon has no classical analogue.

gist: Rhetorical question: what is our Moon.

hindi: सारे शरीर का 72% हिस्सा जल तत्व और यही शिव है।
says: About 72 percent of the whole body is the water element, which is the Moon, and this is Shiva. He makes the Moon the water of the body and equates it with Shiva.
ambiguity: 'Yahi' refers to the Moon and its water; the equation with Shiva is his own phrase.
classical_check: Moon as the water element and the mind is classical; Shiva wears the Moon, but a Moon equals Shiva identification is devotional.

hindi: और वही जल अगर बाहर आ जाए तो लुब्रिकेटेड रहता है।
says: If that water comes out to the surface, the body stays lubricated. Healthy surface moisture is the visible sign of a well-working Moon element.
ambiguity: It is not clear if 'comes out' means sweating, oiling or something else.

hindi: इसलिए पैरों की लुब्रिकेशन बहुत जरूरी।
says: Lubrication of the feet is therefore very important. It is his conclusion from the Moon-water and Pluto-pressure argument.

hindi: यह कहा जाता है पैर के तलों में घी लगा के सोओ।
says: Remedy: it is said that you should sleep with ghee applied on the soles of the feet. This is the traditional version of the foot-lubrication practice, done at night.
ambiguity: 'Kaha jaata hai' marks it as a saying; he is quoting tradition.
classical_check: Ayurveda recommends foot oiling (padabhyanga); Jyotish texts are silent.

hindi: पैर के तले में तेल लगाओ।
says: Remedy: apply oil to the soles of the feet. Oil is offered as an alternative to ghee for the same foot-lubrication practice.
ambiguity: The type of oil is not stated.
classical_check: Silent; oil is a Saturn item classically.

hindi: जैसा जिसका सामर्थ्य हो वह है नहीं तो लगता तो वैसलीन लगाओ क्योंकि शनि के साथ इसकी कभी भी अट्टी-शट्टी खराब नहीं होगी।
says: Use ghee or oil as your means allow, and if not, apply Vaseline, because it will never clash with Saturn. Vaseline is the safe budget fallback, since petroleum is Saturn's own material.
ambiguity: The phrase 'अट्टी-शट्टी खराब नहीं होगी' is slang for 'will not fall out / not clash'; the sense is that Vaseline agrees with Saturn.

hindi: शनि चलता है ढाई साल ढैया लेके एक राशि में ढई ढैया इसकी बदनाम है।
says: Saturn stays two and a half years in one sign, which is the dhaiya, and that dhaiya is notorious. He gives Saturn's sign-stay time and says its reputation is bad.
cells_derived_method: Dhaiya in popular usage means Saturn in the 4th or 8th from the Moon sign; he does not specify this here. The affected area follows that house.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Saturn moving through a sign takes about 2.5 years there, here counted as the 4th-house dhaiya touching home and peace.
derived, not said by him: the 8th-house dhaiya touches sudden changes and health themes.

ambiguity: He does not say that dhaiya is 4th or 8th from the Moon; he uses it loosely for any 2.5-year Saturn stay.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn takes about 2.5 years per sign; the dhaiya of the 4th and 8th from the Moon is a popular rule, not a classical one.

hindi: प्लूटो चलता है 20 साल 21 साल और ये इसका भाई है यमराज।
says: Pluto stays about 20 to 21 years in one sign, and this one, Yamraj, is Saturn's brother. He gives Pluto's sign-stay time and ties it to Saturn's.
ambiguity: Real Pluto stays between 12 and 31 years in one sign; 20-21 is an average.
classical_check: Silent; classical Jyotish does not use Pluto.

hindi: तो शनि ही पहले एक समय ऐसा था जब यमलोक का देवता माना जाता था।
says: There was once a time when Saturn himself was regarded as the god of Yamaloka. Saturn held the post of lord of the dead before it passed to Yama.
ambiguity: It is a mythic claim and no source is named.
classical_check: Not a classical text; classically both Saturn (ayuskaraka) and Yama are linked to death.

gist: Says the stories are very beautiful.

hindi: बाद में यमराज को दिया गया कि यार जीने दो यार लंबा चलने दो।
says: Later the role was given to Yamraj with the instruction to let people live and last longer. Yama's appointment is tied to humans getting longer lives.
ambiguity: 'Diya gaya' (was given) has no stated giver; it is a story reference.
classical_check: Silent; not from a classical astrological text.

gist: Says human beings therefore live for a long time.
Says people still live a hundred years.

hindi: हमारी बॉडी डिजाइन है 120 साल मिनिमम जीने के लिए
says: The human body is designed to live a minimum of 120 years. He ties the full lifespan to the length of the Vimshottari cycle that follows.
ambiguity: It is a design claim and not a prediction for any person.
classical_check: Agrees in numbers: Vimshottari totals 120 years; classical texts treat this as the poorna ayu.

gist: Names the Vimshottari dasha again before explaining it.

hindi: विोत्तरी दशा में 120 साल की दशा होती है।
says: The Vimshottari dasha system is a 120-year cycle, the full dasha of all nine planets. It is the base calendar used for timing.
ambiguity: The caption spells 'Vimshottari' wrongly but the meaning is clear.
classical_check: Agrees: Vimshottari has 120 years in total.

hindi: इस 120 साल की दशा के अंतर्गत सबसे ज्यादा लंबी दशा शुक्र की आती है 20 साल की।
says: In this 120-year cycle the longest mahadasha is Venus's, at 20 years. Venus is the biggest block of the cycle.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus has the longest Vimshottari mahadasha, 20 years.

gist: Cut-off fragment: 'right below it', completed in the next slice.

hindi: ठीक नीचे 19 साल का शनि आता है।
says: Right below Venus comes Saturn with a 19-year mahadasha. Saturn is the second-longest dasha in the cycle. The first word 'after it' sits at the end of the previous slice.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn's Vimshottari mahadasha is 19 years, the second longest.

hindi: शनि इतना पावरफुल है क्योंकि शुक्र के बाद इसी की दशा सबसे लंबी है।
says: Saturn is so powerful because, after Venus, its dasha is the longest. He bases Saturn's strength on the length of its period, not on sign or house strength.
ambiguity: Classical Saturn strength is tested by sign, house and Shadbala, not dasha length; he uses the long period as the reason.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not equate power with dasha length.

hindi: बृहस्पति महाराज 16 साल के लिए चलते हैं।
says: Jupiter's mahadasha runs for 16 years. Jupiter comes after Saturn and Rahu in length.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter's Vimshottari period is 16 years.

says: Rahu's mahadasha is 18 years. He lists it between Saturn at 19 and Jupiter at 16.
ambiguity: The sentence is a fragment, joined to the next line in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu's Vimshottari period is 18 years.

hindi: ये इतना पावरफुल है कि शनि के द्वारा इसकी ट्रीटमेंट होती है।
says: This one, probably Pluto's 20-year punishment, is so powerful that its treatment comes through Saturn. Saturn is the handler or moderator of Pluto's heavy effects.
ambiguity: 'Ye' could be Rahu from the line before, but the next sentence speaks of a 20-year sentence that Saturn shortens, which fits Pluto.
classical_check: Silent; not from a classical text.

hindi: यानी कि जो ये 20 साल की सजा है वो दो ढाई साल में निपट जाती है।
says: The 20-year sentence of Pluto is cleared in two to two and a half years when it passes through Saturn's dhaiya. Saturn compresses Pluto's long penalty into one quick period. This is a timing claim from his scheme, with no date for any person.
ambiguity: The mechanism of how Saturn's two years replace Pluto's twenty is not given.
classical_check: Silent; the compression idea is his own.

hindi: इसलिए शनि की ढैया को हमेशा वेलकम करो।
says: Always welcome Saturn's dhaiya, since it is the period in which Pluto's heavy account is cleared quickly. Welcoming it rather than dreading it is the advised attitude.
ambiguity: It is an attitude instruction, not a ritual.
classical_check: Differs from popular dread of the dhaiya; classical texts give hardship during Saturn's transits over the 4th and 8th from the Moon, with remedies.

gist: Says we spend ninety percent of our time making this fuss.
Mimics people wailing that the dhaiya has arrived.
Repeats the wail that the dhaiya has arrived.
Compares it to how Mona made a fuss.
Mimics a complaint that someone did this to me.

hindi: त्याग दो, छोड़ दो, छोड़ दो, फेंक दो।
says: Remedy: renounce it, let go, drop it, throw it away; he tells people to discard the grievances and fear instead of nursing them. This is the general detachment instruction that goes with welcoming the dhaiya.
ambiguity: The object of 'leave it' is the grievance from the earlier story, not named in this sentence.

hindi: यह ढैया ढैया के चक्कर के अंदर आपका मूलाधार खराब होता है
says: In the worry over dhaiya, your Muladhara (root chakra) gets spoiled. Fear of Saturn's period harms the root centre more than the period itself.
ambiguity: Whether the damage comes from fear or from the Saturn period is not explicit, but the next lines say fear.
classical_check: Silent; chakras are not in classical Jyotish.

gist: Twists the slogan: beyond fear there is no victory.
Twists the slogan again: beyond fear is nervousness.

hindi: जो व्यक्ति डर गया उसका मूलाधार वीक हो गया।
says: A person who has become afraid has a weak Muladhara. He ties fear directly to weakness of the root chakra, which the next lines tie to the hips, back and feet. No diagnosis is made for any person.
ambiguity: No planet is named in this sentence, though it follows from Saturn's dhaiya.
classical_check: Silent; the Muladhara-fear link is yogic, not classical Jyotish.

hindi: उसकी हिप बोन टूटती है।
says: For a fearful person he says the hip bone breaks. It is a consequence he links to the weak root chakra. Recorded only as his belief; it is not a medical claim and applies to nobody in particular.
classical_check: Silent; classical medical astrology links the hips and thighs to Sagittarius and the 9th house, but not through fear.

hindi: बाथरूम में जाकर गिरता है।
says: Such a person falls after going into the bathroom: a fall at home is the example event. It is an illustration of the weak root chakra, not a prediction.

hindi: उसकी कमर में दर्द आता है।
says: Back pain comes to the fearful person. He lists back trouble as a result of the weak root chakra. This is not a medical diagnosis.

hindi: उसकी डिस्क लंब एरिया की वीक होती है।
says: The discs of the lumbar area become weak in such a person. This item narrows the back trouble to the lower spine and is a belief, not medical advice.
ambiguity: 'Lumb' is read as lumbar.

hindi: और जो व्यक्ति घबरा गया उसके पैर जाम हो जाते हैं।
says: For a person who has become panicked, the feet get stiff or jammed. Panic is tied to leg and foot trouble, in a second line of his fear-body chain. No diagnosis is implied.
classical_check: Silent; the feet are classically Pisces, the 12th house.

hindi: पैरों के अंदर तकलीफ होती है।
says: There is trouble inside the legs and feet, a general complaint he adds after the stiffness. It is his belief, not a diagnosis.

hindi: पैर के तले खराब हो जाते हैं।
says: The soles of the feet get damaged. This is the specific foot-sole item that explains why he asks for oiling the soles earlier. It is not a medical claim.

hindi: ऐसे एक विशेष रोग होता है नर्व्स का।
says: A particular disease of the nerves follows from this fear chain. He names nerve illness as the next consequence. This is not a diagnosis of any person.
ambiguity: No specific disease is named.
classical_check: Silent; classically nerves relate to Mercury.

hindi: न्यूरो के रोग होते हैं।
says: Neurological diseases occur as part of the same chain. This widens the nerve claim to the neuro field. It is recorded only as his claim.

gist: Defines the word 'neuro' as relating to the brain.

hindi: कि ब्रेन का यहां सप्लाई नहीं हो रहा।
says: The brain's supply is not reaching the feet and legs. He explains the neuro trouble as a failure of the nerve supply from the brain to the lower body. It is an explanation of his, not medical advice.
ambiguity: 'Yahan' (here) probably points at the feet.

hindi: ब्लड हार्ट हार्ट ब्लड को सप्लाई करके नीचे फेंक नहीं पा रहा।
says: The heart cannot send blood down to the lower body after supplying it. The blood circulation to the feet is blocked in his picture. It is a belief and not a medical statement.
ambiguity: The caption repeats words 'heart heart'.
classical_check: Silent; the heart is classically the Sun and the 4th house.

hindi: नेप्च्यून का पंप खराब हो जाता है।
says: Neptune's pump gets spoiled: he assigns the heart-as-pump to Neptune and says it fails under this fear. Neptune is made the planet of the circulatory pump in his scheme. It is his own karaka claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Neptune's house would show where the pump or flow problem is felt: 4th (heart, chest), 6th (illness), 12th (circulation to the feet).

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Neptune in the 4th in a water sign, a strong heart-and-flow theme.
derived, not said by him: the flow theme sits in the feet and extremities.
derived, not said by him: circulation issues appear as chronic ailments needing routine care.

ambiguity: The caption says 'Neptune' (Varuna). Whether the pump means the heart or the lymph system is not specified.
classical_check: Silent; Neptune is not classical, and the heart is classically the Sun.

hindi: यहां एक पंप लगा होता है एंकल पे हमारी।
says: There is a pump fitted at the ankle of our body, in the calf-and-ankle region. He sets up the ankle pump as the bodily system that the planet Neptune is made to rule in the lines that follow.
ambiguity: No planet is named in this sentence; the link to Neptune comes from the previous sentence about Neptune's pump.
classical_check: Silent; classical medical astrology puts the ankles under Aquarius, the 11th house.

hindi: यह पंप हार्ट के पंप की तरह है।
says: The ankle pump works like the heart's pump. By this comparison he makes the lower-leg circulation a second 'heart' that Neptune governs.

hindi: ये खून जो नीचे जा रहा है इसको वापस ऊपर फेंकता है।
says: The ankle pump throws the blood that has gone down back upward. Returning venous blood from the feet is the job he gives to this Neptune pump.

hindi: वेरीकोस वेंस की प्रॉब्लम होती है।
says: The varicose-veins problem results when this pump fails. He links that vein condition to a failing Neptune pump. This is his belief only and is not a diagnosis of anybody.
ambiguity: The sentence does not state the cause on its own; the next sentence gives the condition.
classical_check: Silent; classically the leg veins would be seen through the 11th/12th houses and Saturn.

hindi: जब नेप्च्यून बिगड़ जाता है और प्लूटो उसका साथ नहीं दे रहा।
says: This problem arises when Neptune is spoiled (afflicted) and Pluto is not supporting it. The condition is a Neptune affliction together with Pluto's absence of help. No house or sign test for these is given.
cells_derived_method: A chart test would be Neptune in a dusthana (6, 8, 12) or afflicted by Saturn or Mars, with Pluto not aspecting or joining it. The house of Neptune sets the body area.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Neptune in the 6th in an earth sign with no Pluto contact, chronic circulation complaints.
derived, not said by him: Neptune in the 12th in a water sign, the flow trouble sits in the feet and extremities.
derived, not said by him: Neptune in the 4th in Libra, the heart-and-pump theme is highlighted.

ambiguity: 'Saath nahi de raha' may mean no aspect, a weak Pluto or the wrong period; he does not say.
classical_check: Silent; Neptune and Pluto are not classical.

gist: Starts an astronomy aside: their journey, Pluto and Neptune go round the Sun.
Fragment saying that Pluto is farther from the Sun than Neptune.

hindi: प्लूटो नेप्च्यून की कक्षा में आ जाता है जो एक खगोलीय घटना है।
says: Pluto comes inside Neptune's orbit, which is an astronomical event. He notes that their paths cross, so the two planets share a close orbital relationship.
ambiguity: This is an astronomical fact and not a chart rule.
classical_check: Astronomically correct: Pluto's orbit crosses inside Neptune's. Classical Jyotish does not use either.

hindi: यानी कई बार नेप्च्यून से जितना सूर्य के पास है उससे ज्यादा पास प्लूटो होता है।
says: At times Pluto is closer to the Sun than Neptune is. He states the same orbital crossing in plain terms to support Pluto and Neptune working as a pair.
classical_check: Astronomically correct (Pluto was inside Neptune's orbit from 1979 to 1999).

gist: Garbled line about something recently found in 250 years of literature; its meaning cannot be recovered.
Says Indian tradition has thousands of years of records of sign-to-sign movement.

hindi: लेकिन जो साइंस ने ढूंढा है उसमें वृश्चिक राशि के अंदर प्लूटो सबसे कम समय रहा है।
says: By what astronomy has found, Pluto stayed the shortest time in Scorpio of all the signs. Scorpio is therefore the sign Pluto crosses fastest.
ambiguity: This is true for the tropical zodiac. In Lahiri sidereal terms Pluto's Scorpio stay falls in different years, so the reading depends on which zodiac he means.
classical_check: Silent; Pluto is not classical. For the tropical zodiac the claim is true.

hindi: 20 21 साल रहना चाहिए।
says: Pluto should stay about 20 to 21 years in a sign, as it does on average. This is the usual stay he compares the short Scorpio stay with.
ambiguity: It is an average; real stays vary between about 12 and 31 years.

hindi: 12 साल के लगभग रहा है।
says: In Scorpio Pluto stayed only about 12 years, instead of the 20 to 21 it would normally take. This is the figure that makes Scorpio the fastest sign for Pluto.
ambiguity: Tropical-zodiac figure; the Lahiri sidereal dates differ.

hindi: इतना फास्ट चला है क्योंकि यानी कि ये ऐसे घूमता है टेढ़ामेढ़ा सा गोला नहीं है इसका।
says: It moved so fast because its orbit is not a circle: Pluto's path is distorted, not round. He gives the shape of the orbit as the reason for its changing speed.
classical_check: Astronomically sound: Pluto's orbit is strongly eccentric, so its speed varies.

hindi: अंडाकार है और
says: Its orbit is oval-shaped (elliptical), and he is about to add that the speed varies along it. This is the shape fact that the next slice explains.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off at the slice end.

hindi: अंडाकार में भी ऐसा है कि एक जगह इतना फास्ट लगता है कि 12 साल में वो राशि बदल डाली इसने जो 21 साल में बदलनी चाहिए वो वृश्चिक राशि है।

hindi: आपका चंद्रमा काम आएगा।
says: Your Moon will be of use too. The Moon is the second planet he names for countering Yamraj, ahead of Mars.

hindi: उसका जल तत्व शिव जो है उस आपका हनुमान काम आएगा।
says: The Moon's water element, Shiva, and then your Hanuman will be of use. The caption runs two items together: the Moon's water-and-Shiva side, and Hanuman as the next helper.
ambiguity: The grammar of the line is garbled; the reading is that Moon (as Shiva's water) and Hanuman are both named helpers.

hindi: मंगल मंगल जो है हनुमान जी अहिरावण उसकी ऐसी तैसी पाताल लोक में जाकर करके आ गए थे।
says: Mars is Hanuman, who went to the underworld (Patala) and dealt with Ahiravana. He equates Mars with Hanuman and reads his visit to Patala as Mars's power over the realm of Yama.
classical_check: Mars is classically linked to Hanuman in popular worship, though not in the texts.

hindi: पंचमुखी हनुमान यह वहीं से मशहूर हुए हैं।
says: The five-faced Hanuman became famous from that Patala episode. This links the five-faced form to the underworld victory over Ahiravana.
classical_check: Agrees with the Ramayana tradition; not part of Jyotish texts.

hindi: यहां के जो हमारा कुंडलिनी का जो पुष्प कमल खिलते हैं, पेटल्स हैं, वह 10 हैं।
says: The kundalini lotus at this place, the navel, has ten petals. The chakra at the navel has ten petals, which he will use for the five-faced Hanuman.
ambiguity: 'यहां' points at the navel from later lines.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard tantra count: Manipura has ten petals; it is not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: पांच इदा पे है, पांच पिंगला पे हैं।
says: Five of the petals are on the Ida side and five on the Pingala side. The ten petals split evenly between the two main energy channels.
ambiguity: A yoga-anatomy claim, not found in Jyotish.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; yoga texts give petal counts but not this split.

hindi: ये पांचप के हिसाब से पंचमुखी हनुमान की स्थापना आपकी नाभि पर होती है।
says: By the five-and-five count, the five-faced Hanuman is established on your navel. The navel is the seat of Mars-Hanuman in the body, which links Mars with the navel centre.
ambiguity: The caption word 'पांचप' is garbled for 'five-five'.
classical_check: Silent; classically Mars rules blood and muscle, with the navel and belly more tied to the Sun.

hindi: यही अग्नि चक्र है।
says: This navel centre is the fire chakra. He names the navel centre as the seat of fire in the body.
classical_check: Agrees with the yoga tradition: Manipura is the fire centre.

hindi: यही आपका ब्रह्म है।
says: This same centre is your Brahma, the creative seat. The navel is named as the creator's place, but the sense of 'Brahma' here is not defined.
ambiguity: The caption may be 'Brahma' as in the creator at the navel (Vishnu's navel lotus) or 'Brahman'; unclear.

gist: Garbled line: a celibate (brahmachari) and breath running here; the meaning cannot be recovered.
Rhetorical question: where does the breath come from.
Asks if you have ever taken a breath yourself.
Says no, someone else is breathing for you.

hindi: जब उसका मन करेगा निकल लेगा।
says: When he wishes, he will pull the breath out: the one who breathes you can stop it at his own will. By context 'he' is Yamraj, the master of the breath.
ambiguity: The subject is not named in this sentence; Yamraj is read from the next line.
classical_check: Silent; the Sun and Saturn are the classical life-force and lifespan significators.

hindi: यानी कि उस सांस को निकालने की ताकत के समय यमराज में कि खींच लो।
says: The power to draw out the breath rests with Yamraj, who simply pulls it out at the time. It makes Pluto/Yama the agent that takes the breath at death.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; classically Saturn and the 8th house indicate when the life-breath leaves.

gist: Rhetorical question: where is the soul.
Sound effect of the soul flying off.
Mimics the soul complaining that the body does not even let it breathe.
Mimics the soul saying fine, I will cut away.

hindi: यह चलेगी तब जब हनुमान होंगे।
says: The breath keeps going only when Hanuman is there. Mars-Hanuman is the support that keeps the breath running, so a strong Mars sustains breathing.
cells_derived_method: Mars's strength would show in its sign and house: own or exalted signs in kendras give the most support.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Mars in its own sign on the ascendant, strong life-sustaining heat.
derived, not said by him: Mars exalted in the 4th, strong inner fire and stamina.
derived, not said by him: Mars debilitated in the 8th, a weak sustaining force.

ambiguity: 'Yah' (this) refers to the breath by context.
classical_check: Silent; classical breath and lifespan significators are the Sun and Saturn.

hindi: हनुमान गर्मी गर्म होती है नाभि आपकी।
says: Hanuman is heat, and your navel is warm. Mars-Hanuman is the heat of the body, centred at the navel.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the classical significator of heat and fire.

hindi: पैरों के तलों को घिसते हैं।
says: Remedy: people rub the soles of the feet. Rubbing the soles is linked to warming and to bringing Hanuman's heat into the body.

gist: Rhetorical question: what do they do.
Answers that they warm the soles.

hindi: जहां प्लूटो कुंडली में बैठा और वहां के अगर संकेत में प्रॉब्लम आ रही है उस हिस्से को गर्म कर दो।
says: Where Pluto sits in the chart, if the indication of that place shows a problem, warm that body part. The body part is taken from the house and sign of Pluto, and heat is applied there to quiet it.
cells_derived_method: The body part comes from Pluto's house or sign using the usual body map: 1st head, 4th chest, 9th thighs, 12th feet, and similarly for signs (Aries head, Cancer chest, Sagittarius thighs, Pisces feet).

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Pluto in the 12th in Pisces, warm the feet.
derived, not said by him: Pluto in the 4th in Cancer, warm the chest area.
derived, not said by him: Pluto in the 9th in Sagittarius, warm the thighs and hips.

ambiguity: 'Sanket' (indication) is read as the sign or house signification; he does not give the body map himself. It is a body-care tradition, not a medical instruction.
classical_check: The body map is classical (Kalapurusha); using it for Pluto and applying heat is his own.

hindi: आपका मंगल स्थापना होगी।
says: Remedy: Mars will be established for you, in other words, install or worship Mars. The Mars-based remedy starts with giving Mars a place.
ambiguity: Whether this is an image, a yantra or a mental installation is not stated.
classical_check: Mars remedies are classical in general; this specific set-up is not.

hindi: मंगल के दान होंगे।

ambiguity: The items of charity are given in the next sentence.
classical_check: Agrees in form: Mars donations are classical, usually red items, lentils and jaggery on Tuesdays.

hindi: मीठी चीज दान होगी।
says: Remedy: a sweet item will be donated. Sweets are the particular charity he names for Mars.
ambiguity: No day or quantity is given.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars charity often includes jaggery or sweets.

hindi: हनुमान की कृपा ली जाएगी।
says: Remedy: Hanuman's grace will be sought. Worship of Hanuman is the devotional side of the Mars remedy.
classical_check: Silent in the texts; Hanuman worship for Mars is a popular practice.

hindi: आप लाल रंग का इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं।
says: Remedy: you can use the colour red. Red is the Mars colour used as the wearable or visible form of the remedy.
classical_check: Agrees: red is the classical colour of Mars.

hindi: वहां ऑटोमेटिकली आपका प्लूटो धूमिल हो जाएगा।
says: As a result, your Pluto will automatically become dim there, at that house or body area. The Mars remedy fades Pluto's effect without a separate Pluto remedy.
ambiguity: 'There' refers to the place where Pluto sits in the chart, from the earlier sentence.

gist: Adds that Pluto will cool down.
Lists the situation of court cases and enemies.

Adds quarrels among siblings and spouses; one word is garbled.

hindi: उसमें आपका सूर्य बहुत हेल्प करेगा।
says: In those cases of courts, enemies and family quarrels, your Sun will help a great deal. The Sun is the main planet for disputes and litigation in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's help in disputes depends on its house and sign: 6th (enemies, cases), 3rd (siblings, neighbours), 7th (spouse). Own or exalted signs help most.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Sun in own sign in the 6th, strong help against enemies and in cases.
derived, not said by him: Sun exalted in the 3rd, help in disputes with siblings and neighbours through courage.
derived, not said by him: Sun debilitated in the 7th, little help in spouse disputes.
