hindi: चंद्रमा डिपेंड करता है।
says: The Moon depends: how much the Moon helps varies from case to case. It is not a fixed helper like the Sun.

hindi: राशि के अनुसार हेल्प करेगा।
says: The Moon will help according to its sign. Its sign sets whether it supports you against Pluto's difficulties.
cells_derived_method: Moon's help is greatest in Taurus (exalted) or Cancer (own) and least in Scorpio (debilitated). The house tells where the help is felt.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Moon exalted in the 2nd, strong help with resources and family.
derived, not said by him: Moon in own sign in the 4th, strong help at home and in the mind.
derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in the 8th, weak help; the water goes against Pluto.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the Moon's strength depends on its sign dignity.

hindi: मंगल आपकी मददगार है।
says: Mars is your helper. Among the planets that stand against Pluto, Mars is firmly on your side.

hindi: बुध जो है सम है।
says: Mercury is neutral (sama), neither helper nor enemy in this matter. In his list of helpers against Pluto, Mercury sits in the middle.

classical_check: Silent on Pluto; classical Mercury is neutral to the Moon's side and Mars.

hindi: बुध एक ऐसा ग्रह है यहां गले में स्थापित है।
says: Mercury is a planet that is established in the throat. He gives Mercury the throat as its body seat.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Mercury governs speech, and the throat is linked to Taurus and Mercury's speech.

hindi: बुध जितने ही साइज का है तो इसका परम मित्र है।
says: Because it is about the same size as Mercury, Pluto's closest friend is Mercury. A size match is given as the reason for friendship; it conflicts with the 'neutral' line just before.
ambiguity: The caption does not name the planet 'of Mercury's size'; Pluto is the guess. In fact Pluto is much smaller than Mercury.
classical_check: Differs: the size claim is wrong astronomically, and classical friendship tables do not cover Pluto.

hindi: राहु जो है ऑब्जर्वर है।
says: Rahu is the observer, the watching planet in his scheme. This repeats the observer-effect link from the physics digression.

hindi: राहु यमराज को सेट।
says: Rahu sets Yamraj in order, by arranging or keeping him in line. Rahu as observer is the planet that regulates Pluto's behaviour.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut short after 'set'.

Lead-in fragment: if someone is watching.
Some people report near-death or after-death experiences of going to death.
They say they felt such and such there and then returned.
They came back into the body.
Rhetorical question: how did that happen.

hindi: यमराज ने उनको लगाम पकड़ी और थोड़ी देर के बाद छोड़ दिया।
says: Yamraj held them by the reins and after a short while let them go. This is his account of a near-death return: Pluto catches the person and then releases him.
ambiguity: A general explanation of near-death experiences, not tied to any chart.

gist: Rhetorical question: how did he release them.

hindi: यार कोई कृपा मिली है।
says: Some grace has been received: Yamraj lets go only because grace reached the person from elsewhere. The release is explained as grace, not as Pluto's own choice.

hindi: कुछ मंगल सूर्य बृहस्पति किसी का लफड़ा मिला भाई।
says: Some support from Mars, the Sun or Jupiter, someone's involvement, came to the person. These three planets are named as the sources of grace that make Yamraj let go.
ambiguity: 'Lafda' is slang for an entanglement; the sense is that one of the three planets stepped in.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter and the Sun are classical protectors of life, Mars less so.

gist: Mimics Yamraj saying all right, fine.
Mimics Yamraj saying fine.
Mimics Yamraj saying fine again.
Rhetorical question: how will a very orderly death come about.

hindi: यदि बृहस्पति की राशि में आपका प्लूटो लिंक होगा।
says: A very orderly death comes if your Pluto links with a Jupiter sign (Sagittarius or Pisces). Pluto placed in a Jupiter-ruled sign makes the ending orderly. It is a general karaka claim, not a date or a prediction for any person.
cells_derived_method: Pluto in either Jupiter sign changes with the house: the 9th and 12th are the natural houses of those signs and the 8th is the house of endings.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Pluto in the 9th in Jupiter's own sign, an orderly, dharma-supported end.
derived, not said by him: Pluto in the 12th in Pisces, a quiet, release-type ending.
derived, not said by him: Pluto in the 8th in Sagittarius, endings come with philosophical acceptance.

ambiguity: 'Link' could mean placement, aspect or a lordship tie; the plain reading, placement in the sign, is used. In his scheme Ketu may also rule Pisces.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; classically a Jupiter-aspected 8th house or a benefic 12th gives a peaceful end.

gist: Says we will look at this among the planets sitting in the chart.

hindi: हम लोग ऐसे समय के हैं जहां हम 100 साल जी तो बहुत है तो हमने 100 साल में चार बार ही प्लूटो के बदलना देखना है 20 साल 21 साल तो एक बार में रहता ही है एक राशि में
says: We live at most about 100 years, so we see Pluto change sign only about four times in a lifetime, as it stays 20 to 21 years in one sign. Pluto's sign changes are rare life-cycle markers.
ambiguity: Real stays vary from 12 to 31 years, so the count in a life is four to eight.

hindi: तो हमारे जीवन के अंदर चार पांच बार बदलेगा यानी हमारे जीवन की जो बड़ी-बड़ी साइकिल है 20ों साल यह हुआ 20ों साल वो हुआ वो प्लूटो ने बदला है
says: Pluto changes sign four or five times in our life, and these changes mark the big cycles of life, each of about twenty years. The long phases of a life are Pluto's doing.

hindi: जो 14 साल की कहानी है वो नेप्च्यून के पास है
says: The 14-year stories of life belong to Neptune. Neptune moves through a sign in about 14 years and so governs life phases of that length.

hindi: प्लूटो इतना ढीला ग्रह है कि 250 साल में गोल घूमता है
says: Pluto is so slow a planet that it takes about 250 years to go around the zodiac once. It is the slowest planet of his set.
classical_check: Astronomically close: Pluto's orbit takes about 248 years.

hindi: और चंद्रमा इतना फास्ट ग्रह है कि ढाई दिन में घूम जाता है।

hindi: तो सोच के चलिए आपका मन अगर आपने यू बदल दिया तो आपका प्लूटो कितनी स्पीड से आपको छोड़ेगा।

Rhetorical question: how much farther is Shiva from you.

hindi: तो प्लूटो जहां आपकी कुंडली में गड़बड़ कर रहा है वहां चंद्रमा स्थापित कर दोगे तो फुरफुर फुर फुरफुर आपको निकाल लेगा।

derived, not said by him: Pluto in the 2nd, the Moon remedy is aimed at family wealth and speech.

hindi: इसके लिए साक्षी भाव चाहिए।

hindi: राहु जो प्लनेट है ये ऑब्जरवेशन का प्लनेट है।

says: Saturn is the god of justice. He assigns Saturn the role of judge, so Pluto's stay in Saturn's signs is a justice-delivering period.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is Shani Dev, the judge who gives fruits of karma, and the lord of Dandadhikari.

hindi: आप पिछले 20 साल से देखेंगे दुनिया के अंदर 20 साल से ऐसे ऐसे युद्ध हो रहे हैं जो न्याय के लिए हो रहे हैं।
says: Looking at the last twenty years, the world has seen wars fought for justice. He reads the recent wars as the work of Pluto in Saturn's signs. It is a mundane claim and not a chart rule.
ambiguity: 'Wars for justice' is his interpretation of events and is not tested.

gist: Rhetorical question: who will win.

hindi: जो धर्म से सही चल रहा है।
says: The one who is walking rightly by dharma will win. In the war for justice the winner is whoever follows dharma, and it names righteousness as the deciding factor.
ambiguity: The sentence is the answer to the question of who wins, said as a fragment.

hindi: और जो धर्म से सही चल रहा है वो 11 नंबर में और लाजवाब चलेगा।
says: The person who follows dharma rightly will do even better while Pluto is in sign number 11, Aquarius. The Aquarius phase amplifies the rewards of dharmic living.

gist: Rhetorical question: what is dharma.

hindi: जो आपने धार लिया वही धर्म है।
says: Dharma is whatever you have taken up and hold (dhaaran). It is defined as the principle you personally uphold, not a set of rules from outside.
classical_check: Agrees with the Sanskrit root of dharma (dhri, to hold).

hindi: धर्म ऐसा नहीं है कि हिंदू है, मुस्लिम है, सिख है, ईसाई नहीं।
says: Dharma is not a matter of being Hindu, Muslim, Sikh or Christian. The word means a held principle, not a religious label, so the Pluto reward is not limited by religion.

hindi: आप यदि जायज और नाजायज पर चलेंगे जैसे कृष्ण ने ये बोला जायज है ये।
says: If you follow what is lawful and unlawful, as when Krishna said 'this is lawful', you are following dharma. The test of dharma is the lawful versus the unlawful, with Krishna as the model judge.
ambiguity: The caption leaves the example from the Mahabharata unfinished.

gist: Continues the Krishna quote: this is necessary.
Continues the Krishna quote: go and do it.

hindi: तो आपको जो जेनुइनली जरूरत है जिसके अंतर्गत आप अपनी पहली तो रक्षा कर रहे हैं।
says: What you genuinely need, within which you are first of all protecting yourself, counts as lawful. Self-protection is the first test of a lawful action.

hindi: अधिकार क्षेत्र यमराज एक लड़ाकू देवता है।
says: Within his domain, Yamraj is a fighting deity. Pluto is a warrior god and not only a god of quiet endings, so its support goes to people who fight.
cells_derived_method: Pluto's house would show the arena of the fight: 6th (enemies, courts), 8th (hidden battles), 10th (career fights).

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Pluto in the 6th, wins long legal and workplace battles.
derived, not said by him: Pluto in the 10th, fights for position with great force.
derived, not said by him: Pluto in the 8th, hidden and prolonged fights over control.

ambiguity: 'Adhikar kshetra' (domain) is garbled but clear in sense.
classical_check: Silent; classically Mars is the warrior planet.

hindi: अगर आप अपने आप को मरने दे रहे हैं तो दूसरा मार देगा और आप लड़ रहे हैं तो आप उसे मार के अपनी रक्षा कर रहे हैं।
says: If you let yourself die, the other will kill you, and if you fight, you protect yourself by killing him. Defence by force is treated as proper under Pluto. It is recorded as his statement only and not as advice to harm anyone.
ambiguity: He means self-defence in the dharmic sense; the limits are not stated.

hindi: आपको बहुत जरूरी है कि मार डालो।
says: It is very necessary that you strike the attacker down, in this case of defence. He presses the point of the previous line. It is recorded only as his claim, not as advice.
ambiguity: 'Maar daalo' is figurative here, meaning to overcome the enemy.

gist: Says remedies will be discussed next, and we will see what to do.
Says but understanding comes first.

hindi: आने वाले समय के अंदर यह प्लनेट उन उन लोगों को रॉकेट की तरह उठाएगा जो लोग धर्म से चलेंगे जेन्युइन।
says: In the coming time this planet will lift those who walk by genuine dharma like a rocket. Pluto's Aquarius phase is a rapid rise for the honest and dharmic. It is a general claim, not a prediction for any person.
ambiguity: 'This planet' is Pluto by context.

gist: Cut-off example start: someone doing shady work who is fully loyal like Duryodhana, continued in the next slice.

hindi: है कि यह दो नंबर का कार्य ही ठीक है मेरे लिए उसको उसी में उठाएगा।
says: Even a person doing shady work, fully convinced like Duryodhana that this dishonest work is right for him, will be lifted by Pluto in that very work. Pluto rewards sincerity of conviction even in a doubtful path. It is recorded as his claim and not as an endorsement.
ambiguity: The first half of the example is in the previous slice.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not reward a wrong path.

hindi: अंडर वर्ल्ड का देवता है ये।
says: Pluto is the god of the underworld. He gives Pluto the realm of the underworld, in both the mythic and the criminal sense.
ambiguity: Whether this means the mythic underworld, the criminal underworld or both is not clear.
classical_check: Agrees with Western myth (Pluto is Hades); Jyotish is silent.

hindi: इसीलिए वेपनरी सारी इसके पास है।
says: That is why all weaponry belongs to Pluto. As lord of the underworld and a fighter, Pluto holds the karaka for arms.
classical_check: Differs: classically weapons belong to Mars.

hindi: बहुत बड़ी-बड़ी मिसाइल्स इसके पास है।
says: Very big missiles are with Pluto. The heavy, long-range weapons are put under Pluto, a step above Mars's smaller ones.

hindi: मंगल के पास छोटी मिसाइल है।
says: Mars has the small missiles. Mars handles small-scale arms, and Pluto the large ones.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Mars is the classical karaka of weapons.

hindi: शुक्र के पास यह है बिग बिग बिग बिग मिसाइल्स है।
says: Venus has big, big missiles. The caption says Venus; it may be an error for another planet. He places very large weapons under it.
ambiguity: The planet name is likely garbled; a missile karaka for Venus would be unusual, and it may mean Saturn or Pluto.
classical_check: Differs: Venus is not classically a weapons planet.

hindi: और इसके पास प्लूटोनियम बम है।
says: Pluto has the plutonium bomb. The nuclear bomb is a Pluto thing, on the word-link between plutonium and Pluto.
classical_check: Silent; plutonium is named after the planet Pluto.

hindi: न्यूक्लियर आर्सनल है।
says: Pluto holds the nuclear arsenal. The whole stock of nuclear weapons is under Pluto, so atomic power is a Pluto matter.

hindi: यानी जितनी जायज बात होगी उसके ऊपर आपका काम पूरा करेगा।
says: Pluto will complete your work in proportion to how lawful the matter is. The more just the cause, the more Pluto delivers. The size of its help is set by dharma.

hindi: अगर आप जायज काम चल करने वाले हो जिसमें आप ढीठ भी हो सकते हो।
says: If you are doing lawful work, you may be stubborn in it and still be fine. Obstinacy is tolerated when the work itself is just.
ambiguity: The sentence is incomplete, with its result in the lines that follow.

hindi: अहंकारी क्रोधी हो सकते हो।
says: You may also be egoistic or angry and still not lose Pluto's support, as long as the work is lawful. Pluto's test is the justness of the work and not your temperament.

hindi: आपके पैर ठीक रहेंगे और आप बिल्कुल सही चलोगे।
says: Your feet will stay fine and you will walk quite right. For a person on a lawful path, Pluto keeps the feet healthy, in his foot-as-Pluto symbolism. It is a belief, not a medical claim.

hindi: आप यूं ही मन में कुड़ते रहते हो, दुखते रहते हो आपके पैर मुड़ जाएंगे।
says: If you keep fretting and grieving in your mind for nothing, your feet will twist or curl up. Inner resentment shows in the feet, as a belief of his and not a medical claim.

gist: Lead-in: people whose confidence drops.
Continues: they remain scared and nervous within themselves.

hindi: उनके पैर के पंजे अंदर घुस जाते हैं।
says: The toes of such frightened people curl inward. Low confidence and fear show in the shape of the feet in his symbolism, and it is his observation, not a medical statement.

hindi: आप देखेंगे बूढ़े लोगों को पैर पूरे के पूरे चप्पल में नहीं घुसते।
says: You will see that old people's feet do not go fully into slippers. He uses the elderly as an example of feet that are held back by fear.
ambiguity: It is an observation used as an illustration, not a rule.

hindi: यानी वो हमेशा डरे कूड़े दबे रहते हैं।
says: This means they are always scared, bent and suppressed. The curled feet are read as the sign of a lifelong fearful posture.

hindi: जो बंदास रहता है उसके पैर के और हाथों की उंगली सेट रहती है।
says: A carefree, fearless person has toes and fingers that stay well set. Boldness is shown in straight, open digits.

hindi: उसका बदन में कुब नहीं निकलता।
says: Such a person does not develop a hunch in the back. The fearless have an upright body in his picture. It is a belief and not medical advice.

hindi: यह सब प्लूटो की कृपा है।
says: All of this, the good feet and the upright body, is Pluto's grace. He credits Pluto, not exercise or diet, for the fearless person's fitness.

hindi: अगर इसकी कृपा आप ले रहे हैं तो आपको जायज चलना है।
says: If you want its grace, you must walk the lawful path. The condition for receiving Pluto's grace is lawful conduct.

hindi: धर्मराज धर्म के देवता जो
says: Dharmaraj is the god of dharma. He names Yama by his title Dharmaraj, the lord of righteousness. The sentence runs on into the next slice.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the slice end.
classical_check: Agrees: Yama is called Dharmaraj in the tradition.

hindi: युधिष्ठिर को जन्म देने वाले देवता माने जाते हैं।
says: Dharmaraj is held to be the god who fathered Yudhishthira. Yama is the divine father of the Pandava king, which links him to a dharmic line.
classical_check: Agrees with the Mahabharata: Yudhishthira is born of Dharma (Yama) and Kunti.

gist: Kunti asked Dharmaraj for her very first son.
Only Yudhishthira, son of Dharmaraj, went to heaven with a dog.

hindi: यानी केतु की तो कृपा चाहिए।
says: So Ketu's grace is needed. Because the dog went with the son of Yama, Ketu, the dog planet, is the one whose favour you need to be in Pluto's good books.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; dogs and Ketu are linked classically.

gist: Rhetorical question: and what is Ketu.

hindi: पूंछ।
says: Ketu is the tail. In his reading the headless node stands for the tail of the dragon.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is the tail of the Rahu-Ketu serpent.

hindi: पूंछ वाला जानवर।
says: Ketu stands for animals with tails. He extends the tail symbol to all tailed creatures, which sets up the list of animals to serve.
classical_check: Partly agrees: dogs and some animals are Ketu significations classically.

hindi: गाय पूंछ वाला जानवर है।
says: The cow is a tailed animal, so it comes under Ketu in this scheme. It is the first animal he adds to Ketu's list.
classical_check: Differs: the cow is classically a Venus or Moon significator.

hindi: कुत्ता पूंछ वाला जानवर है।
says: The dog is a tailed animal, so it too is under Ketu. The dog is the central animal of the Yudhishthira story and of Ketu.
classical_check: Agrees: the dog is a standard Ketu signification.

hindi: सारे पंछी जो है पूछ वाले हैं।
says: All birds have tails, so birds are under Ketu in his list. Bird-feeding therefore becomes a Ketu and Pluto service.
classical_check: Differs: birds are mostly Mercury and Jupiter-linked classically, apart from crows and vultures.

hindi: मछली पूछ की है।
says: Fish have tails too, so fish are under Ketu. This is why seafood comes up in his later warning.
ambiguity: The caption says 'poonch ki'; read as 'has a tail'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: aquatic creatures are also Ketu or Moon signs classically.

hindi: इसलिए आप यदि इनकी भी सेवा करते हैं तो आप प्लूटो की सेवा कर रहे हैं।
says: Remedy: if you serve these animals as well, you are serving Pluto. Caring for cows, dogs, birds and fish is a way of worshipping Yamraj, through Ketu.
classical_check: Silent; feeding animals for Ketu is a popular remedy, although the Pluto link is his own.

hindi: तो इनको पालना, पोसना, जीव को प्रेम करना, जीव के साथ चलना।
says: Remedy: rear and feed these creatures, love living beings, and live alongside them. The service to Pluto is a practice of care and affection for animals.

hindi: यदि आपकी कुंडली में केतु नीच है या दृष्टि उसकी खराब है।
says: If Ketu is debilitated in your chart or has a bad aspect. This sets the condition for the seafood warning that follows. The sign of Ketu's debilitation is not given.

classical_check: Partly agrees: classical schools vary; Taurus or Gemini is the usual debilitation for Ketu.

hindi: किसी हालत में भी सी फूड ना खाएं।
says: Remedy or prohibition: in no case should you eat seafood, if the condition above applies. It is a dietary restriction tied to Ketu and is recorded as his tradition claim only.

hindi: तीन नंबर राशि के ऊपर केतु की दृष्टि पांचवी हो, तीसरी हो, द नौवीं हो, सामने बैठा देख रहा हो, चौथी हो, आठवीं हो तो आपको सी फूड नहीं खाना।
says: If Ketu's aspect falls on sign number 3 (Gemini) by a 5th, 3rd, 9th, 4th or 8th aspect, or from opposite by sitting across, you should not eat seafood. Any Ketu aspect on Gemini triggers the ban.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Ketu in Libra aspects Gemini by its 9th aspect, so the seafood rule applies.
derived, not said by him: Ketu in Aquarius aspects Gemini by its 5th aspect, so the rule applies.
derived, not said by him: Ketu in Sagittarius sits opposite Gemini, so the rule applies.

classical_check: Differs: Ketu's aspects are not given in most classical texts, and a Gemini-specific seafood rule is not classical.

hindi: आपका प्लूटो बहुत ज्यादा नाराज होगा और असाध्य रोग दे सकता है।
says: Your Pluto will be very angry and can give an incurable disease if you eat seafood under that condition. It is a warning in his tradition and not a medical diagnosis or prediction.

hindi: अगर केतु ठीक है तो कोई प्रॉब्लम नहीं है।
says: If Ketu is in good condition there is no problem with seafood. The restriction applies only for a weak or badly aspected Ketu.

gist: Cut-off fragment: in eating seafood the cause of death will be your ..., continued in the next slice.

hindi: भोजन नहीं बनेगा।

classical_check: Silent; a dietary rule tied to Ketu is not in the classical texts.

hindi: जिस व्यक्ति के जीवन के अंदर परेशानी आ रही है उसको सबसे पहले भोजन दो।
says: Remedy: to a person who is in trouble, first give food. Feeding comes before any other help when someone is in difficulty.

hindi: क्योंकि परेशानी के टाइम में भूख नहीं लगती।

gist: Rhetorical question: what is food.

hindi: मंगल और शुक्र।
says: Food is Mars and Venus. He gives the two planets as the karakas of cooked food: Mars the fire and heat, Venus the taste and enjoyment.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Venus is a food and taste karaka classically, and Mars is the fire of digestion, though the texts usually give food to the Moon and the 2nd house.

hindi: जैसे ही यह दोनों पेट में जाते हैं, आपका प्लूटो सेट हो जाता है।
says: As soon as these two, the food of Mars and Venus, go into the stomach, your Pluto gets set right. Eating settles Pluto's disturbance.

hindi: भूखे नहीं रहना, नाराज हो गए, खाना नहीं खाएंगे।
says: Do not stay hungry. When you are angry, do not refuse to eat. Skipping food in anger is named as the thing to avoid.
ambiguity: The 'will not eat' is a quote of the angry person.

hindi: यह सबसे प्रथम कार्य होता है।
says: This, eating, is the very first task. He puts feeding ahead of every other remedy for Pluto's trouble.

gist: Mimics a person saying he has no wish to eat because anger has come.
Mimics the same person saying he will die anyway.

hindi: मरने की इच्छा नहीं लानी।
says: Do not bring up a wish to die. Entertaining a death wish is named as something to avoid, as it feeds Pluto's destructive side.

hindi: इसका भजन नहीं करना।
says: Do not chant over it, that is, do not keep reciting or dwelling on the thought of death. Repeating the death thought is like a prayer to Pluto.
ambiguity: 'Iska' (of this) is the death wish by context.

hindi: यह आदत डालें।
says: Make this a habit. The eating-and-no-death-thoughts discipline is to be built up as a permanent routine, not done once.

hindi: आपकी कुंडली के 12 भाव में यह आपका लग्न है।

classical_check: Agrees: the lagna is the first house.

hindi: दो नंबर तीन चार ये राशियां हैं।

hindi: और यह भाव भी हैं।

derived, not said by him: wealth through trade, communication and multiple small incomes.
derived, not said by him: slow, disciplined saving and wealth through structured work.

derived, not said by him: money matters are managed with analysis and service.
derived, not said by him: money matters are intense, hidden or linked to others' resources.

hindi: या सूर्य हो, मंगल हो, बुध हो कोई लेनदेन नहीं।
says: Likewise, whether the Sun, Mars or Mercury is in it makes no difference to the house's subject. The planet in a house changes the quality, not the topic.
cells_derived_method: The planet colours the 2nd house topic: Sun gives pride in wealth, Mars an aggressive earner, Mercury a trader.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Sun in the 2nd in its own sign, status-linked income and pride in family.
derived, not said by him: Mars in the 2nd in its own sign, hard-driving earner with sharp speech.
derived, not said by him: Mercury in the 2nd in Virgo, an analytic earner with precise speech.

hindi: लेकिन यह दो नंबर जो है ये यहां का दूसरा भाव जो है इसके अंदर धन ही देखा जाता है।

hindi: राइट आंख देखी जाती है।

hindi: यह आपका सिर होता है।

hindi: ये राइट कंधा है।

ambiguity: The house is not spoken; the right shoulder and arm fit the 3rd house.

hindi: कान है।

ambiguity: The house is not spoken.

hindi: ये छाती है।
says: This is the chest. He points to the chest box, which is the 4th house.
ambiguity: The house is not spoken.

hindi: ये दाया घुटना है आपका।

hindi: ये छठा जो है ये ये दाया वाला पैर है।

hindi: ये पेट है।

hindi: गुप्त स्थान है।

classical_check: Agrees: the genitals belong to the 8th house and Scorpio.

hindi: ये लेफ्ट एरिया है बॉडी का।

hindi: तीसरा वाला जो है भाई, बहन, चाचा, ताऊ नाते रिश्तेदारों के लिंक में रिश्तेदार ये हो गए।

hindi: आपका गला कैसा सेंसिटिव रहता है?

hindi: आपकी नाक की हड्डी शनि की यहां दृष्टि हो तो नाक की हड्डी टेढ़ी होती है बंदे की।

hindi: हर हालत में उसके तिल होता है गर्दन के पीछे।

hindi: चौथा घर है यहां पर आपके एक्सीडेंट्स, दुर्घटना, मित्रता, पार्टनरशिप, व्यापार करने में कितना धन आया गया?
says: The fourth house shows your accidents, mishaps, friendship, partnership and how much money came and went in trade. He puts accidents and partnership matters in the 4th house, which differs from the usual map.

hindi: मां की सेहत,
says: The mother's health is also read from here, the 4th. The mother is a fourth-house topic as in the standard teaching.
ambiguity: The house is implied by the sequence.

hindi: पांचवा आपकी संतान, इंट्यूशन की पावर, पूर्व जन्म के संस्कार क्या है?
says: The fifth house shows your children, the power of your intuition and the impressions carried from your past birth. Children, intuition and past-life samskaras all go to the 5th.

hindi: छठे शत्रु हैं आपके।

derived, not said by him: polished opponents who work through law or agreements.

says: Pluto also suppresses enemies. Defeating foes is a Pluto function in his scheme, which links Pluto with the 6th house.

hindi: प्लूटो को मृत्यु के स्थान में स्थापित करना बहुत बढ़िया है।

gist: Repeats that Pluto is the lord of this place.
Rhetorical question: what is Pluto.

hindi: विध्वंसकारी।
says: Pluto is a destroyer, the planet of demolition. He defines the planet by its destructive nature before listing what it does.
classical_check: Silent; this matches the modern view of Pluto as the planet of destruction and renewal.

hindi: जहां ये होता है ना उस घर को छोड़ छड़-छड़ करके खराब करके चेंज कर देता है।
says: Whichever house Pluto is in, it wrecks and changes that house's affairs. The house Pluto occupies is torn up and reshaped, so the house sets the area of change.
cells_derived_method: The topic of the house where Pluto sits is the one that is broken up and rebuilt: 4th (home), 7th (partnership), 10th (career), 2nd (wealth).

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: home, mother and peace of mind are upended and rebuilt.
derived, not said by him: partnerships are broken and remade through crises.
derived, not said by him: career and status are torn down and rebuilt on a new footing.

classical_check: Silent on Pluto; classically malefics harm the house they sit in (bhava nasha).

hindi: आप बहुत धनवान है तो आपको तोड़ मरोड़ के गरीब कर देगा।
says: If you are very rich, Pluto will twist and break you into poverty. Pluto's change can drive a wealthy person to the bottom. It is a general statement and not a prediction for anyone.

gist: Lead-in: if you are very poor.

hindi: तोड़ मरोड़ के अमीर कर देगा।
says: For the very poor, Pluto will twist and break them into riches. The same destroying change can turn a poor person rich, so it works in both directions.

gist: Lead-in: if you are a person who follows rules strictly.

hindi: आपका टोटल नियम डिसिप्लिन सत्यानाश करके बिगाड़ देगा।
says: Pluto will wreck and spoil all of your rules and discipline. Even the most disciplined person's routine is demolished. It is another example of its reversing action.

gist: Lead-in: if you say you will do many good deeds.

hindi: आपसे बुरे करवा देगा।
says: Pluto will make you do bad things. Even a person resolved to do good can be made to act badly under it, so it reverses intentions.

hindi: ये छोटी चीज को बहुत बड़ा और बहुत बड़ी चीज को बहुत छोटा करने की ताकत रखता है और आता छुपके है।
says: Pluto has the power to make a small thing very large and a huge thing very small, and it comes in secretly. Its method is reversal of scale, working unseen.

hindi: छोटा सा है नन्हा सा।
says: It is tiny, a very small planet. Pluto's small size is set against its large power.
classical_check: Agrees with astronomy: Pluto is a small dwarf planet.

gist: Rhetorical question: how does death come.
Mimics relatives saying they never knew when he died.
Mimics relatives saying he was breathing till yesterday.
Rhetorical question: what does the doctor's report say.
Dismisses the doctor's report with a rude idiom.
Some doctors' reports say this man should die.

hindi: वह मर ही नहीं रहा क्योंकि यमराज आ ही नहीं रहे लेने उसे।
says: The man is not dying because Yamraj is not coming to take him. Timing of death rests with Yamraj, not with the doctors' report. It is stated as a belief and gives no date for anyone.
classical_check: Silent; classically longevity is read from the 8th house, the lagna lord and Saturn.

gist: People pray, saying: O God, we plead with you.

hindi: यमराज नाराज है।
says: Yamraj is displeased, so the death does not come. A prolonged suffering with no death is read as Pluto's anger.

hindi: शुक्र की कृपा नहीं है।
says: The grace of Venus is absent. In such a long, painful decline Venus, the planet of ease and comfort, is withholding its favour.
ambiguity: The caption could be 'Shukra' (Venus), but its link to a painful decline is not explained.

gist: Describes the man as rotting away.
The family is begging for relief.
Describes worms in the body.
Says it would be better if death simply came to him.
Says Yamraj himself is sitting with his face turned away.
Says how much grace of Yamraj is needed in such a case.
Says it would be better to die than this.
Cut-off fragment: how many times we curse ourselves, continued in the next slice.
Completes the line: we curse ourselves in life, wishing for death.
Repeats that it would be better to die.
Says death is not coming.
If death did come we would say sorry, it was a slip of the tongue; this is not a game of fun.

hindi: तो आपका प्लूटो 11 नंबर राशि जहां कुंडली में बैठी है वहां पर आपका प्लूटो एक्टिवेटेड है और ये याद रखें बहुत लंबे टाइम के लिए
says: Where sign number 11 (Aquarius) sits in your chart, your Pluto is activated there, and he asks us to remember that it is for a very long time. The house carrying Aquarius is where Pluto's effects are switched on for years.
cells_derived_method: The house that Aquarius occupies in your chart is the area activated: Aquarius on the 2nd means wealth and speech, on the 7th partnerships, on the 10th career.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Pluto is active over wealth, family and speech for a long time.
derived, not said by him: Pluto is active over partnership and marriage matters for a long time.
derived, not said by him: Pluto is active over career and public standing for a long time.

ambiguity: 'Activated' is not tied to a dasha or transit, only to the placement of sign 11.
classical_check: Silent; Aquarius is Saturn's and has no Pluto activation classically.

hindi: अब इसके आसपास जो जो इसके घर में आ रहा है जा रहा है वैसा काम करेगा
says: Pluto will act according to whatever comes and goes in its house. The planets visiting Aquarius set how Pluto behaves at that time, so transits through sign 11 shape its results.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether 'coming and going' means transits or natal planets in the sign.

gist: Garbled remark that the Sun may sit here and not to carry this here; the meaning cannot be recovered.

hindi: 11 नंबर कहीं भी हो सकता है
says: Sign number 11 can be in any house of the chart, depending on the lagna. Aquarius lands on a different house for each ascendant, so the Pluto-activated area differs from person to person.
classical_check: Agrees: any sign can fall in any house.

hindi: तो प्लूटो जिस राशि में बैठा है उससे भी काम करेगा
says: Pluto will also work through the sign it actually sits in. Besides sign 11, the sign of Pluto's placement gives it another channel of action.
cells_derived_method: Pluto's results take on the nature of its sign: in Scorpio intense, in Taurus slow and material, in Gemini mental.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Pluto acts in an intense, secretive and transformative way.
derived, not said by him: Pluto acts through possessions, food and money, in a slow, stubborn way.
derived, not said by him: Pluto acts through speech, writing and ideas.

classical_check: Agrees with the general principle that a planet's results follow its sign.

gist: Repeats that it will work through the sign where Pluto sits.

hindi: अब 11 नंबर में जो बैठा है वो तो प्लूटो का घर है
says: Whatever sits in sign 11 is in Pluto's house. So any planet in Aquarius is a guest of Pluto, and its results come under Pluto's control.
cells_derived_method: A planet in Aquarius would be coloured by Pluto: the house gives the area (1st, 5th, 10th).

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: a planet in Aquarius on the ascendant works under Pluto's control on the self.
derived, not said by him: a planet in the 5th in Aquarius works under Pluto on children and learning.
derived, not said by him: a planet in the 9th in Aquarius works under Pluto on luck and dharma.

classical_check: Differs: classically such a planet is Saturn's guest.

hindi: और प्लूटो के घर में क्या मिलेगा मौत या धर्म
says: In Pluto's house you get either death or dharma. A planet in sign 11 meets one of two outcomes: destruction or righteousness.
ambiguity: 'Death' may mean literal death or destruction of what is wrong.

hindi: धर्म या तो तमीज से रहो।
says: It is dharma, or else live with proper manners. The way out of death in Pluto's house is righteous conduct and good behaviour.

hindi: अगर 11 नंबर यहां है तो आपको तमीज से काम करना है।
says: If sign 11 is in this spot of your chart, you must act with propriety there. The house holding Aquarius is the area where decent conduct is required of you.
cells_derived_method: The area depends on the house where Aquarius falls: 2nd (speech and money), 7th (spouse and partners), 10th (career conduct).

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: be proper in speech and money dealings.
derived, not said by him: be proper in partnership and marriage.
derived, not said by him: be proper in career and public conduct.

ambiguity: 'Yahan' is not tied to a house number.

hindi: बिल्कुल नाजायज नहीं कर सकते।
says: You cannot do anything unlawful at all in that place. The Aquarius house allows no illegitimate action without a penalty from Pluto.

hindi: यहां पर अन्याय गलत फैसले नहीं ले सकते।
says: Here you cannot take unjust or wrong decisions. Matters of the sign-11 house must be decided fairly, or Pluto turns against you.

hindi: यहां धर्म के विरुद्ध बोला आपकी बैंड बज जाएगा।
says: If you speak against dharma here, you will be ruined. In the sign-11 area, words against righteousness bring a collapse, so speech is the trigger.

hindi: मौत के बारे में मजाक उड़ाया ऐसी तैसी।
says: If you make a joke of death, you are wrecked. Mocking death offends Yamraj directly, so it is an action to avoid in Pluto's house.

gist: Garbled line about talking with a companion, husband or wife; the claim cannot be recovered.

hindi: यह वैश्यावृत्ति तक में धकेल देता है।
says: This, Pluto's affliction here, pushes a person even into prostitution. Misbehaviour toward a spouse under a bad Pluto leads to the lowest conduct. It is recorded only as his claim about conduct and not as a prediction about anyone.
ambiguity: The subject and the preceding line are garbled, so the condition is unclear.
classical_check: Silent; classically such a result is read from a badly afflicted Venus and the 7th house.

hindi: अगर शुक्र को शुक्र का दोष हो।
says: If Venus has a Venus fault, the affliction applies. The condition is that Venus itself, the planet of love and relations, is damaged.
cells_derived_method: A damaged Venus would be one in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or in Virgo (debilitated), or afflicted by Saturn or Rahu.

derived_examples.reading: derived, not said by him: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 6th, a clear Venus fault.
derived, not said by him: Venus in the 8th in a Mars sign, a strained Venus.
derived, not said by him: Venus exalted in the 12th, a strong Venus and not a fault by sign.

ambiguity: The wording 'Venus's fault in Venus' is not explained.
classical_check: Agrees that an afflicted Venus damages relations; the specific faults he means are not named.

hindi: पुरुष हो चाहे स्त्री हो।
says: This holds for men and for women alike. The Venus-fault warning is not gender-specific.

hindi: यह इतना डेंजरस है।
says: Pluto is this dangerous. He stresses how hard Pluto hits relationships when Venus is damaged.

hindi: लीगलाइजेशन कराता है डिवोर्स की।
says: Pluto gets divorce legalised: it brings about a formal divorce. A damaged Venus under Pluto gives legal separation. It is a tradition claim and not a prediction for any couple.
classical_check: Silent; classically divorce is read from the 7th house, its lord and Venus.

hindi: इसी के पास सारा का सारा अबॉर्शन का
says: All matters of abortion are in Pluto's hands too. The sentence is cut at the slice end, so only the first claim is certain. It is recorded as his belief and not as medical or moral advice.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off and the rest follows in the next slice.

gist: Fragment 'it is a game' carried over from the previous slice, no claim.

hindi: अगर आपका प्लूटो नाराज है तो ये आपके घर गृहस्ती बच्चे आपको किसी का सुख नहीं देगा।
says: If Pluto is afflicted or 'angry' in a chart, it denies the native the happiness of home life, household and children.
cells_derived_method: Home (4th), children (5th) and family (2nd) topics are the ones hurt; the sign Pluto sits in decides the manner (fire sign = quarrel and rupture, water sign = emotional loss, earth sign = material loss, air sign = estrangement).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: afflicted Pluto in the 4th in Cancer would hit domestic peace and mother-linked comfort through emotional upheaval.
Derived: afflicted Pluto in the 5th in Scorpio would show as intense, obsessive or severed bonds with children.
Derived: afflicted Pluto in the 2nd in Capricorn would break family cohesion through rigid, cold or money-driven separation.

ambiguity: 'Angry' is not defined (affliction by a malefic, enemy sign, or dusthana placement are all possible).
classical_check: Silent: Pluto is not part of the classical seven-planet scheme; the house topics themselves are classical.

hindi: दूर कर देगा।
says: An angry Pluto pushes these people (family, children, home comforts) away from you, creating distance.
cells_derived_method: Distance appears in whichever house Pluto sits: in the 4th it separates from home or mother, in the 7th from spouse, in the 9th from father or guru.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: afflicted Pluto in the 7th in Libra would push the partner away, separation of spouse.
Derived: afflicted Pluto in the 4th in Aries would drive the native out of the home environment through conflict.

ambiguity: Subject of 'dur kar dega' is implied from the previous sentence (family and children).

gist: Rhetorical lead-in 'and what is the fun part, what will it do?'

hindi: यह दुख भोग सको आयु लंबी करेगा।
says: Pluto lengthens the native's life span so that he can live through the suffering it causes, i.e. a long life with sorrow.
ambiguity: Whether this holds for any Pluto placement or only an afflicted Pluto is not stated; no age is given. Longevity claim recorded only as his statement, not as a prediction.
classical_check: Differs from classical view where malefics in the 8th can reduce or lengthen ayu depending on the lord; Pluto is not classical.

gist: Mock-scolding line 'how will you cry then, son?'
Audience question: what if Pluto becomes debilitated, in the 12th house (garbled).

hindi: आठ नंबर प्लूटो नीच ही नहीं होता।
says: He states Pluto is never debilitated at 'number 8'; Pluto does not take a fall in the way the seven classical planets do.
ambiguity: 'Number 8' could be sign 8 (Scorpio, Pluto's traditional sign) or house 8; caption also shows a garbled '12 number bhava' question just before. Only the general claim 'Pluto never debilitated' is certain.
classical_check: Silent: no classical exaltation or debilitation exists for Pluto.

gist: Says the slides for the two signs Virgo and Libra had not come up yet; unclear whether these are shown as Pluto's signs (caption unclear).

hindi: कन्या और तुला राशि के अंदर मनुष्य, राक्षस और देव तीनों ही गण हैं।
says: Virgo and Libra together contain all three ganas (manushya, rakshasa and deva), so these two signs carry all three temperaments.
ambiguity: Gana belongs to nakshatras, not signs; he is transferring it to the signs by their nakshatras.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Virgo holds Uttara Phalguni (manushya), Hasta (deva), Chitra (rakshasa); Libra holds Chitra (rakshasa), Swati (deva), Vishakha (rakshasa), so Libra alone has no manushya nakshatra.

hindi: ना यह मनुष्य को छोड़ता, ना राक्षस को छोड़ता, ना यह देवता को छोड़ता।
says: Pluto, as the death principle, spares none of the three kinds of beings: human, demon or god.
classical_check: Silent (Pluto is outside the classical scheme; the death-time idea is Saturn or Ketu or the 8th lord classically).

hindi: सब मरते ही हैं।
says: Everything that is born dies; mortality is universal, which is the reason Pluto's 'no exemption' power is absolute.
ambiguity: General philosophical remark, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Not a chart rule; consistent with classical views on kala.

hindi: इंद्र भी मरता है।
says: Even Indra, king of the gods, is subject to death; an illustration that rank does not shield from Pluto.
ambiguity: Here Indra is the mythological king; in his scheme Indra also names Uranus, but no Uranus rule is intended.
classical_check: Mythological illustration, not a classical chart rule.

hindi: ब्रह्मा की भी मृत्यु होती है।
says: Even Brahma the creator meets an end, a second mythological example that Pluto's time-power covers all beings.
classical_check: Puranic idea (Brahma's lifespan ends at pralaya); not a chart rule.

hindi: ये शिव के अलावा किसी को नहीं छोड़ता।
says: Pluto spares nobody except Shiva, who stands outside time.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; Shiva as Mahakala beyond time is Puranic.

hindi: विष्णु का भी एक समय आता है कभी ना कभी।
says: Even Vishnu's time comes at some point, so the preserver is also within Pluto's reach.
classical_check: Puranic illustration; not a chart rule.

gist: 'So it spares no one at all', restatement of the previous lines.
Personified Pluto saying 'brother, I will swallow you'.

hindi: काल किसी को नहीं छोड़ता।
says: He identifies Pluto with Kaal (Time): Time leaves no one, which is why Pluto works as the planet of time and death.
ambiguity: Subject is Kaal; the identification with Pluto is carried over from the earlier lines.
classical_check: Classically Kaal is linked to Saturn; Pluto as Kaal is his own mapping.

hindi: सिर्फ महाकाल जो समय स्पेस टाइम की डायमेंशन से परे हैं शिव उनको छोड़ता है।
says: Only Mahakal Shiva, who is beyond the dimensions of time and space, is spared by Pluto.
ambiguity: Restates the exception already given; adds the reason (beyond time-space).

hindi: इसलिए चंद्रमा को देखते हैं हर जगह।
says: Because death rules everything, the Moon (water, life) is looked at everywhere as the counter-principle; the Moon is the first thing examined.
ambiguity: Reasoning is loose: 'we look at the Moon everywhere' may mean scientists looking for water or astrologers checking the Moon.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical emphasis on the Moon as the life and mind karaka (chandra lagna).

gist: Analogy: every scientist asks 'where is the water?'

hindi: पानी है तो जीवन है।
says: Where there is water there is life; the Moon, as lord of water, is the life-giving karaka that stands against Pluto's death principle.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is the karaka of water, fluids and the life-sustaining principle.

gist: No life on a planet without water, repeats the previous line.
'So water is very necessary', repeat of the previous point.

hindi: इसीलिए माता को प्रणाम करना बहुत जरूरी है।
says: Remedy: bowing to the mother is very important, since mother is the Moon; honouring her counters the dangers Pluto brings.
ambiguity: Not stated whether it is a remedy only for afflicted Pluto or general.
classical_check: Classical Moon remedies include serving the mother; agrees.

hindi: इसीलिए स्त्री की कृपा से बचते हैं।
says: People are saved through the grace of a woman (mother, wife), the feminine Moon principle that protects against destruction.
ambiguity: Caption is loose: 'bachte hain' may mean 'are saved' or 'are kept safe'.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the Moon as mother and women karaka.

gist: Allusion to Satyavan (Savitri-Satyavan story, saved from Yama by his wife), garbled.
Transition: 'see how many different jobs Pluto has'.
Introduces a small chart worked out to help remember Pluto's results per sign.
'It is very good', self-approval of the chart.

hindi: एक नंबर राशि मंगल की राशि है।
says: Sign number 1 (Aries) is the sign of Mars; the chart walks through the signs in order starting here.
classical_check: Agrees: Aries is owned by Mars.

hindi: मंगल जो है साहस का देवता है।
says: Mars is the deity of courage (sahas), so the Mars sign stands for courage.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the karaka of courage and valour.

hindi: जुनून का देवता है।
says: Mars is also the god of passion and drive (junoon), the fiery energy behind actions.
classical_check: Agrees broadly with Mars as energy and aggression karaka.

hindi: इसके पास सारी की सारी हिम्मत है।
says: Mars holds the entire store of daring and nerve (himmat); every kind of boldness is placed under Mars.
classical_check: Agrees with Mars as karaka of boldness.

hindi: इसके पास मित्रता है।
says: He gives friendship (mitrata) to Mars's portfolio, tied to the first sign Aries.
ambiguity: Friendship is a Mars karakatwa only in his scheme.
classical_check: Differs: classically friends are linked to Mercury, Venus and the 11th house; Mars gives brothers and comrades.

hindi: इसके पास कम्युनिकेशन है।
says: He assigns communication to Mars (the first sign), meaning direct, forceful self-expression.
ambiguity: Communication is usually Mercury; here it is Mars as the 1st sign (and 3rd house of effort is not mentioned).
classical_check: Differs: classically Mercury governs communication; Mars governs the 3rd-house courage and effort only partly.

hindi: ये गॉड ऑफ़ वॉर है।
says: Mars is the god of war, the warrior planet.

hindi: युद्ध हनुमान जी है ये।
says: He equates the Mars warrior aspect with Hanuman, so Mars is seen as Hanuman's force.
ambiguity: Deity mapping; Mars is classically linked to Kartikeya and Hanuman worship is a Mars remedy.
classical_check: Agrees with tradition of Hanuman worship for Mars.

hindi: ये कुछ भी कार्य हो असंभव शब्द हनुमान की डिक्शनरी में है नहीं।
says: Nothing is impossible for Mars or Hanuman: Mars gives the capacity to accomplish any task.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with Mars as energy and ability to execute.

hindi: ये मौत ही नहीं आती।
says: Mars as Hanuman has no death, he is deathless; so the Mars sign does not simply accept Pluto's death-principle.
ambiguity: Caption 'ये मौत ही नहीं आती' is awkward; read as 'death does not come to him'.

gist: Garbled lines 'so death will happen' and 'from death will live, die'; no clear claim.
Second garbled line 'maut se jiyenge marenge'; cannot be read as a claim.

hindi: चिरंजीवी हैं।
says: Hanuman, and through him Mars, is chiranjeevi (long-lived or immortal); life-force never ends in this sign.
classical_check: Puranic: Hanuman is one of the seven chiranjeevis; not a chart rule.

gist: Rhetorical 'so what is it for this sign?'

hindi: अलाइव।
says: The key quality he gives sign 1 (Aries) is 'alive': vitality, life-force and aliveness.
ambiguity: One-word caption; meaning inferred from the context of deathless Mars.
classical_check: Agrees with Aries as the sign of beginning and life force.

hindi: चर स्थिर द्वभाव।
says: He recalls the three modalities of signs: movable (char), fixed (sthir) and dual (dwiswabhav).
cells_derived_method: Modality repeats every four signs: Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn movable; Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius fixed; Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces dual. Planets in movable signs act quickly, in fixed signs stubbornly, in dual signs variably.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a movable sign in the 1st, active starter temperament.
Derived: a fixed sign in the 10th, persistent and resistant career style.
Derived: a dual sign in the 7th, changeable partnerships.

ambiguity: The following sentence says 'two kinds of signs', which does not match the three listed here.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical movable, fixed and dual classification.

hindi: दो किस्म की राशि होती है।
says: He says signs are of two kinds, apparently leading into 'movable sign and element'; no clear two-way split is named.
ambiguity: Contradicts the three modalities just listed; could mean two attributes (modality and element) or odd/even.
classical_check: Silent; classically signs split into 3 modalities, 4 elements, or 2 polarities.

hindi: चर राशि है और ये अर्थ एलिमेंट है।
says: Sign 1 (Aries) is a movable sign and, as the caption has it, of the earth element.
ambiguity: Aries is fire, not earth; the caption word may be garbled or he may use a different element scheme.
classical_check: Movable agrees; earth element disagrees, Aries is a fire sign classically.

hindi: ये विल जब प्लूटो यहां होता है तो ये आपके साहस को आपकी मित्रता को आपके प्रेम को प्रेम कौन सा?
says: When Pluto sits in this first sign (Mars's sign), it attacks the native's courage, friendships and love.
cells_derived_method: Aries stands for courage, friendship and self-assertion; its effect lands on whichever house Aries falls in: self in the 1st, partners in the 7th, initiative in the 10th, and so on.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Aries in the 1st would erode self-confidence and make the native destroy his own friendships.
Derived: Pluto in Aries in the 7th would wreck marital companionship and fighting spirit with the spouse.
Derived: Pluto in Aries in the 10th would break the courage and initiative needed in career.

ambiguity: The caption leaves the sentence unfinished with 'which love?', answered in the next lines.

hindi: मित्रता वाला जिसमें यार बुरा नहीं मानते
says: The love meant here is the friendship type of love, where friends do not take offence at each other; Pluto damages that easy comradeship.

hindi: या आपकी नाभि को आपके सारे के सारे ब्लड रिलेटेड प्रॉब्लम सारी मंगल के पास है।
says: The navel and all blood-related matters belong to Mars; Pluto in the Mars sign hits these body areas. Recorded as his body-karaka claim, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars is the blood karaka; the navel is not a standard Mars item (it is Mars/Aries head in kalapurusha, the navel is Leo or Virgo).

gist: Rhetorical 'what does it do to all of these?'

hindi: इसको नष्ट करता है, तोड़ता है, मरोड़ता है, कचोड़ता है।
says: Pluto in this sign destroys, breaks, twists and mauls what Mars rules (courage, friendship, blood and navel matters).

hindi: ऐसी की तैसी बजा के बदल देता है।
says: After wrecking it, Pluto transforms and replaces it, so the destruction ends in a changed form.

hindi: अब यहां पर आपके इस राशि के अंदर मान लेते हैं शनि बैठा खराब।
says: For an example he assumes a bad Saturn also sits in this first sign (Aries) along with Pluto's effect.

hindi: शनि नीच का होता है इस राशि में।
says: Saturn is debilitated in this sign (Aries).

gist: Rhetorical 'so what does the number 1 sign mean here?'

hindi: कि आपकी मित्रता भी खराब करेगा।
says: Debilitated Saturn in sign 1 spoils the native's friendships as well, a sign-1 (Mars) topic.
cells_derived_method: Friendship spoils wherever Aries falls: 11th-house friends if Aries is in 11th, spouse if in 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 11th would sour friendships and gains from friends.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 3rd would spoil dealings with siblings and neighbours.

classical_check: Agrees in tone: debilitated Saturn is harsh and cold, not specifically about friendship.

hindi: आप अपने आप की भी इज्जत नहीं करेंगे।
says: With debilitated Saturn in the first sign the native loses self-respect and does not value himself.
cells_derived_method: Self-respect issue is strongest when Aries is in the 1st; in other houses it shows through that house's area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in the 1st in Aries gives low self-esteem and self-neglect.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 10th gives no respect for his own work or status.

classical_check: Consistent with debilitated Saturn in the lagna giving inferiority feelings.

hindi: यह लगन है ना?
says: He treats this first sign position as the lagna (ascendant), so sign 1 equals the first house in his chart walk.
ambiguity: He mixes sign number and house number; this works only for an Aries lagna.
classical_check: Agrees that the 1st house is the lagna; the sign-house identity holds only for Aries rising.

gist: 'You will not respect yourself either', repeated.

hindi: मान लो यह शादी के स्थान में बैठा है तो पत्नी की इज्जत या पति की इज्जत नहीं करेंगे।
says: If this debilitated Saturn sits in the marriage house, the native will not respect his wife or her husband.
cells_derived_method: Same logic: the disrespect transfers to the house topic where Aries lands.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 7th gives disrespect and cold treatment of the spouse.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 4th gives disrespect towards mother and home.

ambiguity: 'Marriage place' read as the 7th house; for the Aries cell this means a Libra lagna.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: debilitated Saturn in the 7th troubles marriage.

gist: 'This is the Saturn of number one', restatement.

hindi: आप कहीं भी ले सकते हैं।
says: The sign-1 reading can be applied to any house: wherever Aries falls, the same sign-based meaning is carried to that house.
cells_derived_method: Take the sign-1 meaning and read it through the house where Aries sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: sign-1 meaning applied to the 2nd shows as bold or harsh speech and wealth through force.
Derived: sign-1 meaning in the 9th shows as aggressive faith or conflict with father.

classical_check: Agrees with the general approach of reading a sign through the house it occupies.

gist: Says he only told this example for illustration.
Rhetorical 'so what is this doing?'
'This is doing satyanash (ruin)', repeat of the effect already stated.
'Ending friendship', repeat.
'Ending love', repeat.

hindi: बुरा मानना, अच्छा मानना।
says: Taking offence or taking things well, the touchiness of the native, is part of sign-1 (Mars) territory.

gist: Rhetorical 'if this bad Saturn sits here, what will it do?'

hindi: ये आप तो बुरा ही मानोगे बात बात पे।
says: Bad Saturn in Aries makes the native take offence at every small thing.

gist: 'You will not respect yourself', third time.
'You will not respect him/her', repeat of the spouse point.
Lead-in 'so if Pluto has come here'.

hindi: प्लूटो बैठा है साथ में तो ये इसको नष्ट कर देगा।
says: If Pluto sits together with this bad (debilitated) Saturn in Aries, it destroys the Saturn's results.
cells_derived_method: Conjunction of Pluto and Saturn in Aries shows through the house where Aries falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto with debilitated Saturn in the 1st in Aries gives destruction of the native's self-image.
Derived: Pluto with debilitated Saturn in the 8th in Aries gives sudden breakdowns and loss.

ambiguity: 'Nasht kar dega' could mean destroys the Saturn's bad effects or intensifies the damage; context suggests it wrecks self-respect.

gist: 'You will not respect yourself', fourth repeat.
Rhetorical 'how will you not wreck it?'

hindi: तुम्हें करनी पड़ेगी।
says: Pluto will compel you to do the wrecking, you will have to ruin your own self-respect and friendships under its pressure.
ambiguity: Fragment completing the previous question; the object of the compulsion is inferred.

hindi: तुम दूसरे को बदनाम करते हो, खराब करते हो।
says: With this combination the native also defames and spoils other people, turning outward the destruction.

hindi: तुम्हारे को सत्यानाश करके बर्बाद कर देगा।
says: In the end it ruins and wrecks the native himself.

hindi: यानी कि यह जिस भाव में बैठा है इसको कचोड़ मचोड़ के ऐसी की तैसी करके उसके अंदर पावर फूंक देगा।
says: Pluto crushes the house it sits in and then infuses power into it: destruction first, then a new strength in that house's affairs.
cells_derived_method: Each house is wrecked in its own topic and later rebuilt stronger: 2nd for wealth or speech, 7th for partnerships, 10th for career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 2nd in Taurus first breaks savings and family values, then rebuilds with a hard-edged power over resources.
Derived: Pluto in the 7th in Libra breaks the partnership pattern, then rebuilds relationships intensely.
Derived: Pluto in the 10th in Aries destroys the career path then rebuilds it with ruthless force.

ambiguity: He says 'bhava' here, so this is house-based, differing from the sign-wise walk before.
classical_check: Silent: Pluto is outside the classical scheme.

gist: Premise of an example: 'suppose you are very rich'.

hindi: और प्लूटो महाराज वहां पहुंच गए तो उसको भ्रष्ट करके नष्ट कर देंगे और आप कंगले हो जाओगे और आप बहुत कंगले हैं तो उसको भ्रष्ट करके नष्ट करके आपको अमीर कर देंगे।
says: If Pluto reaches the rich man's wealth place it ruins it and makes him a pauper; if the native is very poor, Pluto ruins that state and makes him rich. Pluto reverses the existing condition.
cells_derived_method: Reversal acts on the house in which Pluto sits: wealth reversal in the 2nd and 11th, status reversal in the 10th, home reversal in the 4th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 2nd in Libra reverses the wealth condition: rich lose, poor gain.
Derived: Pluto in the 11th in Gemini reverses the pattern of income and gains.

ambiguity: 'There' is taken as the wealth place; he does not name a house. This is not investment advice.

hindi: क्योंकि ये मौत का देवता है।
says: The reason is that Pluto is the god of death.
classical_check: Classically death is linked to Yama (Saturn's brother) and Ketu; he maps Pluto to Yama.

hindi: जो है उसे मारो।
says: Pluto's working rule is to kill whatever exists, to end the present state of a thing.

hindi: अगर तो धर्म से चल रहे हो तो तारो।
says: If the native lives by dharma, Pluto ferries him across, i.e. saves or uplifts; the outcome of Pluto depends on conduct.
ambiguity: 'Taro' read as 'carry across/save'.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea that conduct moderates karmic results; Pluto is not classical.

gist: Rhetorical 'so in what manner are you living?'

hindi: आपको यह देखना है आपका एक बच्चा ऐसा है जो कहना मानता है एक बच्चा कहना नहीं मानता चेक करो उसका प्लूटो
says: When one child obeys and another does not, check the disobedient child's Pluto.
cells_derived_method: Pluto's sign and house in the child's own chart show the area of defiance: Pluto in the 1st, 3rd or 9th is more about self-will or rebellion against elders.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: child's Pluto in the 1st in Aries would show a headstrong, defiant temperament.
Derived: child's Pluto in the 9th in Sagittarius would show defiance of father, teachers and rules.

classical_check: Silent: classically the 5th house and the Moon, Mercury, Saturn would be checked.

hindi: दूरगामी प्रभाव उसका शनि चेक करो
says: Also check the disobedient child's Saturn, since it governs the long-range effect (dooragami prabhav) of conduct.
ambiguity: 'Dooragami prabhav' attached to either the Pluto or the Saturn check.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn shows discipline and long-term results.

hindi: उसका बुध और बृहस्पति वक्री तो नहीं है
says: Check whether the child's Mercury and Jupiter are retrograde, as retrograde Mercury or Jupiter can show a child who does not listen.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts treat retrogression as cheshtabala (strength), not as disobedience.

hindi: अगर वक्री है तो उनके उपाय करो
says: If those planets are retrograde, perform their remedies.
ambiguity: No specific remedy named here.
classical_check: Remedies are a general upaya tradition; silent on specifics.

hindi: प्लूटो के पास काला रंग है
says: Black is the colour of Pluto.
classical_check: Silent for Pluto; black is Saturn's colour classically.

hindi: ये आपका अगर यहां बैठ गया है प्लूटो और ये ऐसा प्लनेट कोई खराब नहीं बैठा है तो ये विलेन बना देता है
says: If Pluto sits in this first sign and no other bad planet is there to share the blame, Pluto itself turns the native into a villain.
cells_derived_method: The villain trait shows in the area of the house where Aries sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 1st in Aries gives a ruthless, aggressive personality.
Derived: Pluto in the 6th in Aries gives a ruthless, combative approach to enemies and rivals.

ambiguity: Caption is garbled: 'such a planet no bad one sits' can be read as 'with no malefic along' or the opposite.

hindi: जितनी क्रुलिटी के काम मंगल कितना अच्छा है हनुमान जी सोच के चले
says: All the cruelty-type work belongs to Mars; yet think of Hanuman, how good Mars is when benign.
ambiguity: Sentence crosses the 56:06 / 57:03 caption boundary.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the karaka of cruelty, weapons and violence as well as valour.

hindi: कितना अच्छा कार्य करते हैं।
says: Benign Mars (Hanuman) does enormous good work, protection and service.
ambiguity: Tail of the sentence started at 56:06.
classical_check: Agrees with benefic Mars giving protection and strength.

hindi: अगर वो विलेन बन गए तो क्या होगा बर्बाद भी कर देंगे उस प्रकार मान के चल
says: If Mars turned villain he would destroy too; read Pluto in the Mars sign in that way, as a good protector turned destroyer.

hindi: तो यानी कि सारी की सारी आपकी ऊर्जा नाभि की ऊर्जा आपकी विलन बनने में है
says: All of the native's energy, the navel energy of Mars, is spent in becoming a villain when Pluto spoils this sign.

hindi: आप इतना बदतमीज हो इतना गंदा बोलते हो क्लेश करते हो खुद का भी गाली बकते हो दूसरे को भी गाली बकते हो
says: The villain-type native is rude, foul-mouthed, quarrelsome and abuses both himself and others.

hindi: अगर ऐसा ही स्वभाव आपका लगातार चल रहा है और बृहस्पति और बुध में दोष साथ में आ गया तो आपकी वाणी में डाल देगा
says: If this nature persists and the fault also reaches Jupiter and Mercury, Pluto's damage enters the native's speech.
ambiguity: 'Dosh' in Jupiter and Mercury is not defined (affliction, retrograde, or conjunction with Pluto).
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury and Jupiter govern speech and the 2nd house.

hindi: शुक्र में आ गया तो आपके पहनने ओढ़ने के अंदर चमकीले भड़कले नौटंकी ड्रामेबाजी डाल देगा
says: If the fault reaches Venus, it shows in dress and show: flashy, garish clothes and theatrical drama.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus rules dress and display.

hindi: आपके शनि में आ गया तो आपके देन लेन के अंदर डाल देगा
says: If the fault reaches Saturn, it enters the native's give-and-take, his dealings and transactions.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Saturn rules justice, dues and fair dealing.

hindi: शनि न्याय का देवता आप न्याय करोगे ही अन्याय अन्याय का साथ दोगे।
says: Saturn is the god of justice; with the fault you will not do justice and will side with injustice. Caption 'karoge hi' is read as 'will not do'.
ambiguity: The caption lacks the negation; meaning follows from the sentence's second half.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is Dandadhikari, the judge.

gist: Audience 'yes sir'.
Audience question: Pluto just gave neech-like results here, did it not?

hindi: हां नीच तुल्य फल देगा ना।
says: Pluto in this situation gives results equal to debilitation (neech-tulya phal) even though it is not debilitated.
ambiguity: Whether this holds only in negative signs and houses is discussed next.

gist: Says 'let it reach negative signs and houses first', postponing the case to later.
'Let me reach there first.'
'I have only just started the car.'
Audience: 'that was the question I asked earlier, sir'.
'Who?'
Audience restates that he had said Pluto is never debilitated.

hindi: नीच तुल्य है।
says: Pluto is neech-tulya (equal to debilitation) but not actually debilitated.

gist: 'It is giving results like a debilitated planet', same as the previous line.

hindi: नीच नहीं क्योंकि ये बख्शेगा नहीं।
says: It is not debilitated because Pluto does not spare anything; a fall would imply weakness, which Pluto never has.

gist: 'Death spares no one', repeat.
'The question does not even arise.'
'It comes to gods too', repeat.
'It comes to humans also', repeat.
'It comes to demons also', repeat.

hindi: अच्छी बुरी मौत कर सकते हैं।
says: One can make death good or bad; the quality of death depends on how one lives. This is only his statement, not a prediction.

gist: 'Yes, good or bad death', repeat.
'But it is still death.'

hindi: आप ये देखिए मौत जैसे शुक्र चरित्र का हनन ही करेगा।
says: Each planet has a fixed function; just as death only ends things, Venus only acts on character (charitra). Only the quality varies.
ambiguity: 'Charitra ka hanan' means harming character; read as acting on the character and conduct area.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Venus governs sensual conduct; no classical rule says 'only destroys character'.

hindi: अच्छा हनन या बुरा हनन करेगा
says: The function is the same but its expression may be constructive or destructive; the planet picks the type of action, circumstance picks its quality.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea that planets give results by dignity and strength.

hindi: वही इंद्र अय्याशी ही करेगा।
says: Indra (Uranus in his scheme) only ever does indulgence and luxury; that is his fixed function.
ambiguity: Indra may here be the myth, with Uranus as the mapped planet.

gist: 'Good indulgence or bad indulgence', repeat of the quality point.
'Yes.'

hindi: हनुमान जी ने हमेशा रक्षा ही करनी है।
says: Hanuman (Mars) always protects; protection is his fixed function.
classical_check: Agrees with Mars as protector (rakshak) of the brave.

gist: 'He must protect well', repeat.
'Bad protection... the planet's fruit is of its own kind', repeats the fixed-function point.

hindi: सूर्य ने जीवन ही देना है।
says: The Sun's function is to give life; it can only give life, in a good or spoiled form.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is atmakaraka, karaka of life-force.

gist: 'Giving it spoiled', variant of quality point.
'Giving it well', variant of quality point.
'This is the planet's nature', repeat.

hindi: इसलिए इसका स्वभाव तो यही है कि जहां जो है उसको मैं कचूमर निकाल के नष्ट कर दूंगा।
says: Pluto's nature is to pulp and annihilate whatever stands in the place where it sits.
cells_derived_method: Pluto's destruction lands on the topic of the house it occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 3rd in Gemini pulps efforts, writing and sibling bonds.
Derived: Pluto in the 12th in Pisces destroys expenses, sleep and foreign settings, leading to dissolution.

gist: 'I will distort it', synonym.
'I will spoil it', synonym.
'I will break it down and ruin it', synonym.
Audience: 'one more conclusion, sir'.
'Yes.'
Audience question: when counting 1 2 3 4 are you placing Pluto in the house or in the sign?

hindi: राशि में प्लेस कर रहे हैं।
says: In this walk-through Pluto is being placed in the sign (rashi), not in a house; each slide is Pluto in a sign.

hindi: भाव का भी फल साथ में बताया जा रहा है।
says: The house result is also being told along with the sign result, since in the walk-through sign N is read together with house N.
cells_derived_method: Sign-based reading plus the house topic: apply sign nature first, then the house where the sign falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Aries in the 6th: the sign gives aggressive drive, the house applies it to enemies and disputes.
Derived: Pluto in Aries in the 5th: the sign gives impulsive force, the house applies it to children and creativity.

classical_check: Agrees with the general method of reading sign and house together.

gist: 'This is being placed in the sign', repeat.
'Pluto is at present in Mars's house' (the example slide for sign 1).

hindi: मान लो ये प्लूटो यहां पर होता है एक नंबर में तो चौथे घर के जो फल है उसको खराब करता है।
says: If Pluto is in number 1, it spoils the results of the 4th house (home, mother, comfort).
cells_derived_method: Pluto's damage reaches the 4th-house topics: home, mother, vehicles, peace of mind.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto afflicting the 4th in Cancer shows as emotional turmoil at home and with mother.
Derived: Pluto afflicting the 4th in Capricorn shows as cold, material loss in property and domestic stability.

ambiguity: Unclear link between 'number 1' and 'fourth house'; may be Mars's 4th aspect from sign 1, or the sign-4 slide that follows. Low reliability.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars aspects the 4th from its position; Pluto aspects are not classical.

gist: Aside that the earlier part was covered at high speed, like a car driven fast.
Poses the question: when we go to the 6th, 8th and 12th with a good planet seated there, what does Pluto do?

hindi: अच्छे वाला काम करके मारेगा।
says: If a good planet sits in the 6th, 8th or 12th together with Pluto, Pluto finishes the matter by a good route, ending things in a favourable way.
cells_derived_method: The good outcome is expressed through the house topic: 6th (enemies, debts, disease), 8th (transformation, death, inheritance), 12th (expenses, foreign, loss).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: good planet with Pluto in the 6th in Virgo ends enemies and debts by clean, orderly means.
Derived: good planet with Pluto in the 8th in Scorpio gives a profound transformation or gain of hidden resources instead of loss.
Derived: good planet with Pluto in the 12th in Pisces ends attachments and gives release or spiritual closure.

ambiguity: 'Maarega' (will kill) is used loosely for 'will end the matter'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: benefics in dusthanas soften results (viparita logic); Pluto is not classical.

hindi: बुरा है तो बुरे तरीके से जैसे यहां पर खराब बैठ गया तो शत्रु से लड़ाई करके जीतवाएगा।
says: If the planet with Pluto is bad, the result comes by a rough route; for instance a bad Pluto here (the 6th, enemy place) wins over the enemy only after a fight.
cells_derived_method: The 6th house victory comes by confrontation; in other dusthanas the bad route would show as ordeal before relief.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: bad Pluto in the 6th in Aries wins against enemies by open combat and heat.
Derived: bad Pluto in the 6th in Capricorn wins against rivals by grinding, long-drawn confrontation.

ambiguity: 'Yahan' is taken as the 6th house; the earlier clause names 6, 8 and 12 and the enemy reference points to 6.
classical_check: Agrees that malefics in the 6th help to defeat enemies; Pluto is not classical.

gist: 'A number-one one has sat', garbled continuation of the example.
'However it sits, there are many signs', transition line.

hindi: पांच नंबर भी खराब है।
says: Sign number 5 (Leo) is also a bad placement for Pluto in his table of signs.
cells_derived_method: Pluto in Leo hits the 5th-sign topics (children, creativity, ego, authority) in whichever house Leo falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 5th in Leo strains children and creative self-expression.

hindi: अगर ये अगर ये खराब करता है तो उसी हिसाब से करेगा।

hindi: इसका काम तो मृत्यु है ना।
says: Pluto's job is death; this is the one function it always performs.

hindi: प्लनेट का एक काम तो फिक्स है।

hindi: उसका काम तो यही है कि भाई मौत दूंगा।
says: Pluto's function in his own voice is 'I will give death'; whatever it sits in, the result is an ending.

hindi: चाहे देवता है, राक्षस है, कोई भी तुम्हें एक्सीडेंटल डेथ देनी है।
says: Whether you are god-like or demon-like, Pluto can deal an accidental death; recorded as his claim about Pluto's range, not a prediction for anyone.

classical_check: Classically accidental death is read from the 8th lord, Mars, Rahu and Saturn; Pluto is his addition.

hindi: आठवें घर में डेथ देगा।
says: In the 8th house, the house of death, Pluto delivers the death result.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 8th decides the manner: fire sign gives sudden or violent ending, water sign illness-linked or emotional ending, air sign abrupt or travel-linked, earth sign slow or material. This is a derived reading of the manner only.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 8th in Aries points to sudden, violent or accident-type endings (manner only, not a date).
Derived: Pluto in the 8th in Pisces points to a quiet, dissolving, water-linked ending.
Derived: Pluto in the 8th in Capricorn points to a slow, long-drawn ending tied to structure and age.

ambiguity: No age or date is given. Recorded as his statement only; no death prediction is made.
classical_check: Agrees that the 8th is the house of death and ayu; Pluto is not classical.

hindi: एक्सीडेंटल डेथ दे देगा।
says: With a bad placement in the 8th, Pluto can bring the accidental type of death.
cells_derived_method: Accidental manner is likelier in movable and fire signs than in water or earth signs (derived).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: bad Pluto in the 8th in Aries is the harshest accident-type reading.
Derived: bad Pluto in the 8th in Taurus is milder, accident risk tied to possessions or throat-area ailments only in this derived sense.

ambiguity: Linked to the 8th by the previous sentence; he says 'if this is a bad sign' only after. No death prediction is made.
classical_check: Classical: 8th lord and Mars or Rahu in the 8th give accidents; Pluto is his addition.

hindi: अगर यह खराब राशि है तो अच्छी डेथ चाहिए चाहिए सोए सोए मर जाओ धर्म का नाम लेते हुए मर जाओ
says: The caption reads: if the sign is bad, a good death is wanted: dying in sleep, chanting God's name. The sign quality decides whether the death is peaceful or accidental; the sign condition is likely reversed in the caption.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 8th in Sagittarius, a dharmic sign, is the example for a peaceful, God-named ending.

hindi: पानी का काम तो प्यास बुझाना है चाहे कैसे भी करो
says: Analogy: water's fixed job is to quench thirst, however you use it; likewise each planet's function is fixed.

hindi: दो नंबर राशि जो है इसके पास सारे के

hindi: जितनी वो कन्याएं होती है ना गाना गाती है बड़ी कोयल जैसी आवाज वो सबका का शुक्र बढ़िया होता है।

hindi: अगर कुंडली में दो नंबर राशि शुक्र मालिक है।
says: Sign 2 (Taurus) is owned by Venus.

hindi: इसका कहीं पर भी शुक्र अच्छा है तो वह गायन में बहुत अच्छे होते हैं।
