hindi: अगर तो बहुत सादे विलेज के अंदर मान लो कोई लड़की है तो बिल्कुल मॉडर्न हो जाएगी।
says: If a girl lives in a very simple village she will turn thoroughly modern; Pluto reverses her to the opposite of her surroundings.

gist: Premise of the opposite example: 'a girl born in a very modern home'.

hindi: इतनी सादगी वाली होगी
says: A girl born in a very modern home will turn so simple and plain that people will be amazed; again Pluto reverses the household pattern.
ambiguity: Sentence ends 'you will be amazed' in the next chunk.

gist: 'You will be astonished', ending the previous sentence.
'Understand Pluto's nature', lead-in.

hindi: वो पलट देगा।
says: Pluto's nature is to reverse and flip whatever situation it touches.

hindi: बृहस्पति का स्वभाव समझ लो वह पकड़ लेगा, जकड़ लेगा कि ऐसे ही करो मेरे हिसाब से।
says: Jupiter's nature is to grip and bind, insisting that things be done his way.
classical_check: Differs in tone: Jupiter is classically the teacher and expander; the gripping is his reading.

hindi: सूर्य का मकसद क्या है कि छा जाऊंगा।
says: The Sun's purpose is 'I will dominate and cover everything'.
classical_check: Agrees with the Sun as authority and the dominant planet.

hindi: चंद्रमा का मकसद बह जाऊंगा।
says: The Moon's purpose is 'I will flow', adapting and drifting with feelings.
classical_check: Agrees with the Moon as the fluid, changing mind.

hindi: शनि मींस ढाप लूंगा।
says: Saturn's purpose is 'I will cover and suppress', to cover and hold things down.
classical_check: Agrees with Saturn as restriction and concealment.

gist: 'What is Pluto's purpose?'

hindi: बदल दूंगा।
says: Pluto's purpose is 'I will change it', to transform what exists.

hindi: तो ये जैसी स्थिति होगी उसको पलट देगा।
says: So whatever condition exists in the place Pluto touches, it will turn to its opposite; the outcome depends on the starting condition.
cells_derived_method: A prosperous house is flipped to loss and a lacking house to gain.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a rich 2nd house with Pluto is flipped toward loss of savings.
Derived: a poor-expense 12th with Pluto is flipped toward foreign gains.

gist: 'It can be that thing.'
Garbled line about the soul being in one place and a hole; no clear claim.
'What tension do they have?'
'I will take it out of his horoscope and tell you.'
'Your question is complicated.'

hindi: ऐसा नहीं है कि सूर्य आत्मा और मन की बात है।
says: It is not simply that the Sun means soul and the Moon means mind when they join; the combination is more than that.
ambiguity: Reply to the audience question; sense is loose.
classical_check: Differs from the standard Sun-soul and Moon-mind reading.

gist: 'This is a different thing.'

hindi: यह उसके सूचक है।
says: Sun and Moon are only indicators (soochak) of soul and mind, not the same as them.

hindi: सूर्य और चंद्रमा एक नंबर में साथ हो के हो सकता है दो नंबर राशि काम कर रही है।
says: With Sun and Moon together in house number 1, it may be that sign 2 is the one working in that house.
cells_derived_method: The 1st house is touched by the sign at its start and the next one; a planet near the end of the 1st-house sign may act through the next sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun and Moon in the 1st with Taurus as the working sign give a stable, resource-oriented self.
Derived: when Aries is the main sign of the 1st, the Taurus share carries a minor but real effect.

ambiguity: Which of the signs is dominant is decided by degree, as he says next.
classical_check: Agrees with the idea of houses spanning signs in bhava chalit; classically the sign remains the sign of the lagna.

hindi: हो सकता है 12 नंबर कर रही है साथ में।
says: Or sign 12 may be working along with it in that house, the other side of the first-house cusp.
cells_derived_method: The house span can include the previous sign too, so the preceding sign (12th) also touches the 1st.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the 1st house touched by Pisces gives a dreamy, imaginative flavour to the Sun and Moon.

hindi: दो राशि काम करती है।
says: Two signs work in a house: every house is touched by two signs together, not one.
cells_derived_method: Each house covers parts of two signs: a major and a minor. Apply both to every planet there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 7th with Libra major and Scorpio minor gets partnership flavour from Libra and intensity from Scorpio.
Derived: a planet in the 10th with Capricorn major and Aquarius minor gets authority from Capricorn and network flavour from Aquarius.

classical_check: Differs from Parashari equal-house reading and matches bhava chalit.

hindi: एक कभी नहीं करती।
says: A single sign never works alone in a house; there is always more than one.
classical_check: Differs from sign-house identity but agrees with bhava chalit.

hindi: हमेशा कसपल होता है।
says: There is always a cusp: the house is a meeting of two signs, a transition zone.
ambiguity: Caption word 'kasapal' is read as 'cusp'.
classical_check: Agrees with the bhava sandhi concept.

hindi: डोमिनेंट राशि देखनी पड़ती है हमारे को।
says: Of the two signs working in a house we must identify the dominant sign and read from it first.
cells_derived_method: Dominance is decided by the degree of the cusp; the sign with more of the house is major.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: when Cancer covers most of the 4th it is the dominant sign and Leo the minor one.
Derived: when Sagittarius covers most of the 9th it is dominant and Capricorn minor.

ambiguity: How dominance is measured is not stated.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with taking the bhava madhya sign as the main one.

hindi: तो ये आपके जीवन के अंदर खानपान का सिस्टम बदलेगा।
says: Pluto in the 4th will change the native's whole system of food and eating habits.
cells_derived_method: Which food change depends on the sign: Cancer changes home food habits, Gemini changes by influence of company, Scorpio by intensity or extremes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Cancer in the 4th changes home food customs and family diet.
Derived: Pluto in Scorpio in the 4th shifts diet to extremes or taboo foods.

classical_check: Silent: Pluto not classical; the 4th is not a classical food house.

gist: Premise: 'suppose Pluto is sitting in the 4th house'.

hindi: तो आप जैन परिवार में पैदा हुए हो सकता है आप मांसाहारी हो जाए।
says: If you were born in a Jain family you may become a meat-eater, the reversal of the home diet; recorded as his illustration of Pluto's reversal.
ambiguity: An illustration of reversal, not a rule about any religious group.

hindi: आप मांसाहारी परिवार में पैदा हो और आप कहेंगे मुझे नहीं चाहिए।
says: The reverse case: a native born in a meat-eating family refuses it; Pluto in the 4th flips the home diet either way.

hindi: यह इस प्रकार का पूर्ण परिवर्तन बदल के रख देता है जबरदस्त तरीके से।
says: This kind of total transformation is what Pluto does, with great force, to the ways of the house it sits in.

gist: 'Whose is the fifth house, number 5?'

hindi: ये सारा का सारा सूरज अंग सूरज देवता का है।
says: All of the 5th, the number 5 house and sign (Leo), belongs to the Sun god.
ambiguity: Sign 5 and house 5 are treated together.
classical_check: Agrees: Leo is ruled by the Sun and is the natural 5th.

gist: 'Of what is the Sun the god?'
'Let us understand the Sun's quality.'
'What is the Sun?'

hindi: राजा।
says: The Sun is the king, the ruler among planets.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is the king.

hindi: सूरज अ रॉयल्टी यार खानदान।
says: The Sun stands for royalty and the family lineage (khandan).
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is the karaka of father, lineage and royalty.

hindi: लाजवाब हिसाब जबरदस्त नॉलेज।
says: The Sun gives superb calculation ability and powerful knowledge.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun gives vidya through the 5th; calculation is more Mercury.

hindi: औरों को भी शिक्षा देना।
says: The Sun's quality includes giving education and teaching to others.
classical_check: Partly agrees: teaching is more Jupiter; the Sun gives the authority to guide.

hindi: लीडरशिप सबको बता दूंगा।
says: Leadership is the Sun's: 'I will tell everyone', an assertive, directing nature.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is the karaka of leadership.

hindi: पितरों की कृपा जबरदस्त तरीके से।
says: The Sun brings the blessing of the ancestors (pitra) very powerfully.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is the pitru karaka.

hindi: हर तरह का नेता यह है नेता हीरो एंटरटेनमेंट दूरदर्शिता विज़ सूर्य की क्वालिटी
says: Every type of leader, hero, entertainment and farsighted vision are listed as the Sun's qualities.
classical_check: Partly agrees: leaders and fame are Sun; entertainment is classically more Venus and 5th house.

hindi: अब सूर्य के घर में पहुंच गया।
says: Now Pluto has reached the Sun's house, sign 5 (Leo), the sign of royalty and lineage.
ambiguity: Subject Pluto implied.

hindi: अब सूर्य चाहे यहां है यहां है यहां है।
says: Wherever the Sun itself may sit in the chart (here, there or elsewhere), it makes no difference to this slide; only sign 5 with Pluto is being studied.
ambiguity: Loose gestural statement.

gist: 'Where is the number-5 sign?'

hindi: कहीं भी है हम यहां पर लेके चल रहे हैं।
says: Sign 5 may be anywhere in a chart; for this walk-through it is taken as sitting in the 5th house.
classical_check: Silent: a simplification of the method.

hindi: ये पांचवा भाव जो है ये संतान का है।
says: The 5th house is the house of children.

hindi: पितरों का है।
says: The 5th house also stands for the ancestors (pitra).
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 5th shows purva punya and lineage; the father line is mainly the 9th.

hindi: और इस पांचवें भाव के अंदर आपका सूर्य का आधिपत्य होता है।
says: Over the 5th house the Sun holds lordship (adhipatya), as Leo is the natural 5th sign.
ambiguity: This lordship holds when Leo is on the 5th; for other lagnas the lord differs.
classical_check: Agrees only when Leo is the 5th sign (Aries lagna).

hindi: यानी सूर्य जीवन चलाता है।
says: So the Sun runs life; the house of the Sun is the house that keeps life going.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is the karaka of the life force.

gist: 'Now who has reached number-5 sign?'

hindi: प्लूटो पहुंच गया।
says: Pluto has reached sign 5 (Leo); the slide now studies Pluto in the Sun's sign.

gist: 'What is Pluto?'
'Where has Yamraj (Pluto, god of death) reached?'
'In the house of life, what will it do?'

hindi: नाश पीट देगा।

Derived: Pluto in Leo in the 9th damages fortune and fatherly or ancestral support.

hindi: आपकी रॉयल्टी खा जाएगा।
says: It will eat up your royalty: status, rank and dignity.

hindi: आपके खानदान को तोड़फोड़ के नष्ट भ्रष्ट करके सत्यानाश करके रख देगा।
says: It will smash, corrupt and ruin your family lineage (khandan).
ambiguity: Starts at 1:14:03 and ends in the next caption chunk.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Leo in the 5th blocks romance and affection with children.

classical_check: Agrees that the 5th is the house of love; Pluto not classical.

says: The Sun gives light to everyone alike; generosity and impartial giving are its nature.
classical_check: Agrees with the Sun's generous nature.

hindi: ये सबको कहेगा ऐसी की तैसी सबको रोशनी नहीं देनी।
says: Pluto in the Sun's sign makes the native say 'to hell with everyone, I will not give light to anyone', i.e. he withholds what he has from all.

hindi: महास्वार्थी बनना है।
says: The native wants to become extremely selfish.

hindi: घटिया नेचर पे आना है।
says: He descends to a low, mean nature.

hindi: लीचड़ बनना है।
says: He turns stingy and petty (leechad), a miserly rascal.

hindi: लूट मारो, खसोट कर दो।
says: He loots and plunders, grabbing what he can from others.

gist: Comment 'how powerfully it has made things negative'.

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर पढ़ाई पूरी नहीं होगी।
says: In life your studies will remain incomplete.

hindi: कमाई पूरी नहीं होगी।
says: Your earnings will not be complete; income remains short.

hindi: संतान का हिसाब दिक्कत करेगा।
says: The matter of children will cause difficulty.
classical_check: Agrees that an afflicted 5th troubles progeny.

hindi: संतान होने के बाद आप दुखी रहोगे।

hindi: आपका एक पैर आपको तंग करेगा।
says: One of your legs or feet will trouble you (Pluto's body area); a tradition correlation, not a diagnosis.

hindi: आपको सेक्सुअल प्रॉब्लम, गायनी प्रॉब्लम, यूरिनरी प्रॉब्लम्स ये सारी की सारी बैठेंगी।
says: Sexual, gynaecological and urinary problems all become part of the picture; recorded as his claim about this placement, not a diagnosis.

hindi: यह एक और आठ नंबर यहां बैठ गया तो शादी खराब कर देगा।
says: If this sign-1 or sign-8 Pluto sits in the marriage house it spoils the marriage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Aries in the 7th spoils marriage through conflict and domination.
Derived: Pluto in Scorpio in the 7th spoils marriage through suspicion and intensity.

ambiguity: 'Yahan' is taken as the 7th since the topic is marriage; the caption does not say it.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars signs afflict the 7th.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया आपको ससुराल ऐसा मिलेगा जिसमें सासससुर में से एक जीवित है।
says: Placed here, you get an in-law family in which only one of the mother-in-law and father-in-law is alive.
ambiguity: The house is not clear from the caption; it may be the 7th or the 8th. This is a family-longevity claim recorded as his words.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया धर्म स्थान में तो ये ऐसा मिलेगा आपको धर्म जिसको आप मानोगे ही नहीं।
says: Placed in the place of dharma (9th), you get a religion you will not believe in at all.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Aries in the 9th makes the native rebel openly against inherited religion.
Derived: Pluto in Scorpio in the 9th makes the native distrust and secretly reject inherited faith.

hindi: आपको कोई

ambiguity: Sentence split by the caption boundary.

hindi: चाहिए ही नहीं।
says: He needs no one at all, neither a guru nor any religious guidance.
ambiguity: Completes the previous sentence 'you [do not need] anyone'.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया बेरोजगार कर देगा।
says: Placed in the place of work (10th), it makes the native jobless.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Aries in the 10th makes the native jobless through clashes with bosses.
Derived: Pluto in Scorpio in the 10th makes the native jobless through intrigue and hidden enemies.

ambiguity: The 10th is inferred from 'rozgar' (employment).
classical_check: Agrees that malefics in the 10th disturb career.

hindi: एक और आठ नंबर मींस नष्ट।
says: Numbers 1 and 8 (the Mars signs Aries and Scorpio) mean destruction for Pluto's results.

gist: 'Understand it this way: what is the planet's fruit?'

hindi: पांच नंबर भी नेगेटिव है इसका।
says: Sign 5 (Leo) is also negative for Pluto.

hindi: एक और आठ तो महासत्यानाश है।
says: Signs 1 and 8 together with Pluto give the worst, total ruin, worse than sign 5.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया तो महा कंजूस होगा आदमी।
says: Placed here (a house not named), the man becomes extremely miserly.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Scorpio in the 2nd makes extreme miserliness around money and family funds.

ambiguity: House unspoken; the wealth house (2nd) is the likely context.

hindi: महा लालची होगा।
says: He will be extremely greedy.

hindi: एक का धन का लाभ नहीं होगा।

ambiguity: 'Ek ka' is garbled; read as 'number-one (honest) money'.

hindi: दो नंबर के पैसे काम कमाई करेगा।
says: He will earn through number-two (black or illegitimate) money.
ambiguity: 'Do number' is slang for unaccounted income.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया तो स्पिरिचुअल लोगों को गाली बकेगा।

hindi: फकीरों को गाली बकेगा।
says: He will also abuse fakirs, wandering holy men.

hindi: दान के नाम पर कुछ नहीं।
says: He gives nothing in the name of charity.

hindi: भयंकर बीमार रहेगा।
says: He will remain terribly sick; recorded as his claim about this combination, not a diagnosis.

hindi: हॉस्पिटल जाकर धन खर्च के भी उसको ठीक नहीं होना।

hindi: भाव अलग कहानी है।

hindi: अगर यहां पर प्लूटो आपका सत्यानाश पीट के चलता है तो यह हिटलर जैसी स्थिति बना देता है।
says: If Pluto wrecks everything in sign 5 it makes a Hitler-like state in the native: a ruthless, destructive disposition.

Derived: Pluto in Leo in the 10th shows a tyrannical style in position of power.

hindi: इसलिए पांच नंबर की राशि का जो प्लूटो कहीं भी बैठा है यहां बैठा पांच नंबर यहां बैठा पांच यहां बैठा यहां बैठा पांच नंबर का जहां बैठा है समझो हिटलर आ गया
says: Pluto in sign 5, wherever it sits in the chart, in any house, means a Hitler-type has arrived in that house's affairs.
cells_derived_method: The 'Hitler' effect hits the house where Pluto sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Leo in the 4th brings a tyrannical force into home and mother affairs.
Derived: Pluto in Leo in the 7th brings a domineering, merciless spouse or partner.
Derived: Pluto in Leo in the 11th brings ruthless friends or gains by force.

hindi: और वो क्या करेगा सफाया
says: And what it will do there is wipe out; total clearance of whatever exists in that house.

hindi: उसको समझा नहीं सकते
says: Such a Pluto cannot be made to understand; the person under it cannot be convinced by explanation.

hindi: उसको बता नहीं सकते
says: You cannot tell it anything; it accepts no information or advice.

hindi: उसके साथ बैठकर बात नहीं कर सकते

hindi: उसको कोई रिश्वत नहीं दे सकते

hindi: उसे कुछ कह ही नहीं सकते

'It is dharma, friend.'

hindi: मौत तो एक धर्म है।
says: Death is itself a dharma, a law of nature that must be accepted.

gist: 'So it will go.'

hindi: ऐसे लोग ये कहते हैं हां जाएगा तो जाए।
says: People with a strong Pluto say 'if it goes, let it go'; they take loss and endings with detachment.

gist: 'No matter, end it.'

hindi: अपने को कोई चिंता नहीं है जाने की आने की अगर आपके अंदर एक गुण है ऐसा स्वभाव आप बनाते हैं कि भैया हमें टेंशन नहीं है इस चीज की हमने ओके कर लिया समझ लो प्लूटो लाजवाब चल रहा है
says: If you have the trait of not worrying about things coming and going, with the attitude 'I have accepted it, no tension', take it that your Pluto is working excellently.

gist: 'Often people are afraid of working, shirkers', set-up for the next point.

hindi: अगर यहां खराब राशि का प्लूटो हो 10 नंबर नहीं है मान लो आठ है पांच है तो आप कामचोर है
says: If Pluto sits in the 10th (work house) in a bad sign, say sign 8 or 5 rather than sign 10, you are a work-shirker.
cells_derived_method: The shirking trait appears when a bad sign of Pluto lies in the work house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Scorpio in the 10th shows avoidance of regular work, with hidden or irregular dealings.
Derived: Pluto in Leo in the 10th shows ego-driven avoidance of ordinary work, wanting only a leader's role.

ambiguity: 'Yahan' is the 10th house; 'not number 10' means the sign is not Capricorn.

hindi: वैसे ही प्लूटो बहुत धीमा है और धीमा हो गया जब यहां 10 नंबर का बैठा है 11 नंबर का अगर बैठा है
says: Pluto is already very slow, and it becomes slower still when sign 10 or sign 11 (Capricorn or Aquarius) is seated there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Capricorn in the 10th makes work pace extremely slow and deliberate.
Derived: Pluto in Aquarius in the 11th makes the arrival of gains very slow, though large.

ambiguity: Sentence continues into the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees that Capricorn and Aquarius are Saturn's slow signs.

hindi: यहां मान लो तो सोचो कितना धीरे चलता है धर्मराज प्लूटो कितना धीमे चलता है
says: Imagine how slowly Dharmaraj Pluto moves in such signs: extremely slow and unhurried.

hindi: क्या करेगा राजा जा बनाएगा।
says: It makes such a person like a king (raja) in manner, working at a lordly, unhurried pace; caption words are partly garbled.
ambiguity: 'Raja ja banayega' is garbled; read as 'will make him a raja'.

gist: 'What will such people do?'
Example quote: 'I go to this office only once a month.'
Example: that man must have many offices.
Example: he will go once a month, once in six months.
Example: he has no time for that office.

hindi: राजा है क्योंकि अपनी राशि का है।
says: He is a king because Pluto is in its own sign (sign 11, Aquarius in his scheme) and so rules without hurry.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Aquarius in the 11th acts as a king, with large gains and command over networks.

ambiguity: 'Apni rashi' is read as sign 11, Pluto's own sign by his earlier statement.
classical_check: Differs: classically Aquarius belongs to Saturn; Pluto as co-lord is his scheme.

gist: 'What do we do?'

hindi: सारे हबड़बड़ हबड़बड़ जल्दबाजी करने वाले ने अपने बुध के अंडर काम करना होता है।
says: Hurried, flustered workers belong to Mercury; haste and quick bustling work are Mercury's style.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is quick and restless.

gist: 'And I will do it totally at leisure.'
'Who are the rajas and maharajas?'

hindi: यह प्लूटो, शनि, यूरेनस, नेप्च्यून इनके द्वारा कंट्रोलोल्ड है।
says: Rajas and maharajas are controlled by Pluto, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune, the slow outer planets.
classical_check: Differs: classically kings are the Sun's and Jupiter's; Saturn gives rule over the masses.

hindi: एक के पास नर्क लोक है, एक के पास स्वर्ग लोक है, एक के पास यमलोक है।
says: One of these planets holds the world of hell, one holds heaven, and one holds the realm of Yama; the outer planets govern the three worlds.
ambiguity: He does not say which planet holds which world; Uranus (Indra) would be heaven and Pluto (Yama) the Yamaloka by his own scheme.

gist: 'These three deities are like this.'
'Think now, nobody can escape from this.'
'Everyone wants heaven.'
'Nobody wants hell.'
'But it comes.'

hindi: क्योंकि जितना नर्क आएगा उतना ही स्वर्ग आएगा।
says: As much hell comes, that much heaven comes; sorrow and joy come in equal measure in life.

gist: Analogy: the more sugar added, the sweeter it gets.
Joke: the more water you drink, the more you urinate.
Analogy: the more food eaten, the fuller the stomach.

hindi: तो ये तो बाय प्रोडक्ट है।
says: So hell is a by-product of heaven; difficulties come automatically along with blessings.

hindi: प्लस और माइनस हमेशा बराबर चलेगा।
says: Plus and minus always run equal: the total of pleasure and pain stays balanced over a life.
ambiguity: Sentence crosses the caption boundary.

gist: Example speech: 'Oh, I will be married and I will be happy.'
'Will you really be that happy, sister?'

hindi: 11 ग्राम 11 ही ग्राम दुख मिलेगा प्लूटो निश्चित करेगा इतना मिलेगा
says: For 11 grams of happiness you get exactly 11 grams of sorrow; Pluto fixes the quantity and balances it.
ambiguity: A figurative measure in grams.

hindi: फिर मैं तो 25 ग्राम सुखी हो जाऊंगी 25 ग्राम दुख मिलेगा
says: If you are happy to the extent of 25 grams, you will receive 25 grams of sorrow in the same ratio.

gist: Example: 'they have 120 grams of happiness, they even have a private plane and jet'.

hindi: बहुत भयंकर दुख आएंगे तेरे जीवन में सह नहीं पाएगी 120 ग्राम ही आएगा
says: With 120 grams of happiness comes 120 grams of terrible sorrow that you cannot bear; the pain scales with the happiness.

hindi: ये ऑटोमेटिक जितना बड़ा पेड़ ऊपर जाएगा उतना नीचे जाएगा
says: It is automatic: the higher a tree grows, the deeper its roots go; rise and depth are linked.

hindi: जितने आप साधु बनेंगे उतना आपके अंदर शैतान होना जरूरी है
says: The more saintly you become, the more devil there must be in you: duality means each virtue has an equal opposite.

gist: Garbled line about the observer effect of the devil via Rahu and how much was suppressed or set.

hindi: खेल वो है कि आपने इलेक्ट्रॉन को पॉजिट्रॉन बनाया या नहीं बनाया।
says: The game is whether you turned the electron into a positron, i.e. whether you converted a negative into a positive.
ambiguity: A physics metaphor for converting negatives to positives.

gist: 'If you have learnt that, fine; to whom do we keep giving water all the time?'
'To a plant.'
'What does that plant do?'
'It grows.'
'To what are you giving your attention energy in life?'

hindi: बीमारी बीमारी बीमारी बीमारी बढ़ गई।
says: If attention goes to illness, illness grows; what you feed with attention expands. A teaching about attention, not a medical statement.

hindi: प्यार प्यार प्यार प्यार बढ़ गया।
says: If attention goes to love, love grows; the same law applied to affection.

gist: 'Money, money, what do we often say?'
Quoted lament: 'there is no money, friend.'
Quoted wish: 'may money come.'
Quoted prayer: 'O God, give me money.'
'There is no money, friend', repeated.
'There is no money', repeated.
'You are saying just give me money.'

hindi: अंदर फील कर रहे हैं पैसा नहीं है और रोते रहते हैं पैसा नहीं है।
says: Inwardly you feel 'there is no money' and keep crying it, so your attention feeds the lack; focus on shortage keeps shortage alive.
ambiguity: A self-help principle, not an astrological rule; 2nd house is the nearest wealth topic.

gist: 'To whom are you giving the water?'
Garbled 'there is no money of attention at all'.
Sentence 'you are beggars...' cut off at the end of the slice.
Tail word of a sentence carried over from the previous slice ('...you will remain').
Mock list of victim complaints: my son is bad, uncle bad, sister bad, nephew bad, business bad.
Metaphor: you keep giving water to this complaining habit continuously.
Metaphor continued: with continuous watering the complaint keeps growing.

hindi: और प्लूटो क्या कर रहा है? बैलेंसिंग कर रहा है।
says: Pluto's job in the chart is balancing: while a person keeps feeding grievances and negativity so they grow out of proportion, Pluto works to trim and re-balance the situation.
cells_derived_method: Pluto's balancing/pruning acts on the life area of the house it occupies, with the manner coloured by the sign: fixed signs resist and force the cut, mutable signs adjust, movable signs act abruptly.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: pruning of family wealth habits and harsh speech patterns, done slowly and structurally (earth, Saturn-ruled sign).
Derived: sudden, forceful cutting-back of shared resources or hidden matters in the 8th house, impulsive style of the sign.
Derived: balancing of gains and friend circles, with relationships (Libra) being weighed and thinned out.

ambiguity: Pluto's balancing is stated in a general way here; the house/sign dependence is not given.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no Pluto; modern outer-planet doctrine.

gist: Aside to an audience member ('yes brother, take it') and a remark that he will surely die.

hindi: इसलिए ये भजन, ये रोना, ये पिटना आपको छोड़ना पड़ेगा।
says: The remedy he gives is to stop the habitual lamenting, crying and chest-beating over one's troubles; this must be given up before Pluto's pruning turns harsh.
ambiguity: 'Bhajan' here is used sarcastically for the repeated complaint chant, not devotional singing.
classical_check: Silent: a psychological remedy, not a classical rite.

gist: Rhetorical: what will the body say, what will the mind say?
Says you are used to crying for the last '150' (days or births, caption unclear).
Imagined objection: how can I leave it in one day?

hindi: ये जिसने सीख लिया साक्षी भाव ऑन दवां घर और 11वां घर न्याय करा के देंगे आपकी लाइफ सेट तक।
says: Whoever learns the witness attitude (sakshi bhav) will get justice from the 10th and 11th houses, and life will settle into place.
cells_derived_method: Justice and settling come through career/karma (10th) and gains/fulfilment (11th); the sign on each house decides the channel: earth signs give it through work and results, air signs through networks, water signs through feeling and closure, fire signs through action.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: settling through steady career structure and recognised karma.
Derived: justice and gains arrive via communication, contacts and trading circles.
Derived: karma is rewarded through care-giving, public emotional connection, home-linked work.

ambiguity: Caption 'ऑन दवां घर' is garbled; read as 'दसवां घर' (10th house).
classical_check: Silent on witness attitude; 10th and 11th are classically karma and gains.

hindi: ज्ञानी बना देगा।
says: The result of this witness attitude (via the 11th house) is that the person becomes wise or knowledgeable.
cells_derived_method: Wisdom shows in the manner of the 11th-house sign: air signs through ideas and groups, water signs through intuition, earth signs through practical learning, fire signs through direct experience.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: wisdom through humanitarian, group and scientific thinking.
Derived: wisdom through crisis, research and transformation of friendships.

ambiguity: Subject of 'will make wise' is unclear: witness attitude or the 11th house.
classical_check: Silent: classically 11th is gains, not wisdom.

hindi: 11वां घर एनलाइटेंड करता है।
says: The 11th house is the house that enlightens: planets and signs placed there give understanding and awakening in that area.
cells_derived_method: The enlightenment theme of the 11th takes the nature of the sign on it and of any planet in it, so the area awakened differs by house lord and sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: awakening through philosophy, teachers and higher learning.
Derived: awakening through analysis, service and refinement of daily habits.
Derived: awakening through surrender, spiritual practice and compassion.

classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat the 11th as gains (labha) and elder siblings, not enlightenment; this is Gautam's own association (Pluto/Uranus-style).

gist: Aside: people say 'enlightened beings'.

hindi: 11 नंबर राशि में प्लूटो कुंडली में जहां बैठा है उस क्षेत्र में व्यक्ति एनलाइटेंड है।
says: Pluto in the 11th sign (Aquarius, in his scheme Pluto's own sign) makes the person enlightened in whatever life area the house it sits in represents.
cells_derived_method: The enlightened area is the house where Aquarius falls; the lagna decides which house that is, so the same placement shows awareness in different life fields.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: self-awareness and personal identity are the enlightened area.
Derived: awareness in partnership and marriage matters (lagna Leo).
Derived: enlightened in career and public karma (lagna Taurus).

ambiguity: '11 number rashi' could mean Aquarius (sign 11) or the 11th house; the phrase 'where it sits' suggests house, but 'rashi' points to sign. Recorded as Aquarius.
classical_check: Silent: Pluto not in classical texts.

gist: Says he recently saw someone's wife.
Case: a wife by mistake formed a contact with another man and had a baby.
Her husband said never mind, stay together, mistake forgiven.
Think what a great king he is (sentence runs into next slice).
Tail word of the previous sentence ('that one').

hindi: सप्तम भाव में प्लूटो दूषित है।
says: Pluto placed in the 7th house is afflicted or tainted; in marriage and partnership it brings complicated, irregular situations like the case just narrated.
cells_derived_method: The 7th-house sign sets the style of the partnership complication: Libra (Venus) gives it through attraction and bargaining, Scorpio (Mars/Uranus) through intensity and secrecy, Pisces through illusion and sacrifice.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: partner relations are weighed and negotiated; tainted bonds are tolerated for balance (lagna Aries).
Derived: intense, secretive, possessive partnership entanglements (lagna Taurus).
Derived: confusion, idealisation and boundary-blurring in partnership (lagna Virgo).

ambiguity: He says 'dooshit' (afflicted) without naming the cause; may be a general Pluto-in-7th claim.
classical_check: Silent: Pluto absent from classical texts; 7th house is classically spouse.

gist: The husband legalised the child by giving it his name.
They already had three children.

hindi: अब वो ग्रह है वो दे के रहेगा।
says: A planet, once its time and placement are set, will certainly deliver its results; moral resistance does not stop it.
ambiguity: Planet is implied to be Pluto from context.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with classical fatalism of karma phala, but the doctrine also allows remedies.

gist: Challenge: go ahead, try to uproot it.
Rhetorical: what will you uproot?

hindi: जायज नाजायज लीगल इललीगल रिश्ते देगा।
says: Pluto gives relationships both legitimate and illegitimate, legal and illegal; it does not respect social labels.
cells_derived_method: Which kind of relationship appears depends on the sign on the 7th: Scorpio and Aries give forceful, secretive ties; Gemini gives multiple or talk-based ties; Capricorn gives status or duty-based ties that may be formalised later.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: secret or taboo ties that become public through crisis.
Derived: more than one connection, with a dual or changeable status (lagna Sagittarius).
Derived: ties for status or obligation, later formalised on paper (lagna Cancer).

ambiguity: House 7 is inferred from the previous sentence; he does not repeat it.
classical_check: Silent: Pluto absent from classical texts.

gist: Repeated challenge: go ahead, uproot it.
Imagined critics: people will say don't do dirty deeds, don't speak dirty.

hindi: अरे गंदी और अच्छी बात नहीं होती।
says: In his view there is no inherently dirty or good deed at the level of planets; behaviour follows what the planet makes the person do, so moral labels do not explain it.
ambiguity: Philosophical remark; no cell dependence.
classical_check: Differs from dharma-based classical ethics which does judge deeds; this is his own deterministic framing.

hindi: ग्रह करा रहा है।
says: It is the planet that is making the person act; actions are driven by the planetary placement rather than free choice.
ambiguity: Which planet is not stated.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical view of grahas as agents of karma.

hindi: वो करके छोड़ेगा।
says: The planet will not stop until it has finished the action it is driving; it completes its result to the end.
ambiguity: Which planet is not stated.

gist: Repeated: you may try uprooting anything.
Mock advice: do not drink liquor.

hindi: तुम्हारी कुंडली में लिखा है कि तुम्हारे पांचवें और नौवें घर को डिस्टर्ब या डिस्टोर्ट करेगा ग्रह।
says: If the chart shows a planet disturbing or distorting the 5th and 9th houses, that person will be pulled towards intoxicants regardless of advice not to drink.
cells_derived_method: Which area is harmed through the habit depends on the signs on the 5th and 9th: fire signs push excess, water signs link it to emotion, air signs to company, earth signs to routine or appetite.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: escapism through intoxicants as a replacement for joy and creativity (lagna Scorpio).
Derived: excess and indulgence tied to beliefs, travel or teachers (lagna Aries).
Derived: compulsive, hidden habits linked to the mind and emotions (lagna Cancer).

ambiguity: The disturbing planet is not named; the 5th and 9th are the Jupiter-trikona houses.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts link afflicted 5th/9th and Jupiter to loss of judgment; no specific rule about alcohol.

hindi: तुम्हारी किडनी लीवर जाएगा।
says: He says such a person's kidneys and liver can be ruined; this is a health claim from the affliction of the 5th and 9th houses and is recorded as his tradition claim only, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Medical claim; not to be used as a diagnosis. Houses carried over from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Partly: Jupiter and the 5th are classically linked to liver, but kidney is not tied to the 5th/9th.

gist: Says anything can go wrong.

hindi: बृहस्पति के अंडर होगा तो लिवर जाएगा।
says: If the affliction falls under Jupiter's rule, it is the liver that suffers; Jupiter is the karaka of the liver in this reading (health claim, tradition only).
cells_derived_method: The liver link follows Jupiter's houses: Jupiter-ruled or Jupiter-occupied 5th/9th signs (Sagittarius, Pisces) bring the effect to the person; elsewhere through Jupiter's aspect.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter's own sign on the 9th, liver link strongest (lagna Aries).
Derived: Jupiter's own sign in the 5th, affliction ties to liver and over-indulgence (lagna Scorpio).

ambiguity: 'Under Jupiter' could mean Jupiter's sign, its star, or its dasha.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is classically karaka of the liver and fat (medical astrology texts).

gist: You eat the best food.
Mentions Baba Ramdev's own brother.
Says Balkrishna ji had a heart attack.
Rhetorical: what do they sell to the whole world?
They sell detox medicine yet he had a heart attack.
There are people who smoke cigarettes.
Their heart is not affected.
There are people who are pure Sufi saints.
Their liver and kidneys are failing.

hindi: सारा खेल एनर्जी का है।
says: Whole outcome is a game of energy, not of lifestyle or diet; the energy pattern in the chart decides who falls ill or stays well.
ambiguity: 'Energy' is not defined in the sentence.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts also say karma, not lifestyle, decides the result, loosely similar.

gist: 'It depends on Mona ne...' sentence breaks off into the next slice.
Mona mentally left all her troubles with the Teele-wale Baba (tail of a story).
She felt light.

hindi: अगर हल्की हो गई बहन तो शरीर ठीक हो जाएगा।
says: If the person feels light after unloading the mind's burdens, the body will heal; he links bodily well-being to mental release (tradition claim, not a medical statement).
ambiguity: Health claim; recorded as his view only.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts treat health via 1st, 6th and 8th houses and planets, not as mind-lightening.

gist: Garbled opening: says that in ordinary (other) countries this is taught, introducing a game.
There are 10 children.
They are told: we will play musical chairs.
The music will play.
Nine chairs are being placed while the music beats.
Running around, when music stops whoever has a chair sits and the one without leaves the game.
All the children start fighting.
Child thinks: I will not give this one a chair.
He should not get one.
Go to hell, I will push and drop him.
One is always left out.
Nine sit down.
Nine children circle around.
One chair is removed.
They make it eight.
Music plays again.
Again: I will push and drop him.
One is bound to fall.
With eight, seven, six chairs, at the end what does the child think?
All others are worthless.
Only I am there.
Rhetorical: what feeling developed?
To hell with everyone.
I must be the one to stay up.
Question: what game do they play in Japan?
Claims the most people live longest in Japan.
Rhetorical: why does Yamraj not come there for the longest lives?
Imagined objection: astrology is not true there.
Why do people not die there?
Why do they die here?
Died early, at 60.
Why do they die there at 100?
There is an island where all are above 100 years.
Checks with audience: okay, brother, perhaps that name.
'I think so'; now tell me why that is.
Because when musical chairs starts there, nine chairs are placed.
Ten children told nine chairs for ten; whoever does not sit goes out; they adjust somehow and all sit.
They squeeze in somehow on nine chairs and the children say wow very good.
One more chair is removed, eight chairs for ten; they say hard but let us manage, you sit in my lap.
I will sit on the chair.
Sound of music beats, fewer chairs.
Then chairs are cut to seven, six, five, four.
Then someone sits in someone's lap (sentence breaks off).
Some in laps, some leaning on others, they keep playing like this.
No one must fall.
Do not let anyone go.
At the end the chairs do get removed and children fall.
Rhetorical: but what was learned?

hindi: जोड़ से चलेंगे।
says: The lesson of the game is to move together, in connection, not alone; he later ties this to staying out of Yama's (Pluto's) reach.
ambiguity: Metaphor from a game, not a chart rule.

hindi: इसकी शक्ति ले लेंगे, उसकी शक्ति लेंगे।
says: Take strength from one person and from another; draw support from many people, which he treats as a protective behaviour against Pluto's loss-and-ending effects.
ambiguity: Behavioural advice only; no chart cell given.

hindi: जब तक दूसरे से शक्ति नहीं लेंगे, मदद नहीं लेंगे, भाई सर्वाइव कैसे करेंगे?
says: Without taking power and help from others you cannot survive; isolation and ego-driven self-reliance are what endanger survival, so asking for help is protective.
ambiguity: Rhetorical question; framed as general life advice.

gist: Rhetorical: where is Yamraj?

hindi: आप जितनी टीम सेट करके चलोगे, जितना जुड़ के चलोगे, जितना साथ सहारा लेने से कतराओगे नहीं।
says: The more team and connections you build, and the less you shy from taking company and support, the less room Yama (Pluto) finds to act; sentence leads to the next line about Yama's reaction.
ambiguity: Incomplete clause; conclusion is in the next sentence.

hindi: यमराज कहेगा यार किसे मारू?
says: For a person who is well connected, Yamraj (Pluto) will be left asking whom to strike; his destructive action finds no weak point.
ambiguity: Story-like phrasing; death imagery is figurative.

hindi: ना प्यार मरेगा, ना साथी मरेगा, ना पैसा मरेगा।
