hindi: ये आप अपने चरण पकड़ो ये भाई के ये अपने परिवार वालों के पकड़ो अपने काम करने वाले वर्कर्स के
says: Examples of whose feet to hold, pointing at chart houses: your own, brother's, family's and your workers'; likely the 1st, 3rd, 2nd and 6th houses.
ambiguity: He points at houses while speaking; the house numbers are not audible, so the mapping is guessed.

hindi: यहां और यहां होता है उनका भी ध्यान रखो
says: Look after the people in the other houses he points to as well.
ambiguity: Houses pointed at are not named.

hindi: प्रेम करो प्लूटो सेट है
says: Love them and Pluto becomes set (settled, propitiated); love is the stated key to calming Pluto.

hindi: ये आपके भाई और बहन हो गए या आपके बाल बच्चे बच्चों के चरण पकड़ने हैं
says: If it is your siblings or your own children, you must hold their feet, including those of young children.
cells_derived_method: Siblings point to the 3rd and 11th, children to the 5th; the remedy applies when Pluto is in those houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 3rd, respect younger siblings.
Derived: Pluto in the 5th, show humility to your children.
Derived: Pluto in the 11th, respect elder siblings and friends.

ambiguity: House numbers inferred, not stated.

gist: Story: a sage returned from the Himalayas and put the baby Buddha's feet on his head because Buddha was born.
We coo to small children.
We touch their feet to our heads.
How lovely the baby is.

hindi: सोचो कितनी पवित्र आत्मा होती है क्योंकि उसमें अभी वीर्य और रज नहीं बना।
says: A small child is a pure soul because the generative substances (semen and ovum) have not yet formed in it; this is his reason for bowing to children.
ambiguity: A biology-flavoured claim; his own rationale.

gist: Joke: the little one has not switched on yet.
Joke: both have thin voices.
Points: this one is an enemy.

hindi: शत्रु के भी हाथ जोड़ लो।
says: Fold your hands even to an enemy; humility towards enemies is part of the Pluto remedy.
ambiguity: House 6 is the enemy house and is inferred; he does not state a house.

hindi: उसके भी चरण पकड़ लो।
says: Hold the enemy's feet as well, bowing down fully to the one who opposes you.
ambiguity: House 6 inferred.

hindi: माफ कर दो।
says: Forgive; releasing grudges is the closing step of the remedy.

hindi: निकाल दो अंदर से।
says: Remove the grudge from inside yourself completely, not just on the surface.

hindi: शुद्ध बुद्धि होगी।
says: The result of forgiving is a pure intellect; the mind clears.

hindi: पति और पत्नी को माफ कर देना।
says: Forgive the husband and the wife, that is, the spouse in marriage conflicts (the 7th-house relationship).
ambiguity: 7th house is inferred from 'spouse'.

hindi: छोड़ देना।
says: Let it go; drop the matter instead of carrying it forward.

hindi: जहां भाई यमराज ने माफ कर दिया।
says: Where you forgive, Yamraj (Pluto) forgives you; his mercy mirrors your own forgiveness.

gist: Remark: death just touched and went away.
They were saved.
These days there are clips like that on the internet.
A man is standing there.
A rock falls here, doesn't it?
It just passes by the side.
Joke caption: who saved you?
Was Yamraj on leave that day?
Such captions get written on clips.
So Yamraj was on leave.
Rhetorical: and whose help does Yamraj take?

hindi: कुत्ते के थ्रू।
says: Yamraj works through the dog; the dog is his agent or helper.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Yama's dogs appear in the Puranas; classical astrology links dogs to Ketu.

hindi: पूंछ वाला जानवर।
says: The tailed animal; the creature with a tail is Yamraj's channel (tail suggests Ketu symbolism).
ambiguity: Ketu link is my inference from 'tail'; he does not say Ketu here.

hindi: आप कुत्ते का ध्यान रखें।
says: Remedy: take care of dogs, since the dog is Yamraj's helper and treating it well pleases Pluto.
classical_check: Partly agrees: feeding dogs is a classical remedy for Ketu and Saturn.

hindi: अपने जो घर का कुत्ता है पतिपालतू जो उसके पट्टा बांधे तो टाइट ना बांधे।
says: If you keep a pet dog at home and put a collar on it, do not tie the collar tight.
ambiguity: 'पतिपालतू' is garbled (pet).

hindi: और दूसरी बात कुत्ते को भौकने दें।
says: Second instruction: let the dog bark; do not suppress it.

hindi: याद रखें जो कुत्ता भौकता नहीं वो किसी लायक नहीं।
says: A dog that does not bark is of no use; the bark is its purpose, so restraining it defeats the Yamraj-helper function.

gist: Joke: the husband can also stand in place of the dog.
Joke: only the husband can be the dog's substitute.
Topic change: several people say there are men who are completely saintly.

hindi: जिन लोगों को आत्मिक तृप्ति हो जाती है।
says: Defines the group under discussion: people who attain inner (soul) satisfaction; the cause is given in the next sentence.
ambiguity: Incomplete clause.

hindi: वो सब केतु की कृपा से होता है।
says: Inner satisfaction and saintliness come through Ketu's grace; Ketu is the planet of renunciation and moksha.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is the classical karaka of moksha and detachment.

hindi: राहु की कृपा से होता है।
says: He also credits Rahu's grace for the same state; unusual, as Rahu normally stands for worldliness.
ambiguity: Could be a slip for the Rahu-Ketu axis, or a caption error.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts put moksha with Ketu, Rahu with worldly desire.

hindi: बुध उनका बिल्कुल डिस्टर्बड नहीं होता।
says: In such saintly charts Mercury is not disturbed; the intellect is clear of afflictions.

hindi: बृहस्पति डिस्टर्ब अस्त नहीं होता।
says: Jupiter is neither disturbed nor combust in such charts; the guru planet is clean.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter free of affliction is classically a condition for wisdom.

hindi: किसी किस्म से नेगेटिव राशि का नहीं होता है।
says: The planets are not placed in any negative sign such as debilitation or an enemy sign.
ambiguity: 'Negative sign' not defined.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: avoiding debilitation is a classical strength condition.

hindi: ऐसे लोग साधु व्यक्ति बन जाते हैं।
says: Such people, with Ketu's grace and clean Mercury and Jupiter, become saintly persons.

hindi: चार ग्रह एक साथ कुंडली में हो जाए सूर्य जिसमें जरूर होना चाहिए।
says: When four planets come together in one house of the chart, with the Sun necessarily among them, a renunciate yoga forms.
cells_derived_method: Any house can hold the four-planet conjunction; the house tells which life area is renounced (e.g. 7th, marriage; 2nd, family and wealth; 10th, career).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: four planets incl. Sun in 7th: strong pull to leave partnership/marriage matters.
Derived: Sun exalted in the 10th with three others: renunciation through public career and karma.
Derived: pull to ascetic philosophy and pilgrimage in Jupiter's sign.

ambiguity: Sun 'must' be included is his condition.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Pravrajya yoga needs four or more planets in a house, with details varying by text (Phaladeepika, Saravali).

hindi: तो चार ग्रह यदि साथ जुड़े जिसमें यूजुअली बुध या शुक्र साथ होता है।
says: In a four-planet combination, Mercury or Venus is usually the companion with the Sun, since they never wander far from it.
classical_check: Agrees as an astronomical fact: Mercury and Venus stay close to the Sun.

gist: Garbled: 'one planet stays together' (unclear).

hindi: बुध हो गया या शुक्र होगा दो और आ सकते हैं।
says: With the Sun, Mercury or Venus is present, and two more planets can join to make four.

hindi: जब ये ग्रह साथ हो जाते हैं तो साधु योग बन जाता है।
says: When these planets come together, a sadhu yoga (ascetic yoga) is formed.

hindi: इसे प्रवृजि योग कहते हैं जो बुध को भी था।
says: This yoga is called Pravrajya yoga, and it was present in Buddha's chart too (caption 'बुध' is probably Buddha, not Mercury).
ambiguity: 'बुध' can be Mercury or Buddha; the sense points to Gautama Buddha.
classical_check: Agrees on the name: Pravrajya yoga is the classical term for ascetic yoga.

hindi: तो ऐसे लोग साधु की तरह रहते हैं जीवन में।
says: People with this yoga live like sadhus in life, detached and simple.

hindi: अगर चार ग्रह साथ हो गए तो व्यक्ति विवाह करके भी परिवार छोड़ के चला जाएगा।
says: If four planets are together, the person will leave the family even after marrying; full renunciation overrides marriage.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts say Pravrajya yoga persons take sannyasa.

hindi: अगर चार साथ नहीं है तो घर नहीं छोड़ेगा
says: If fewer than four planets are together, the person does not leave home.

hindi: लेकिन शुक्र दब जाता है तो साधु बन जाता है
says: But if Venus is suppressed (weakened or overpowered), the person turns sadhu-like even without leaving home.
cells_derived_method: Venus is suppressed in Virgo (debilitated), by combustion near the Sun, or by Saturn/Ketu affliction; the house it holds shows which pleasures are lost.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Venus in the 7th, marital pleasure muted (lagna Pisces).
Derived: debilitated Venus in the 2nd, little interest in luxuries and food (lagna Leo).

ambiguity: 'Dab jata hai' not defined (debilitation, combustion or affliction).
classical_check: Partly agrees: weak Venus reduces sensual enjoyment.

hindi: ना वह ऐश में रहता ना अय्याशी में
says: Such a person lives neither in luxury nor in debauchery; indulgent pleasures are absent.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the karaka of luxury and sensual life.

hindi: और ऐसी स्थिति में पति और पत्नी में भी आपसी तौर पे बड़ा ही सद्भावना का रिश्ता रहता है
says: In this state husband and wife keep a relationship of great goodwill and mutual harmony.
ambiguity: 7th house is inferred from marriage.

hindi: प्रेम प्रेम नहीं रहता उतना क्योंकि आकर्षण नहीं होता साधुत्व योग के कारण से
says: Romantic love is not as strong in such marriages because attraction is missing, due to the ascetic yoga.
ambiguity: 7th house inferred.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: weak Venus lowers attraction.

hindi: आपकी बातें हमेशा इंटेलेक्चुअल हाइट पे जाती है।
says: Their talk always goes to an intellectual height, discussions of ideas rather than pleasure.

hindi: सादगी पर रहती है।
says: Their life and speech stay on simplicity; they live plainly.

hindi: सीधी रहती है।
says: Their conduct stays straightforward, without crookedness.

hindi: जरूरी नहीं कि आप समझदार हो या बहुत बड़े ज्ञान की बात करें।
says: It is not necessary that such a person is wise or speaks of great knowledge; the yoga gives detachment, not cleverness.

hindi: पर साधु योग का मतलब विरक्ति यह विरक्ति का हिसाब किताब यहां बनाता है यह।
says: Sadhu yoga means virakti (detachment); this placement sets up the account of detachment here.
ambiguity: 'Here' is the 11th house from the next line.

hindi: 11व घर में विरक्त करता है।
says: In the 11th house it creates detachment (virakti); the 11th is where this planet makes the person withdraw from desires.
cells_derived_method: Detachment colours the 11th's topics: gains, friends, elder siblings, fulfilment of desires; sign decides the area most affected.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: detachment from social ambition and income goals.
Derived: detachment from friend circles and wishes through spiritual surrender.
Derived: detachment from fame and recognition.

ambiguity: Planet is Pluto per the next sentence.
classical_check: Differs: classical 11th is desires fulfilled, not detachment.

hindi: डिटचमेंट का देवता यहां डिटचमेंट क्रिएट कर देता है।
says: Pluto, the god of detachment, creates detachment in the 11th house.

hindi: किसी भी चीज के प्रति ऐसी जिनजिन चीजों के प्रति आपको डिटचमेंट है समझो वहां पर प्लूटो आना है
says: Wherever you feel detachment from a thing, understand that Pluto has arrived there; detachment is the sign of Pluto's working.

gist: Example: sweets no longer pull me when I see them.
Example: let it lie there.
Example: someone's wealth lies there, it makes no difference to me.

hindi: आप यमराज को प्रसन्न कर रहे हैं।
says: By being detached you are pleasing Yamraj (Pluto).

hindi: आपकी बड़ी से बड़ी बीमारियां ठीक होंगी।
says: When Pluto is pleased, even your biggest illnesses will heal. Health claim recorded as his tradition claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Health claim; not medical advice.

gist: People defraud in money and in body.
They defraud with the eyes and looks.
These are quite normal things.

hindi: अगर ऐसे में आप धर्म अनुसार चलते हैं तो आपका प्लूटो यानी कि यमराज प्रसन्न रहता है।
says: If in such conditions you live according to dharma, your Pluto (Yamraj) stays pleased.
classical_check: Silent: dharma conduct is a general classical remedy.

hindi: आपकी चीजें मरती नहीं है आसानी से।
says: Your belongings and affairs do not die easily when Pluto is pleased; they last.

hindi: आपका गया हुआ धन मार नहीं सकता कोई।
says: Money that has gone from you cannot be killed (destroyed) by anyone; lost wealth can return when Pluto is pleased. Reading is uncertain.
ambiguity: Meaning unclear; 2nd house inferred from wealth. Not investment advice.

gist: Concession clause: however much pain or injury comes to your body.

hindi: यमराज फिर भी खड़ा रखेगा।
says: Yamraj will still keep you standing; the person survives despite injury and suffering when Pluto is pleased.

gist: Transition: let us take the small name of war (a topic).
On war, we will look at a case study if there is time.
Plans a later class on Pluto with the signs and combinations.

hindi: क्योंकि प्लूटो 21 साल एक राशि में पड़ा है
says: Pluto stays about 21 years in one sign, so a whole generation shares the same Pluto sign.
ambiguity: Actual stay varies from about 12 to 31 years; 21 is the average.
classical_check: Agrees as an average: Pluto takes about 248 years for the zodiac.

hindi: फिर कैसे काम कर रहा है और ग्रह घूम घूम के उसके साथ बटन दबा दबा के काम करते हैं
says: Then how does it work? Other, faster planets keep moving and press its button through conjunction or aspect, triggering its results.
classical_check: Silent: the idea matches the classical use of transit triggers over a natal promise.

gist: Sentence cut off: 'recently 21...' continues in next slice.

hindi: जनवरी को छह ग्रह एक लाइन में आ गए थे
says: In January six planets appeared lined up in the sky, the planetary parade he uses as the backdrop for his war prediction.
ambiguity: Year not stated; 'January' is the date he gives as 21 January later.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts treat multi-planet clusters (graha yuddha, grahamalika) as signs of disturbance in the country.

gist: Photo credit on a slide: photograph by Dario Giannobile (name garbled).

hindi: अभी रिसेंटली एक छोटा सा प्लेटरी कॉम्बिनेशन आया था जिसमें मंगल गुरु यूरेनस नेप्च्यून शनि शुक्र एक ही लाइन में आ गए थे आकाश में
says: Recently a planetary combination formed with Mars, Jupiter, Uranus, Neptune, Saturn and Venus in one line in the sky; this group of six is the combination he reads for war.
ambiguity: A line-up in the sky is not the same as a conjunction in one sign; he does not give signs here.

gist: Says you will see the Thor movie, which has an episode about gods above worldly life.
Thor is also a lightning god, compared with Indra, god of the hammer.
The hammer goes and returns flying.
Movie shows all planets in a line, Thor: The Dark World, where they go to find the Aether and enemy.
In the movie the planets align and the character says war is now certain.

hindi: तो अब सारे के सारे ग्रह एक लाइन में आए हुए हैं अभी 21 जनवरी को आए थे नेकेड आई से देख सकते थे अंतरिक्ष में।
says: All these planets arrived in one line on 21 January and could be seen with the naked eye in space; he fixes the date of the alignment.
ambiguity: Year not given. Uranus and Neptune are not naked-eye objects, so 'naked eye' is loose.

hindi: उसके बाद ऑटोमेटिकली ग्रहों का समकरण हुआ है।
says: After this, an equation of the planets formed on its own; the line-up set a combined planetary equation that he then reads planet by planet.
ambiguity: 'Samikaran' (equation) is not defined.

gist: Rhetorical: what has happened?

hindi: मंगल युद्ध का देवता है।
says: Mars is the god of war, the planet of battle and conflict.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the classical karaka of war, soldiers and battle.

hindi: हनुमान जी।
says: He identifies Mars with Hanuman as the deity of the planet.
ambiguity: A fragment; link to Mars inferred from the previous line.
classical_check: Agrees with the popular tradition: Hanuman is worshipped for Mars (Mangal) remedies.

hindi: जुपिटर ये कहता है मैं किसी की चलने नहीं दूंगा।
says: Jupiter's stance in this combination is that he will let nobody's will prevail; he overrules the others.

hindi: जुपिटर भयंकर ताकतवर है।
says: Jupiter is tremendously powerful, the strongest force in this group.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is the greatest benefic.

hindi: कभी खत्म नहीं हो सकता ये।
says: Jupiter can never be finished or destroyed; dharma and wisdom cannot be wiped out.

gist: Trailing 'it is just a matter of saying' (sentence breaks off).

hindi: यूरेनस यह इंद्र है।
says: Uranus is Indra in his scheme, the king of the gods.
classical_check: Silent: Uranus is not classical; the Indra mapping is Gautam's own.

hindi: लाइटनिंग का देवता है।
says: Uranus-Indra is the god of lightning, so sudden, flashing, electrical events belong to it.

hindi: इसके पास वज्र है।
says: Indra-Uranus holds the vajra (thunderbolt), a weapon of destruction.

hindi: कत्लेआम मचा सकता है ये।
says: Uranus can cause massacre; it is capable of mass destruction.

hindi: नेप्च्यून यह तूफान है।
says: Neptune is the storm, the planet of tempest and flooding force.

hindi: यह तो नर्क का देवता है।
says: Neptune is called the god of hell; he associates it with the underworld and torment.
ambiguity: Mythologically Neptune is the sea god; hell is his own association. Possibly the caption mixes it with Pluto.
classical_check: Differs: modern astrology links Neptune with sea and illusion, Pluto with the underworld.

hindi: नेप नेप्च्यून से खतरनाक योद्धा कोई नहीं है।
says: There is no warrior more dangerous than Neptune; he rates Neptune the deadliest fighter among the planets.

gist: Everyone knows what Lord Saturn does.

hindi: शुक्र मृत्युंजय
says: Venus is Mrityunjaya, the conqueror of death, as in Shukracharya's power to revive.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic tradition: Shukracharya holds the Mrityunjaya (Sanjivani) knowledge.

hindi: अब सारे एक से बढ़कर एक पावरफुल है।
says: All the six planets in the line are each more powerful than the last, so the combination is of great strength.

gist: Repeats: these have come in one line.
Repeats: they came on 21 January.

hindi: अब जब ये एक साथ आए तो एक कह रहा है मैं लडूंगा, एक कह रहा मैं युद्ध करूंगा, एक नाश पीटूंगा।
says: When they came together each planet asserted its own role: one will fight, one will make war, one will cause ruin; the combined effect is conflict and destruction.
ambiguity: Which planet says which is not given.

hindi: ऑटोमेटिकली ऐसी अराजकता फैली हुई है कि युद्ध के संकेत बनने शुरू हो गए।
says: Chaos has spread by itself, and indications of war have started to form; he reads this planetary combination as a war signal.
ambiguity: A mundane prediction about world events.

hindi: साथ में लिप्त हो गया जुपिटर यानी कि बृहस्पति।
says: Jupiter has also become involved in this combination, adding its weight to the planetary equation.

hindi: अब बृहस्पति जो है भारत बृहस्पति प्रधान देश है।
says: India is a Jupiter-dominant country, so Jupiter's movements bear on India's fate.
classical_check: Differs partly: classical mundane astrology (Brihat Samhita) assigns India's regions to various grahas; modern lore often says India is Jupiter-ruled.

hindi: अब 12 नंबर के अंदर नेप्च्यून शिफ्ट हुआ है अभी रिसेंटली मीन राशि में।
says: Neptune has recently shifted into sign number 12, Pisces.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Pisces falls in a different house for each lagna; its storm and illusion theme acts through that house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in its natural 12th, losses, escapism and spiritual dissolving.
Derived: Pisces lagna, blurred identity and idealism.
Derived: confusion or idealisation in partnerships.

ambiguity: Date of ingress is not given; he treats Pisces as Neptune's sign here (sidereal).

gist: Repeats: Neptune has shifted into number 12.

hindi: यूनस इंद्र अभी दो नंबर के अंदर है।
says: Uranus (Indra) is now in sign number 2, Taurus.
cells_derived_method: Uranus in Taurus lands in a different house for each lagna; sudden change acts on that house's topics.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: sudden changes in money and family.
Derived: abrupt career shifts and unusual work.
Derived: sudden turns in service, debts or health routines.

gist: Rhetorical: where is the god Indra now?

hindi: शुक्र की राशि के अंदर है।
says: Uranus-Indra is sitting in Venus's sign, Taurus; Venus is its host.

hindi: बहुत ताकतवर बैठे हुए हैं।
says: Indra-Uranus is sitting very strong in Venus's sign; the placement is powerful.
ambiguity: Strength criterion is not given.

gist: Rhetorical: what is Indra's relation with Venus?

hindi: राग रंग, महफिल, मौज, मस्ती।
says: The Indra-Venus link means revelry: music and colour, gatherings, merriment and fun; Uranus in Venus's sign gives pleasure-seeking events.
classical_check: Agrees on Venus: music, pleasure and festivity; Indra's court (apsaras) is the Puranic link.

gist: Repeats: Neptune has come in number 12.
Rhetorical: where has the god of storms come?

hindi: केतु में आया है।
says: Neptune has come into Ketu's sign (Pisces, which he gives to Ketu as lord); the storm god sits in Ketu's home.
ambiguity: Pisces lords here are Jupiter or Ketu in his scheme; he picks Ketu.
classical_check: Differs: classical lord of Pisces is Jupiter; Ketu as lord is a later or modern allocation.

gist: Rhetorical: what does it do in Ketu's sign, Ketu's house?

hindi: केतु के घर में तूफान मचा देगा।
says: Neptune will raise a storm in Ketu's house (Pisces), disturbing the spiritual, loss-related matters of that sign.
cells_derived_method: Where Pisces sits (12th for Aquarius-lagna etc.), the storm hits that house's topics.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: storm in the 12th, upheaval in expenses, sleep, foreign matters.
Derived: turbulence in home and peace of mind.
Derived: storms around beliefs and father.

hindi: केतु क्या आध्यात्म का देवता है।
says: Ketu is the god of spirituality; in the quote he is set against material pleasure.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is the classical karaka of moksha and spirituality.

hindi: मौज मस्ती ऐश परस्ती का हर चीज के मजे करने
says: Pleasure, fun, luxury and enjoying everything is the contrasting side, set against Ketu's spirituality; it is the pleasure-seeking nature of the Indra-Venus side of the line.
ambiguity: Sentence runs into the next slice and the subject is unclear (pleasure planet vs Ketu in Pisces).
classical_check: Agrees on Venus as luxury karaka.

hindi: प्लूटो महाराज 10 नंबर के न्याय के देवता है।
says: Pluto is in sign number 10 (Capricorn) and acts as the god of justice there.
cells_derived_method: Pluto in Capricorn lands in a different house for each lagna; justice and structural reckoning acts on that house's topics.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: justice and exposure in career and authority.
Derived: personal reckoning and rebuilding of identity.
Derived: reckoning in partnerships and contracts.

ambiguity: Pluto in the sidereal sign Capricorn; justice is usually Saturn's, so this is his own scheme.
classical_check: Differs: classical justice (nyaya) belongs to Saturn.

gist: Rhetorical: what will he do?

hindi: न्याय स्थापित करूंगा भैया मैं।
says: Pluto in Capricorn says it will establish justice, meaning exposure and correction of wrongs.

hindi: तो न्याय अन्याय की कहानियां जितनी भी हो रही है लंबे टाइम चल रहा है।
says: So the stories of justice and injustice now going on in the world have been running for a long time; this is the Pluto-in-Capricorn period.

hindi: और 20 साल अभी और जाएगा आगे।
says: About twenty more years of this will continue, as Pluto stays in the sign for that period.
ambiguity: '20 years' is loose; the remaining total depends on current progress.

hindi: 20 साल में से टोटल जितने रहते हैं उसके बाद ये अपना 11 नंबर में जाएगा।
says: After the remaining years are over, Pluto will move on to sign number 11 (Aquarius), which he calls Pluto's own house.

hindi: अब बृहस्पति महाराज तीन नंबर में शिफ्ट होने वाले हैं दो से।
says: Jupiter is about to shift into sign number 3 (Gemini) from sign number 2 (Taurus).
ambiguity: Date not given in the sentence.
classical_check: Agrees as an ephemeris-type statement (Jupiter moves one sign per year).

hindi: नेप्च्यून जब से यहां आया है इसने युद्ध शुरू करा दिया है।
says: Since Neptune came into Pisces, it has started wars.
ambiguity: A causal claim from one planet's transit.

hindi: लड़ाईयां 12 नंबर में शनि भी आ गया है।
says: Fights are on, and Saturn has also come into sign number 12 (Pisces).
classical_check: Agrees as a transit statement; Saturn is in Pisces in sidereal terms during this period.

hindi: शनि भी 12 नंबर के ऊपर ऐसी की तैसी फेर रहा है।
says: Saturn is also wrecking sign 12 (Pisces), pressing hard on it.

hindi: नेप्च्यून भी इकट्ठा आ गया है।
says: Neptune is also together there with Saturn; the two share the sign Pisces.

hindi: तो अब ये युद्ध करेंगे और शनि न्याय का देवता तो न्याय कराएगा।
says: So Neptune and its group will make war, while Saturn, the god of justice, will bring justice.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn is the karaka of justice.

hindi: अब इसके अंतर्गत प्रैक्टिकली स्पीकिंग 10 नंबर से 12 नंबर के ऊपर इसकी दृष्टि है।
says: Practically speaking, Pluto in sign 10 (Capricorn) looks at sign 12 (Pisces); this is its third-sign aspect.
cells_derived_method: The 3rd-from-itself aspect applies to whatever house Pisces is from Capricorn's house; Capricorn lagna: Pluto in 1st, aspect on 3rd.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 1st aspects the 3rd (Pisces), courage and siblings are shaken.
Derived: Pluto in the 7th aspects the 9th (Pisces), dharma and father.
Derived: Pluto in the 10th aspects the 12th (Pisces), expenses and foreign matters.

ambiguity: He may mean Saturn; 'इसकी' not named. Pluto is the sign-10 planet.
classical_check: Differs: classical aspects are the 3rd/10th for Saturn only; this 3rd aspect for Pluto is his own idea.

hindi: तीसरी तो युद्ध तो है ही।
says: The third (aspect or house) is war in any case; the 3rd-position aspect carries the war meaning.
ambiguity: 'Third' could be 3rd house (courage, battle) or the 3rd aspect.
classical_check: Agrees partly: the 3rd house is classically courage and fighting (Upachaya, Mars's house).

hindi: अब युद्ध समाज वैचारिक तौर पे होगा।
says: The war will happen on the level of society and ideology, as a war of thoughts.

hindi: बम के गोले के तौर पे होगा।
says: It will also happen as actual bombs and shells.

hindi: मंगल अभी चार नंबर का चल रहा है।
says: Mars is currently in sign number 4, Cancer.

hindi: नीच का होता है।
says: Mars is debilitated in Cancer; the sign number 4 is Mars's fall.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Cancer weakens its drive in the house it falls in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Mars in the 10th, weak drive in career, though Neecha-bhanga may apply.
Derived: debilitated Mars in the 4th, unrest in home and with mother.
Derived: debilitated Mars in the 1st, low confidence in assertion.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars is debilitated in Cancer.

gist: Remark: those who know astrology will understand these points.
'The debilitated Moon is going on' conflicts with Mars being the debilitated planet; probably a slip or garbled caption.
Repeats: Mars is going on now.

hindi: ये चलेगा 6 जुलाई 6 जून तक।
says: Mars stays in Cancer until 6 June (caption says both 6 July and 6 June); the period of its debilitation ends then.
ambiguity: Caption gives both '6 July' and '6 June'; he seems to settle on 6 June.
classical_check: Agrees as a transit statement type.

hindi: 6 जून तक तो वार बम बूम ब्लास्ट खटक फटक होएगा ही होएगा।
says: Until 6 June there will certainly be war, bombs and blasts; he predicts violence while Mars is debilitated in Cancer.
ambiguity: A mundane prediction; not validated.

hindi: फिर पांच नंबर में जाएगा दो ढाई महीने तब तक चलेगा।
says: Then Mars moves into sign number 5 (Leo) and stays about two to two-and-a-half months.
classical_check: Agrees as a transit statement: Mars spends about 45 days in a sign unless retrograde.

gist: Sentence breaks off: 'In so much (time)...' continues in next slice.

hindi: देर में बृहस्पति महाराज तीन नंबर में आ जाएंगे शिफ्ट हो के।
says: By that time Jupiter will have moved into sign number 3, Gemini.

hindi: तीन नंबर से बृहस्पति चार की ओर शिफ्ट होगा।
says: From Gemini, Jupiter will then move towards sign number 4, Cancer.

gist: Points at the chart: this is sign number 4.

hindi: ये उच्च चुका है।
says: Jupiter is exalted in Cancer; the sign number 4 is Jupiter's exaltation.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter exalted in Cancer lands in a different house for each lagna; its wisdom and expansion lifts that house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Jupiter in the 1st, strong wisdom, health and good fortune.
Derived: exalted Jupiter in the 10th, honoured career and rising status.
Derived: exalted Jupiter in the 5th, good children and judgment.

ambiguity: Caption 'उच्च चुका' read as 'उच्च का'.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is exalted in Cancer.

hindi: यानी जुपिटर ने बृहस्पति ने अक्टूबर में एंटर करते ही डेढ़ महीने के लिए रहेगा।
says: Jupiter will enter Cancer in October and stay about one and a half months.
ambiguity: Year not given.

hindi: फिर वापस तीन में चला जाएगा।
says: Then Jupiter goes back into sign 3 (Gemini), due to retrograde motion.
ambiguity: Retrograde is not named in the sentence.

hindi: फिर 6 महीने तीन में रह के फिर चार में जाएगा एक साल के लिए।
says: After about six months in Gemini, Jupiter then enters Cancer again for a full year.

hindi: यानी ये कहता है भारत को उठाना है।
says: Jupiter in Cancer says India must be uplifted; he reads this exalted transit as India's rise.
ambiguity: A mundane prediction.

gist: Repeats: India has to be raised, three times.

hindi: जहां धर्म की बात है।
says: Jupiter will uplift wherever dharma is concerned; dharma is the criterion for the uplifting.
ambiguity: Incomplete clause.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the karaka of dharma.

hindi: जहां सनातन की बात है उठाओ उठाओ।
says: Wherever Sanatan is concerned, Jupiter says lift it up.

hindi: चाहे भारत है अमेरिका है कहीं भी है।
says: The rule is not limited to India; it applies to any country, India or America or anywhere.

hindi: जहां भी होगी वहां उठाएगा।
says: Wherever dharma is found, Jupiter will lift it, whatever the country.

gist: Says he is using the word India for convenience.

hindi: तो ये वॉर का हिसाब किताब इसने बना दिया है।
says: This Jupiter movement has set up the account of the war; it shapes how the conflict plays out.

hindi: बुध प्रधान ग्रह सारे के सारे आ गए।
says: All the Mercury-dominant countries come into the picture; Mercury is the planet for such nations.
ambiguity: Caption says 'planets' but the next line says countries.

hindi: देश आ गए आपके जापान इत्यादि।
says: Countries like Japan are Mercury-dominant; those come into the picture.

hindi: बुध को कोई खास तंग करता नहीं है ये।
says: Jupiter does not specially trouble Mercury; it is not particularly hostile to Mercury.
classical_check: Differs: classically Mercury treats Jupiter as an enemy, but Jupiter is neutral to Mercury.

hindi: लेकिन बुध की राशि में आ रहा है।
says: But Jupiter is coming into Mercury's sign Gemini, so Mercury-type countries are touched.

hindi: तो चाइना जैसी कंट्री का थोड़ा सा प्रत्यक्ष नहीं तो परोक्ष रूप से एंट्री का हिसाब किताब युद्ध के अंदर बैठ सकता है।
says: A country like China may enter the war, if not directly then indirectly; he treats China as Mercury-dominant.
ambiguity: A mundane geopolitical prediction.

hindi: यहां से उठ के ये गया 7 8 9 प्लूटो के घर पे अटैक मारेगा।
says: From sign 4 (Cancer), Jupiter will strike Pluto's house through its 7th, 8th and 9th placements counted from itself.
cells_derived_method: From Cancer, counting 7, 8, 9 gives Capricorn, Aquarius and Pisces; the house of each depends on the lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 4th looks at the 10th (Capricorn), 11th (Aquarius) and 12th (Pisces).
Derived: Jupiter in the 1st looks at the 7th, 8th and 9th (Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces).

ambiguity: Caption is garbled; read as Jupiter's 7th, 8th and 9th. He counts different aspects from the classical 5, 7, 9.
classical_check: Differs: classical Jupiter aspects the 5th, 7th and 9th, not the 8th.

gist: Points to the chart: 'this is...' (the name Pluto follows in the next slice).

hindi: प्लूटो का घर है 11 नंबर।
says: Pluto's house is sign number 11, Aquarius.
ambiguity: Earlier he put Pluto in sign 10; here 11 is its own house.
classical_check: Silent: Pluto is not classical; Aquarius is classically Saturn's.

hindi: 11 नंबर पे पूर्ण दृष्टि होगी इसकी।
says: Jupiter will have a full aspect on sign 11 (Aquarius) from Cancer; Pluto's own house gets Jupiter's full sight.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 4th gives full sight to Aquarius, the 11th, gains and friends.
Derived: Jupiter in the 8th (Cancer) gives full sight to Aquarius, the 3rd, courage and siblings.

ambiguity: Sign 11 from sign 4 is the 8th place, not a classical Jupiter aspect.
classical_check: Differs: classical Jupiter does not fully aspect the 8th.

gist: Rhetorical: and what is Pluto?

hindi: तोड़फोड़ विध्वंस।
says: Pluto means breaking and demolition, destruction of structures.

hindi: बृहस्पति जकड़ता है।
says: Jupiter grips and holds; its aspect binds the planet it looks at.

gist: 'It is on the planet' (garbled fragment).

hindi: पकड़ने वाला ग्रह है।
says: Jupiter is the catching planet that takes hold of whatever it aspects.
ambiguity: Subject Jupiter from context.

hindi: यह कहता है जहां होगा भैया मैं तमीज से तमीज से लड़ो।
says: Wherever Jupiter is, it says: fight with decorum and proper conduct.

hindi: कोई अन्याय, कोई अत्याचार बाय द बुक चलो तरो मारना है किसी को तरीके से चलो।
says: Jupiter's rule is no injustice and no atrocity; go by the book, and if someone must be killed, do it in the proper way.
ambiguity: A war-ethics statement, not a chart rule.

hindi: यह उस प्रकार का प्लनेट है।
says: Jupiter is that kind of planet: rule-bound, lawful and just.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the karaka of law and dharma.

hindi: क्योंकि बृहस्पति की जहां दृष्टि आ गई ये किसी की नहीं सुनता।
says: Where Jupiter's aspect falls, it listens to no one; its look overrides the others.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter's aspect is classically strongly protective.

hindi: यह सबसे ज्यादा ऊंची चीज है।
says: Jupiter is the highest thing among the planets, the supreme authority.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is the guru of the gods.

hindi: ये किसी से भी प बृहस्पति राहु को भी दृष्टि देता है।
says: Jupiter casts its aspect even on Rahu; nothing escapes its look, even the unruly Rahu.
ambiguity: The opening 'ये किसी से भी प' is garbled.
classical_check: Agrees in principle: Jupiter aspects Rahu like any planet.

hindi: उसको भी कहता है ओ तरीके से आग लगा।
says: Jupiter tells even Rahu to set fire, but properly; it channels Rahu's destruction into controlled form.

hindi: तरीके से देख तरीके से भटका इसको।
says: Jupiter tells Rahu to look properly and mislead properly; even deception must follow rules.

hindi: धर्म अनुसार चलेंगे।
says: Everything will proceed by dharma under Jupiter's watch.

hindi: अधर्म अनुसार नहीं।
says: Not by adharma; unrighteous methods will not be allowed under Jupiter's aspect.

hindi: तो यह धर्म अनुसार मृत्यु करवाएगा प्लूटो के ऊपर।
says: So Jupiter's aspect on Pluto will bring a dharma-ruled ending, destruction carried out by the rules.
ambiguity: 'Death' is figurative for endings.

gist: Rhetorical: so what will happen in between?

hindi: जैसे वार्तालाप अभी हो गई कि हां भैया रोक रहे युद्ध नहीं रोक रहे हैं।
says: In between there will be on-off talks like the recent conversation about whether the war is being stopped.
ambiguity: A mundane current-affairs remark.

gist: Mock voice: 'OK, they are stopping.'
Mock voice: 'OK, they are not stopping.'

hindi: ये नौटंकी चलती रहेगी।
says: This theatre of talks will keep going while Jupiter is not yet in Cancer.

hindi: ये ड्रामेबाजी चलती रहेगी पांच महीने।
says: This drama will go on for five months, until Jupiter reaches sign 4.
ambiguity: Start date not given.

hindi: फिर बृहस्पति चार में आ जाएगा।
says: Then Jupiter will come into sign 4, Cancer.

hindi: चार में आते ही यह प्लूटो को सीधा डायरेक्टली दाब देगा।
says: As soon as Jupiter comes into Cancer it will directly press down on Pluto (in Capricorn, the 7th place from Cancer).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 4th presses Pluto in the 10th: restraint on career-level upheavals.
Derived: Jupiter in the 1st presses Pluto in the 7th: restraint on partnership upheaval.

classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter's 7th aspect from Cancer falls on Capricorn.

hindi: और टोटल न्याय के हिसाब से काम होगा।
says: Everything will then proceed on the basis of justice.

hindi: तो या तो यह अक्टूबर तक का कार्यक्रम लगा लो।
says: So reckon the programme (of war and talks) to run until October, when Jupiter enters Cancer.
ambiguity: A mundane time frame.

hindi: युद्ध जारी है।
says: The war continues until the conditions he lists end; stated as a flat claim.

gist: Rhetorical: now how long will the war last?

hindi: जब तक नेप्च्यून महाराज 12 नंबर में है तब तक युद्ध जारी है।
says: The war continues for as long as Neptune is in sign number 12 (Pisces).
ambiguity: Neptune stays about 14 years in a sign, so this is a long time frame.

hindi: 12 नंबर का नेप्च्यून युद्ध ही चलेगा।
says: Neptune in sign 12 will only run war; war is the sole character of this placement.

gist: Repeats: it will certainly go on.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष परोक्ष रूप से आना ही है।
says: Involvement, direct or indirect, is bound to come to us.

hindi: अब हमारे पास बुध और शुक्र से जो प्रधान तौर पे देश हैं ये जैसे पाकिस्तान इत्यादि हो गए।
says: The countries dominated by Mercury and Venus near us, such as Pakistan, belong to that group; he puts Pakistan among the Mercury/Venus-ruled countries.

gist: These are our immediate neighbouring countries.
So nobody ever gets along with their neighbour.
The neighbour's neighbour is always a friend.
And his neighbour is the enemy of our neighbour.
Two friends are those who share a third common enemy.
This works on its own for us.

hindi: तो ये 12 नंबर जो है ना ये तोड़ेगा।
says: Sign 12 (Pisces), with Neptune and Saturn in it, will break things apart.

gist: Rhetorical: what does Pluto do?

hindi: टुकड़े तोड़ता है।
says: Pluto breaks things into pieces; it fragments.

gist: Rhetorical: what does Neptune do?

hindi: तूफान लाता है।
says: Neptune brings storms.

hindi: तो तूफान आएंगे ऑटोमेटिकली।
says: So storms will come automatically while Neptune is in Pisces.
ambiguity: Storms may be literal or figurative.

hindi: तो ऐसी स्थिति में विखंडन होना लगभग लगभग तय है।
says: In this situation, a break-up (fragmentation) is almost certain.
ambiguity: A mundane prediction.

hindi: कोई ना कोई टीटर टुकड़े तोड़ लेगा।
says: Some party or country will break away in pieces; some entity will split off.
ambiguity: Caption word 'टीटर' is garbled.

hindi: अब भारत के पास चार नंबर का बृहस्पति आया।
says: Now Jupiter in sign 4 (Cancer) has come to India's side; the exalted Jupiter works for India.

hindi: चार नंबर का बृहस्पति आते ही यहां दृष्टि देगा सातवीं यहां आठवीं और नौवीं यहां
says: Jupiter in sign 4 will give aspects to its 7th, 8th and 9th places (Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces), pointing to each on the chart.

hindi: यही तो खेल है यह जो सबने बुध पेल रखा है ना तीन और छ तीन और छह बुध नहीं है तीन बुध है छह राहु है

hindi: वो राशि उड़ गई है।
